items.title_en: PISim: A Unified Photonic Inference Simulator for Hardware-Aware Cross-Layer Design-Space Exploration
items.title_zh: PISim：面向硬件感知跨层设计空间探索的统一光子推理模拟器
items.abstract_en: Photonic neural accelerators offer ultra-low latency linear algebra, yet their usable numerical precision, sustainable throughput, and application accuracy remain tightly bounded by surrounding electro-optical interfaces and physical non-idealities. Pre-fabrication design-space exploration (DSE) requires a cross-layer electronic design automation (EDA) framework capable of evaluating disparate optical topologies under identical neural workloads and physical assumptions. We present \textbf{PISim}, a unified Photonic Inference Simulator that couples pretrained deep neural network execution with physics-based models of six accelerator architecture families, six electro-optic modulator technologies, four optical source organizations, and direct or coherent readout schemes. PISim embeds stage-resolved impairment operators---covering control and analog-to-digital quantization, finite extinction ratio, shot noise, correlated relative-intensity noise (RIN), thermal drift, propagation loss, and channel crosstalk---alongside an analytical cycle-level interface timing model to expose electronic-optical bottlenecks. Using simulated MNIST multilayer perceptron (MLP) benchmarks, we demonstrate how PISim identifies optimal precision operating points under multi-impairment stress (peaking at 6 bits for Mach--Zehnder and microring modulators), quantifies a 52.5 percentage-point accuracy gap between VCSEL-array and parallel-fanout laser architectures arising, under the modeled conditions, from power partitioning and correlated source noise, and models interface-limited throughput scaling across emitter-array widths from 32 to 128 channels. This comprehensive framework establishes an extensible, reproducible foundation for accuracy-constrained Pareto optimization prior to photonic tape-out.
items.abstract_zh: 光子神经加速器可提供超低延迟的线性代数运算，但其可用数值精度、可持续吞吐量和应用精度仍受周围电光接口和物理非理想性的严格限制。制造前设计空间探索（DSE）需要一个跨层电子设计自动化（EDA）框架，能够在相同的神经工作负载和物理假设下评估不同的光学拓扑。我们提出 PISim，一个统一的光子推理模拟器，它将预训练深度神经网络执行与六类加速器架构家族、六种电光调制器技术、四种光源组织方式以及直接或相干读出方案的基于物理的模型耦合起来。PISim 嵌入阶段分辨的损伤算子——涵盖控制和模数转换量化、有限消光比、散粒噪声、相关相对强度噪声（RIN）、热漂移、传播损耗和信道串扰——并加入解析的周期级接口时序模型，以揭示电子—光学瓶颈。使用模拟的MNIST多层感知机（MLP）基准，我们展示PISim如何识别多损伤压力下的最优精度工作点（在Mach—Zehnder和微环调制器上峰值达到6比特），量化VCSEL阵列与并行扇出激光架构之间52.5个百分点的精度差距——在建模条件下，该差距源于功率分配和相关光源噪声——并建模从32到128信道的发射器阵列宽度下受接口限制的吞吐量扩展。这一综合框架为光子流片前受精度约束的Pareto优化建立了可扩展、可复现的基础。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Experience-Handoff Reinforcement Learning for Recursive Self-Improvement
items.title_zh: 面向递归自我改进的经验交接强化学习
items.abstract_en: It is common to train Large Language Models (LLMs) for agentic tasks with Reinforcement Learning (RL) from scalar rewards. However, this throws away the fine-grained information about the environment that the agent experienced during the trial (e.g., error logs). To utilize this rich information, recent works wrap the agent in a harness that refines its own inputs through reflection or compaction and hands past experience to future rollouts, but the construction of the handed-off artifacts (e.g., a playbook) is itself not learned. We want the best of both worlds: gradient updates from a scalar reward, while also utilizing environment information to hand off experience. As a concrete testbed, we fix the Agentic Context Engineering (\ace{}) harness and train one model to act, reflect, and curate task-local playbooks. Our method, \acerl{}, evaluates candidate experience-handoff artifacts by their downstream effect on future actor rollouts, and co-optimizes the role-specific behaviors (action generator, insight reflector, and playbook curator) under a fixed scaffold. Across agentic benchmarks, \acerl{} achieves higher held-out performance than baseline methods. The results suggest that agent training should optimize not only the actions in the current rollout, but also the model-written experience that future rollouts inherit.
items.abstract_zh: 使用来自标量奖励的强化学习（RL）训练大语言模型（LLM）执行智能体任务很常见。然而，这会丢弃智能体在试错过程中经历的关于环境的细粒度信息（例如错误日志）。为利用这些丰富信息，近期工作将智能体包裹在一个执行框架中，该框架通过反思或压缩来精炼自身输入，并将过去经验传给未来rollout，但所交接产物（如playbook）的构建本身并未被学习。我们希望兼得两者：既从标量奖励获得梯度更新，又利用环境信息来交接经验。作为一个具体测试平台，我们固定 Agentic Context Engineering（ACE）执行框架，并训练一个模型来行动、反思和整理任务本地的playbook。我们的方法 ACE-RL 根据候选经验交接产物对未来actor rollout的下游影响来评估它们，并在固定脚手架下协同优化角色特定行为（动作生成器、洞见反思器和playbook整理器）。在多个智能体基准上，ACE-RL的留出性能高于基线方法。结果表明，智能体训练不仅应优化当前rollout中的动作，还应优化未来rollout所继承的模型书写的经验。

items.title_en: Pretraining Data Statistics Shape the Phases of Learning Entity Comparison in Language Models
items.title_zh: 预训练数据统计塑造语言模型中实体比较学习的阶段
items.abstract_en: How does data shape language model (LM) behavior throughout pretraining? We investigate this question through a case study on entity comparison, e.g., Between France and Brazil, which country is larger?, across nine comparison tasks spanning five entity types. We begin with controlled experiments in which we train small LMs (163M parameters) on mixtures of natural text from pretraining corpora and synthetic task data. Our analysis identifies three distinct phases of learning: (1) an early phase where the LM selects entities by frequency, (2) a middle phase where the LM selects entities by position in the prompt (first vs. last mentioned entity), and (3) a late phase where the LM selects the entity that is the correct answer. We show that the emergence of these three phases is causally determined by statistical properties of the training data. With small amounts of task-specific synthetic data, we observe only the first two phases and the model fails to learn the task; with large amounts, the model jumps directly from the frequency-based heuristic to solving the task correctly. Moreover, changing the entity frequency distribution from a naturally occurring Zipfian distribution (a small number of entities are very common and the vast majority are rare) to a uniform one weakens the frequency phase and speeds up learning of the task. Lastly, we show that the three phases of training dynamics from our controlled experiments appear in the open source model OLMo-2 32B. Together, our findings demonstrate that properties of pretraining data are causal drivers of heuristic learning and show that small-scale synthetic experiments can predict training dynamics at larger scales.
items.abstract_zh: 数据在预训练全程如何塑造语言模型（LM）行为？我们通过对实体比较的案例研究来考察这一问题，例如“法国和巴西之间，哪个国家更大？”，涵盖跨越五类实体类型的九个比较任务。我们首先进行受控实验，在来自预训练语料的自然文本与合成任务数据的混合上训练小型LM（163M参数）。我们的分析识别出三个不同的学习阶段：（1）早期阶段，LM按频率选择实体；（2）中期阶段，LM按提示中的位置（最先提及与最后提及的实体）选择实体；（3）晚期阶段，LM选择作为正确答案的实体。我们表明，这三个阶段的出现由训练数据的统计特性因果决定。在少量任务特定合成数据下，我们仅观察到前两个阶段，模型未能学会该任务；在大量此类数据下，模型从基于频率的启发式直接跳到正确解决任务。此外，将实体频率分布从自然出现的Zipf分布（少数实体非常常见，绝大多数罕见）改为均匀分布，会削弱频率阶段并加快任务学习。最后，我们表明，受控实验中的三个训练动态阶段出现在开源模型 OLMo-2 32B 中。总之，我们的发现表明预训练数据的属性是启发式学习的因果驱动因素，并表明小规模合成实验可以预测更大规模下的训练动态。

items.title_en: Reins: Frontier Multimodal Models Driving Real Robot Arms on Long-Horizon Tasks, Zero-Shot
items.title_zh: Reins：前沿多模态模型零样本驱动真实机械臂完成长时程任务
items.abstract_en: Frontier models such as GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 can now plan and call tools, yet they still struggle to drive real robots through long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation, blind while the arm moves and while they think. We present Reins, a harness in which an off-the-shelf model operates a dual-arm robot with 3D perception tools and atomic actions that report contact and grip. The model chains actions in one call, each with a condition that must hold, stopping at the first that fails; a second instance, the narrator, watches the cameras continuously and reports what changed with every result. From images, Reins also builds a simulation-ready twin of the scene for continual policy learning. With natural-language prompts and no task-specific code, GPT-6.1 Sol succeeds in 88% of real episodes on five tasks; without the harness, it fails every shell game, taking 8 times as long. Three frontier models perform alike but differ in tracking a scene that changes while the actor thinks. Code will be released upon publication.
items.abstract_zh: GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Opus 5.5 等前沿模型如今能够规划和调用工具，但仍难以驱动真实机器人完成长时程、接触丰富的操作，并且在机械臂移动时和模型思考时处于盲态。我们提出 Reins，这是一个执行框架，其中现成模型使用3D感知工具和可报告接触与抓握的原子动作来操作双臂机器人。模型在单次调用中串联多个动作，每个动作都有一个必须成立的条件，并在第一个失败处停止；第二个实例——叙述者——持续观看摄像头，并报告每个结果带来的变化。Reins 还可根据图像构建场景的可仿真孪生体，用于持续策略学习。在自然语言提示且无任务特定代码的情况下，GPT-6.1 Sol 在五项任务的真实回合中成功率为88%；没有该执行框架时，它在每个猜壳游戏（shell game）中均失败，且耗时达到8倍。三个前沿模型表现相似，但在跟踪“执行者思考时发生变化的场景”方面存在差异。代码将在论文发表后发布。

items.title_en: Report of the 8th LSVOS Challenge: Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding
items.title_zh: 第8届LSVOS挑战赛报告：移动统一多模态理解
items.abstract_en: This report summarizes the Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding (MUMU) track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge, held in conjunction with ECCV 2026. MUMU asks for a single unified model that jointly performs multi-concept image tagging over quality, scene, and event vocabularies, open-vocabulary object detection, and concise image captioning, within a budget of 0.5B parameters and 8 GB of peak inference memory. Submissions are ranked by a weighted task score scaled by an efficiency factor. We describe the tasks, rules, and evaluation protocol, report the final results, and review the methods of the top three teams. All three leading solutions build on the compact Florence-2-base model, but extend it in different ways: lightweight tagging heads with cross-task inference refinement, a shared low-rank adapter trained on coverage-aware multi-source data with task-dependent decoding, and a training-free pipeline that maps captions to tags and applies detection test-time augmentation. The results show that a compact prompt-based vision-language model can serve all three outputs when supervision, decoding, and cross-task cues are designed for each task, while open-vocabulary detection on novel categories remains the main bottleneck.
items.abstract_zh: 本报告总结了与ECCV 2026同期举办的第8届大规模视频目标分割（LSVOS）挑战赛中的移动统一多模态理解（MUMU）赛道。MUMU要求单一统一模型在0.5B参数和8 GB峰值推理内存预算内，联合执行面向质量、场景和事件词表的多概念图像打标、开放词汇目标检测和简洁图像描述。提交作品按加权任务分数乘以效率因子排名。我们描述任务、规则和评估协议，报告最终结果，并回顾前三名团队的方法。三个领先方案均基于紧凑的Florence-2-base模型，但以不同方式扩展：带跨任务推理精炼的轻量打标头；在覆盖感知多源数据上训练的共享低秩适配器，并采用任务相关解码；以及将描述映射到标签并应用检测测试时增强的免训练流水线。结果表明，当监督、解码和跨任务线索针对每个任务设计时，紧凑的基于提示的视觉语言模型可以服务全部三种输出，而新类别上的开放词汇检测仍是主要瓶颈。

items.title_en: Expert-level localization of fine-grained cardiac structures across the transthoracic echocardiogram
items.title_zh: 经胸超声心动图中心脏细粒度结构的专家级定位
items.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence models for echocardiography interpret studies without identifying the structures that support their outputs. We show that this spatial grounding does not emerge from the pretraining of current vision-language models. General-purpose and medical vision-language models and an open-vocabulary detector recalled 3% or fewer of cardiac structures and scored below a box that never sees the image. EchoLens, a detector trained on 5,912 expert-annotated structures and 4,219 Doppler signals from 136 patients, recalled 87% and localized structures as reliably as a blinded expert reader (box centre within the reference in 95.7% and 95.3% of cases). It covers 21 structures across 11 transthoracic views and 11 spectral Doppler signal types. In external data, two physicians judged 81-92% of its detections correct across all 11 views, and it identified the Doppler signal type in 83% of frames. EchoLens provides the spatial layer that grounded echocardiographic interpretation requires.
items.abstract_zh: 用于超声心动图的AI模型可解读检查，却不识别支撑其输出的结构。我们表明，这种空间定位不会从当前视觉语言模型的预训练中涌现。通用和医学视觉语言模型以及一个开放词汇检测器召回了3%或更少的心脏结构，并且得分低于一个从未看到图像的边界框。EchoLens是一个在来自136名患者的5,912个专家标注结构和4,219个多普勒信号上训练的检测器，召回率为87%，并以与盲法专家读者同样可靠的方式定位结构（在95.7%和95.3%的病例中框中心位于参考范围内）。它覆盖11个经胸视图中的21个结构和11种频谱多普勒信号类型。在外部数据中，两名医生判定其检测结果在所有11个视图中81–92%正确，并且它在83%的帧中识别出多普勒信号类型。EchoLens提供了有依据的超声心动图解读所需的空间层。

items.title_en: Design and optimization of multilevel zone plates for flying focus applications
items.title_zh: 飞行焦点应用的多级波带片设计与优化
items.abstract_en: Flying focus pulses, characterized by programmable velocities decoupled from the group velocity, offer remarkable potential for high-intensity laser-matter interactions. However, achieving low-cost manufacturing while simultaneously suppressing higher-order foci and maintaining high efficiency remains a key challenge. Here, we propose a modulated width zone plate with $2^{M}$ steps (MWZP-$2^{M}$S). By employing Monte Carlo sampling of sinusoidal random widths, the MWZP-8S design statistically mimics a Gabor zone plate, suppressing higher-order foci by four orders of magnitude. Furthermore, the multilevel phase modulation converts opaque regions into constructive phase-shifting zones, significantly boosting the focusing efficiency to 73.7$\%$ when $M=3$. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the focal velocity is flexibly tunable across subluminal and superluminal regimes while remaining stable over 100 Rayleigh lengths. This scalable and cost-effective scheme provides a robust platform for flying focus applications in EUV generation and X-ray optics.
items.abstract_zh: 飞行焦点脉冲具有可编程速度且与群速度解耦，为高强度激光-物质相互作用提供了显著潜力。然而，在同时抑制高阶焦点并保持高效率的同时实现低成本制造仍是一个关键挑战。在此，我们提出一种具有$2^{M}$个台阶的调制宽度波带片（MWZP-$2^{M}$S）。通过对正弦随机宽度进行蒙特卡洛采样，MWZP-8S设计在统计上模仿Gabor波带片，将高阶焦点抑制四个数量级。此外，多级相位调制将不透明区域转换为相长移相区，在$M=3$时使聚焦效率显著提升至73.7$\%$。数值模拟表明，焦点速度可在亚光速和超光速区间灵活调谐，同时在100个瑞利长度上保持稳定。这种可扩展且成本有效的方案为EUV产生和X射线光学中的飞行焦点应用提供了稳健平台。

items.title_en: AgentSSL: Can MLE Agents Leverage Unlabeled Data?
items.title_zh: AgentSSL：MLE智能体能否利用无标签数据？
items.abstract_en: Applying machine learning systems to new domains introduces bottlenecks in both labeled data acquisition and manual pipeline engineering. While recent MLE agents show promise in automating pipeline design, they have been studied almost exclusively in fully supervised settings, leaving them untested in realistic regimes where labeled data is scarce but unlabeled data is abundant. In this work, we introduce Agentic Semi-Supervised Learning (AgentSSL), framing SSL as a program search problem and studying how agents navigate this space under limited supervision. We find that even under weak feedback and matched compute, agents can synthesize code that combines and adapts established SSL techniques, exceeding the strongest human-engineered baselines in 8 of 12 settings by up to +21.8%. However, our results identify program selection as a critical bottleneck in AgentSSL, where performance drops by as much as 47% when selecting based on the agent's feedback metric. To systematically study this bottleneck, we introduce ProgramSelectBench, a large-scale benchmark with a combined total of 16,977 agent-generated and human-engineered SSL programs, and evaluate both unsupervised and active program selection methods. We further evaluate AgentSSL on real-world ecology detection tasks, highlighting the opportunities and challenges of transferring agent-discovered strategies beyond controlled benchmarks.
items.abstract_zh: 将机器学习系统应用于新领域会在标注数据获取和手动流水线工程两方面引入瓶颈。尽管近期的MLE智能体在自动化流水线设计方面显示出前景，但它们几乎只在全监督设置中研究，尚未在标注数据稀缺但无标签数据丰富的现实场景中测试。在本工作中，我们引入智能体半监督学习（AgentSSL），将SSL表述为程序搜索问题，并研究智能体在有限监督下如何导航这一空间。我们发现，即使在弱反馈和匹配计算下，智能体也能合成结合并适配已有SSL技术的代码，在12种设置中的8种超过最强人工工程基线，最高提升+21.8%。然而，我们的结果识别出程序选择是AgentSSL中的关键瓶颈，当基于智能体的反馈指标进行选择时，性能最多下降47%。为系统研究这一瓶颈，我们引入ProgramSelectBench，一个包含总共16,977个智能体生成和人工工程SSL程序的大规模基准，并评估无监督和主动程序选择方法。我们进一步在真实生态检测任务上评估AgentSSL，突出将智能体发现的策略迁移到受控基准之外的机会与挑战。

items.title_en: Indic-Task Gains and Regressions after Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 强化学习后印度语言任务的增益与回退
items.abstract_en: We run reinforcement learning (RL) with GRPO across four environments, starting from a supervised fine-tuned 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model covering English and eight Indic languages. We compare the model before and after RL across 34 benchmarks in one evaluation campaign. MATH improves by 36.07 points, and most Indic benchmarks also improve. Yet XQuAD-Indic F1 falls 19.32 points as English answers rise from 8.7% to 91.7%; IndicQA falls 8.64, while English XQuAD gains 11.71 F1. A second RL run from the same supervised initialization adds an Indic environment together with language and repetition rewards. Compared with the released model, it improves both passage-answering and instruction-following benchmarks, along with preserving MATH performance. But it loses ground on reasoning and coding benchmarks. Several training choices changed together, so we cannot isolate the effect of any one of the reward terms. Script compliance remains unresolved. Adding a language reward did not ensure use of the requested script. Passage answering and script compliance therefore need direct evaluation, even when other benchmark scores improve.
items.abstract_zh: 我们使用GRPO在四个环境中运行强化学习（RL），起始模型是一个覆盖英语和八种印度语言的、经监督微调的30B-A3B混合专家模型。我们在一次评估活动中比较RL前后的模型，覆盖34个基准。MATH提升36.07分，大多数印度语言基准也提升。然而，随着英语答案从8.7%上升到91.7%，XQuAD-Indic F1下降19.32分；IndicQA下降8.64，而英语XQuAD提升11.71 F1。从同一监督初始化进行的第二次RL运行加入一个印度语言环境以及语言和重复奖励。与已发布模型相比，它在段落问答和指令遵循基准上均有提升，同时保持MATH性能。但它在推理和编码基准上退步。若干训练选择同时改变，因此我们无法隔离任一奖励项的效果。文字系统合规性仍未解决。加入语言奖励并未确保使用所要求的文字系统。因此，即使其他基准分数提升，段落问答和文字系统合规性仍需直接评估。

items.title_en: I See What You Want: Decoding Hierarchical Operator Intent from Visual Teleoperation History
items.title_zh: 我明白你想要什么：从视觉遥操作历史中解码分层操作员意图
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a powerful foundation for robotic scene understanding, task planning, and language-conditioned control. A natural question follows: can these models also decode what a human operator intends while teleoperating a robot, without any explicit instruction? We formulate this as hierarchical intent prediction, jointly inferring the ongoing atomic action and the broader mission it serves from a short visual teleoperation history. To study this, we introduce VI AMO (Vision Intention Action and Mission Ongoing), a dataset of 6,600 episodes from eleven robot sources with 13,653 temporally aligned action annotations and 9,702 mission annotations. Large proprietary models struggle with this problem: on held-out episodes, GPT-4o reaches Sentence-BERT similarities of only 0.563 and 0.470 for action and mission, and GPT-5.6 Luna achieves only 0.581 and 0.554. Fine-tuning a VLM on VI AMO yields our Vision-Intention Model (VIM), which raises these scores to 0.825 and 0.821 and still reaches 0.726 and 0.717 on the 35.4% of test actions with both labels absent from training. Finally, as a downstream application, VIM's predicted mission enables a vision-language-action (VLA) policy to take over from the operator mid-task in a real-world environment unseen during VIM fine-tuning, reducing human teleoperation time by 34.6% relative to GPT-4o and 39.8% relative to GPT-5.6 Luna, while cutting intent-prediction latency by roughly 70% on average.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）已成为机器人场景理解、任务规划和语言条件控制的强大基础。一个自然的问题随之而来：这些模型能否在没有任何显式指令的情况下，解码人类操作员在遥操作机器人时的意图？我们将其表述为分层意图预测，从短视觉遥操作历史中联合推断正在进行的原子动作及其服务的更广泛任务。为研究这一点，我们引入VI AMO（Vision Intention Action and Mission Ongoing），一个包含来自十一个机器人来源的6,600个回合、13,653个时间对齐动作标注和9,702个任务标注的数据集。大型专有模型在该问题上表现困难：在留出回合上，GPT-4o在动作和任务上的Sentence-BERT相似度仅达到0.563和0.470，GPT-5.6 Luna仅达到0.581和0.554。在VI AMO上微调VLM得到我们的Vision-Intention Model（VIM），将这些分数提高到0.825和0.821，并且在35.4%的训练中两个标签均缺失的测试动作上仍达到0.726和0.717。最后，作为下游应用，VIM预测的任务使视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略能够在VIM微调期间未见过的真实环境中，在任务中途从操作员接管，相对于GPT-4o减少人类遥操作时间34.6%，相对于GPT-5.6 Luna减少39.8%，同时平均将意图预测延迟降低约70%。

items.title_en: DuoJEPA: Cross-Modal Translation Between Unaligned Self-Supervised Embedding Spaces
items.title_zh: DuoJEPA：未对齐自监督嵌入空间之间的跨模态翻译
items.abstract_en: Learning from paired modalities is commonly equated with aligning them: two encoders are trained until the embeddings of a pair coincide in a shared space. We study whether cross-modal retrieval and classification can instead be obtained while the two encoders' own embedding spaces remain directly unaligned. DuoJEPA trains one encoder per modality with the self-supervised LeJEPA objective and appends to each encoder a single transformer layer that translates its embedding into the other encoder's space, supervised by a contrastive objective computed entirely within that target space. No loss term compares the two own spaces directly, although the encoders are optimised jointly through the translation objective. In our experiments, the translator's residual connections determine where the cross-modal pressure is absorbed: with a residual translator the two encoders become directly aligned, whereas with a skipless (residual-free) translator a paired-cosine test detects no alignment in the final models, and at most a weak one in the ablations, at comparable cross-modal performance. The learned class-token translation is well approximated by a single scaled rotation of the source space. We evaluate DuoJEPA on two modality pairs that differ in nearly every respect. On chest radiographs and reports from CheXpert Plus, it attains a zero-shot AUC of 86.6 and a cross-modal retrieval score of 78.5, compared with 60.0 and 64.2 for our reimplementation of LeVLJEPA with the same encoders and data. On Sentinel-2 optical and Sentinel-1 radar imagery, the frozen encoders fall within the range of published Sentinel foundation models under our reproduction of the Copernicus-Bench linear-probe protocol, the translator retrieves the paired image of the other sensor among 4,000 candidates in 77-79% of cases, and a patch-level extension transfers the within-image similarity structure of the scene.
items.abstract_zh: 从成对模态中学习通常被等同于对齐它们：训练两个编码器，直到一对嵌入在共享空间中重合。我们研究是否可以在两个编码器自身的嵌入空间保持直接未对齐的情况下，获得跨模态检索和分类。DuoJEPA 使用自监督 LeJEPA 目标为每种模态训练一个编码器，并在每个编码器后附加一个 transformer 层，将其嵌入翻译到另一个编码器的空间，该层由完全在该目标空间内计算的对比目标监督。没有损失项直接比较两个自身空间，尽管编码器通过翻译目标联合优化。在我们的实验中，翻译器的残差连接决定了跨模态压力被吸收的位置：使用残差翻译器时，两个编码器变得直接对齐；而使用无跳跃连接（无残差）翻译器时，配对余弦检验在最终模型中未检测到对齐，在消融实验中至多检测到弱对齐，同时跨模态性能相当。学到的类 token 翻译可以很好地由源空间的单个缩放旋转近似。我们在几乎各方面都不同的两个模态对上评估 DuoJEPA。在 CheXpert Plus 的胸部 X 光片和报告上，它达到 86.6 的零样本 AUC 和 78.5 的跨模态检索分数，而我们用相同编码器和数据重新实现的 LeVLJEPA 为 60.0 和 64.2。在 Sentinel-2 光学和 Sentinel-1 雷达影像上，在我们复现 Copernicus-Bench 线性探针协议下，冻结编码器落在已发表 Sentinel 基础模型的范围内；翻译器在 4,000 个候选中以 77-79% 的情况检索到另一传感器的配对图像；补丁级扩展迁移了场景的图像内相似性结构。

items.title_en: E2F4 gene therapy reverses established synaptic and cognitive deficits and remodels learning-associated signaling in Alzheimer's disease mice
items.title_zh: E2F4 基因治疗逆转阿尔茨海默病小鼠已建立的突触和认知缺陷，并重塑学习相关信号
items.abstract_en: Alzheimer's disease (AD) causes progressive synaptic dysfunction, neurodegeneration, and cognitive decline, yet strategies capable of reversing established deficits remain limited. Here, we show that neuronal expression of a p38MAPK phosphorylation-resistant human E2F4 variant (hE2F4DN), delivered by adeno-associated virus, restores hippocampal long-term potentiation and memory in homozygous 5xFAD mice after functional impairment is established. Treatment also reduces amyloid-{beta} and phospho-tau pathology and prevents hippocampal neuronal loss. Integrated proteomic and phosphoproteomic analyses reveal remodeling of metabolic, redox, neuroimmune, synaptic-vesicle, and GSK3{beta}-associated signaling pathways. Following contextual fear conditioning, hE2F4DN-treated mice exhibit broader learning-associated synaptic proteomic signatures and distinct phosphoregulatory responses involving synaptic machinery. These findings demonstrate that E2F4 gene therapy can reverse established synaptic and cognitive deficits while preserving neuronal integrity and reshaping molecular responses to learning, identifying E2F4 phosphorylation as a potential therapeutic target for advanced AD states.
items.abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）导致进行性突触功能障碍、神经退行和认知衰退，但能够逆转已建立缺陷的策略仍然有限。在此，我们表明，通过腺相关病毒递送神经元表达的抗 p38MAPK 磷酸化的人 E2F4 变体（hE2F4DN），在纯合 5xFAD 小鼠功能损伤建立后恢复海马长时程增强和记忆。治疗还减少淀粉样蛋白-β 和磷酸化 tau 病理，并防止海马神经元丢失。整合蛋白质组和磷酸化蛋白质组分析揭示代谢、氧化还原、神经免疫、突触囊泡和 GSK3β 相关信号通路的重塑。在情境恐惧条件反射后，hE2F4DN 治疗的小鼠表现出更广泛的学习相关突触蛋白质组特征，以及涉及突触机器的独特磷酸化调控反应。这些发现表明，E2F4 基因治疗可以逆转已建立的突触和认知缺陷，同时保持神经元完整性并重塑对学习的分子反应，将 E2F4 磷酸化确定为晚期 AD 状态的潜在治疗靶点。

items.title_en: An optical-frequency-comb-enabled unified infrastructure for quantum networks
items.title_zh: 一种由光学频率梳赋能的量子网络统一基础设施
items.abstract_en: Quantum networks require precision timing and classical communication to coordinate distributed quantum operations, yet these functions are typically supported by separate infrastructures, increasing system complexity and limiting scalability. Here we demonstrate an optical-frequency-comb-enabled infrastructure that unifies precision timing, classical communication and quantum communication over a shared fibre link. By encoding classical data onto the intensity of the comb while retaining its pulse timing, we simultaneously transmit data at 100 Mbit/s and achieve a timing stability of 0.85 fs at 1 s over 100 km. We develop a spectral-engineering strategy to suppress the coupling between data modulation and timing extraction. We further establish a power-dependent model of the excess noise induced in a co-propagating continuous-variable quantum key distribution channel, identifying optical power, wavelength allocation and propagation direction as the principal control parameters. After optimization, the system introduces only 0.0037 shot noise unit of additional excess noise and limits the secret-key-rate penalty to 6.7%. Furthermore, quantum-secured timestamp transmission additionally enables absolute time synchronization with a stability of 0.26 fs at 1 s. These results establish optical frequency combs as a common physical layer for integrated quantum-network services.
items.abstract_zh: 量子网络需要精确计时和经典通信来协调分布式量子操作，但这些功能通常由独立的基础设施支持，增加了系统复杂性并限制了可扩展性。在此，我们展示了一种由光学频率梳赋能的基础设施，在共享光纤链路上统一了精确计时、经典通信和量子通信。通过将经典数据编码到梳的强度上，同时保留其脉冲计时，我们在 100 km 上同时以 100 Mbit/s 传输数据，并在 1 s 处实现 0.85 fs 的计时稳定性。我们开发了一种光谱工程策略，以抑制数据调制与计时提取之间的耦合。我们进一步建立了共传播连续变量量子密钥分发信道中引起的额外噪声的功率依赖模型，确定光功率、波长分配和传播方向为主要控制参数。优化后，系统仅引入 0.0037 散粒噪声单位的额外额外噪声，并将密钥率损失限制在 6.7%。此外，量子安全时间戳传输还实现了绝对时间同步，在 1 s 处稳定性为 0.26 fs。这些结果确立了光学频率梳作为集成量子网络服务的通用物理层。

items.title_en: Using an energy pixels approach to estimate the size a 2nd Generation DEL must be to train a high-resolution binding model
items.title_zh: 用能量像素方法估计：训练高分辨率结合模型所需的第二代 DEL 规模
items.abstract_en: DNA-encoded libraries (DELs) are commonly used to find small-molecule binders to a target protein. But the hard part is no longer finding a hit. It is building a machine-learning model good enough to guide the medicinal chemistry that follows, one that can resolve the shift in affinity when a chemist changes a single atom. Such a model needs two things from its training data: dense sampling of the small patch of chemical space around the hit, and an adequate number of genuinely tight binders within it. A diverse naive DEL gives neither. It samples an enormous space, so any one neighborhood is covered far too thinly, and the tightest binders are rare. A model trained on that naive DEL data must extrapolate to binders tighter than any it has seen, and that is where models can fail. One way to get training data with both properties is a second-generation DEL built around the hit. We ask how complex that library must be. We treat binding as a sum of small, independent interactions, called pixels on the target and antipixels on the ligand. From the spread of affinities measured in the naive library, with no structural information and nothing yet synthesized, we estimate the complexity such a library must have to supply that dense sampling and those tight binders. The method does two useful things. It turns the number of tight binders a model needs into the number of compounds a library must contain. And it estimates the expected yield of a randomly designed second-generation DEL, so the gain from designing the library with machine learning or active learning can be measured against a baseline, without the expense of a control library as large as the experiment itself.
items.abstract_zh: DNA 编码库（DEL）常用于寻找靶蛋白的小分子结合物，但难点已不再是找到 hit，而是训练出足以指导后续药物化学的机器学习模型——要能分辨化学家改动单个原子所带来的亲和力变化。这类模型对训练数据有两点要求：命中点附近化学空间的密集采样，以及其中数量充足的真正高亲和力结合物。多样化朴素 DEL 两者皆缺：采样空间极大导致每个邻域过于稀疏，强结合物也罕见，模型必须外推到比所见更强的结合物，而这正是模型容易失败之处。围绕 hit 构建第二代 DEL 是获得此类数据的一条途径，我们追问该库需要多复杂。我们把结合视为目标上的“像素”与配体上的“反像素”之间独立小作用之和；仅依据朴素库中测得的亲和力分布（无需结构信息、尚未合成任何化合物），即可估计该库为提供密集采样与强结合物所需的复杂度。该方法的用处在于：把模型所需强结合物数量换算为库应含的化合物数量，并估计随机设计二代 DEL 的期望产出，从而为机器学习或主动学习设计库的增益提供基线，无需合成与实验同等规模的对照库。
items.highlight_zh: 不合成化合物，即可预估二代 DEL 所需规模与产出
items.digest_zh:
1）研究问题：用 DNA 编码库（DEL）筛选小分子早已能出 hit，真正卡脖子的是后续模型：要指导药物化学微调，模型必须能分辨“改一个原子”造成的亲和力变化，也就是高分辨率。这种模型对训练数据要求苛刻——命中点周围的化学空间要密采样，且里面要有足够多真正结合得紧的分子。而普通的“朴素”DEL 两头都不满足：空间太大导致邻域极稀疏，强结合物又很少，模型等于被迫外推到它从没见过的高亲和力区域，容易失准。
2）方法：思路是围绕 hit 专门设计第二代 DEL。作者把结合能建模为一系列小的、相互独立的相互作用之和，形象地称为靶标上的“像素”与配体上的“反像素”。只利用朴素库里测到的亲和力分布，不需要蛋白结构信息，也不需要先合成任何化合物，就能估算出这个二代库要多复杂（多大）才够用。
3）结果与工具价值：方法给出两件实用产出：一是把“模型需要多少个强结合物”换算成“库必须装多少化合物”；二是预估随机设计的二代 DEL 的期望产出，相当于一个基线。有了这个基线，用机器学习或主动学习来设计库究竟带来多少增益就能被量化，而不必付出合成一个与实验同等规模对照库的昂贵代价。
4）为何重要：它把一个耗资巨大的湿实验决策（该建多大的库）前移到几乎零成本的计算估算，为 DEL 驱动的药物发现提供了可规划的资源分配依据。

items.title_en: Show Your Work in Swahili: Reinforcement Learning for Native-Language Mathematical Reasoning
items.title_zh: 用斯瓦希里语展示你的工作：面向母语数学推理的强化学习
items.abstract_en: We present Fikiria, a two-stage SFT+GRPO recipe for Swahili mathematical reasoning. Its reward multiplies a format gate by a weighted sum of answer accuracy and the ChrF\texttt{++} similarity of the Swahili reasoning to an in-language reference chain of thought, so that training targets the surface fidelity of the reasoning trace and not only the final answer. We train on a 2.3k-problem Swahili dataset created by translating GSM8K with GPT-4.1 and filtering with SSA-COMET. On AfriMGSM Swahili, Fikiria-AfriqueQwen-14B reaches 79.2\%. Under the same fixed prompt and strict answer-format scoring, GPT-4o reaches 68.0\%, partly because it often fails the required answer format; IrokoBench reports 78.8\% for GPT-4o using a best-per-model prompt, a figure numerically close to ours but not directly comparable. In a small human evaluation with co-author annotators, GPT-4o's outputs were preferred overall. ChrF\texttt{++} measures surface fidelity, not the validity of individual reasoning steps.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Fikiria，一种用于斯瓦希里语数学推理的两阶段 SFT+GRPO 方法。其奖励将格式门乘以答案准确率和斯瓦希里语推理与语言内参考思维链的 ChrF++ 相似度的加权和，因此训练针对推理轨迹的表面保真度，而不仅仅是最终答案。我们在一个 2.3k 问题的斯瓦希里语数据集上训练，该数据集通过用 GPT-4.1 翻译 GSM8K 并用 SSA-COMET 过滤创建。在 AfriMGSM 斯瓦希里语上，Fikiria-AfriqueQwen-14B 达到 79.2%。在相同的固定提示和严格的答案格式评分下，GPT-4o 达到 68.0%，部分原因是它经常不符合要求的答案格式；IrokoBench 报告 GPT-4o 使用每模型最佳提示达到 78.8%，这一数字在数值上接近我们的结果，但不能直接比较。在与共同作者标注者进行的小型人工评估中，GPT-4o 的输出总体上更受偏好。ChrF++ 衡量表面保真度，而不是单个推理步骤的有效性。

items.title_en: ManiLadder: Benchmarking Robot Manipulation Through a Categorized and Multi-Difficulty Level Task Ladder
items.title_zh: ManiLadder：通过分类多难度层级任务阶梯对机器人操作进行基准测试
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in robotic manipulation have enabled increasingly complex and dexterous behaviors, yet existing benchmarks still focus on simple pick-and-place tasks and lack a systematic framework for measuring progress in robot learning along the axis of task difficulty. We present ManiLadder, a large-scale and organized simulation benchmark for robotic manipulation. ManiLadder contains 112 carefully designed tasks stratified into 4 difficulty levels, with 8 categories in each level, spanning rigid-body and deformable-object manipulation, single-arm and dual-arm settings, and gripper and dexterous-hand end-effectors. To calibrate difficulty, we fix the data amount the same for every task and use a unified flow- matching imitation learning policy under the same training and evaluation protocols, then use its evaluation success rate as an operational empirical difficulty signal. All tasks are iteratively refined until they fall into target difficulty ranges, which are then verified across different random seeds, policies, and agentic learning systems. We further analyze the task properties, compare different policy performances and training settings, analyze task transfer and data scaling behaviors, and conduct real-world experiments showing that the designed tasks preserve their difficulty ordering beyond simulation. ManiLad- der provides a calibrated ladder for measuring, comparing, and advancing robotic manipulation capabilities. More results are available at https://maniladder-benchmark.github.io/.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人操作的最新进展使得越来越复杂和灵巧的行为成为可能，但现有基准仍然关注简单的拾放任务，缺乏沿任务难度轴衡量机器人学习进展的系统框架。我们提出 ManiLadder，一个大规模、有组织的机器人操作仿真基准。ManiLadder 包含 112 个精心设计的任务，分层为 4 个难度级别，每个级别有 8 个类别，涵盖刚体和可变形物体操作、单臂和双臂设置，以及夹爪和灵巧手末端执行器。为了校准难度，我们将每个任务的数据量固定相同，并在相同训练和评估协议下使用统一的流匹配模仿学习策略，然后将其评估成功率作为可操作的经验难度信号。所有任务经过迭代改进，直到落入目标难度范围，然后跨不同随机种子、策略和智能体学习系统进行验证。我们进一步分析任务属性，比较不同策略性能和训练设置，分析任务迁移和数据缩放行为，并进行真实世界实验，表明设计的任务在仿真之外保持其难度排序。ManiLadder 提供了一个校准的阶梯，用于衡量、比较和推进机器人操作能力。更多结果见 https://maniladder-benchmark.github.io/。

items.title_en: FoveaDet: Software-Hardware Co-Design of Foveated CNN-Transformer for Object Detection
items.title_zh: FoveaDet：面向目标检测的注视式 CNN-Transformer 软硬件协同设计
items.abstract_en: Deploying real-time object detection on power-constrained edge platforms is challenging as processing full-resolution frames is often computationally redundant. Inspired by biological foveation which assigns variable resolution based on visual saliency, we propose a novel software-hardware co-design framework called FoveaDet. On the software side, FoveaDet dynamically identifies salient regions to predict fixation points, followed by aggressive patch pruning in Vision Transformers (ViT) to discard irrelevant background data. To mitigate slowdowns from sequential patch generation, we implement optimized interpolation and patch selection algorithms. Evaluated on standard GPUs, this foveated approach reduces floating-point operations by 65.4% to 92.2% and accelerates inference by 4.76x, while suffering a negligible mAP drop compared to dense baselines. To eliminate hardware bottlenecks, we complement the algorithm with a custom RISC-V core featuring specialized instructions to accelerate the foveated processing pipeline. FoveaDet provides a scalable, efficient architecture capable of unlocking advanced vision processing on severely constrained mobile platforms.
items.abstract_zh: 在功耗受限的边缘平台上部署实时目标检测颇具挑战，因为处理全分辨率帧常带来计算冗余。受生物注视机制启发——依据视觉显著性分配可变分辨率——本文提出软硬件协同设计框架 FoveaDet。软件端动态识别显著区域并预测注视点，随后在 Vision Transformer（ViT）中激进裁剪 patch，丢弃无关背景数据；为缓解顺序生成 patch 导致的减速，实现了优化的插值与 patch 选择算法。在标准 GPU 上评估，该注视式方法将浮点运算量降低 65.4% 至 92.2%，推理加速 4.76 倍，且相较稠密基线 mAP 下降可忽略。为消除硬件瓶颈，作者还配套设计带专用指令的定制 RISC-V 核，加速注视式处理流水线。FoveaDet 提供可扩展的高效架构，有望在资源严苛的移动平台上释放先进视觉处理能力。
items.highlight_zh: 注视式剪枝加专用RISC-V指令，检测推理提速4.76倍
items.digest_zh:
这篇论文关注一个实际问题：在手机、嵌入式设备等功耗受限平台上做实时目标检测时，如果每帧都按全分辨率处理，大量背景像素其实没必要算，导致算力和能耗浪费。

作者从人眼“中央凹注视”获得灵感：人眼只在感兴趣区域保持高分辨率，周边区域分辨率较低。FoveaDet 因此在软件端先动态找出画面中的显著区域并预测注视点，再在 Vision Transformer 中大幅裁剪 patch，把无关背景丢掉；同时优化插值和 patch 选择流程，避免因逐块生成而拖慢速度。

在标准 GPU 上测试，该方法把浮点运算量减少 65.4% 到 92.2%，推理速度提升 4.76 倍，而检测精度 mAP 相比稠密基线几乎不降。为进一步消除硬件瓶颈，团队还设计了带专用指令的定制 RISC-V 核，用来加速整套注视式处理流水线。

其重要性在于：它把“只看该看的地方”的生物视觉策略落到算法与芯片协同层面，为资源严重受限的移动平台提供可扩展、高效率的目标检测方案。

items.title_en: Warming, thermal variability, and the 96% decline in childhood respiratory-infection mortality in China: a national time-series analysis of the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021 and the C-LSAT high-resolution climate dataset
items.title_zh: 变暖、温度变率与中国儿童呼吸道感染死亡率下降 96%：基于全球疾病负担研究 2021 与 C-LSAT 高分辨率气候数据集的全国时间序列分析
items.abstract_en: Background Childhood respiratory mortality in China has fallen by over 90% in three decades alongside sustained national warming, yet national long-run evidence on temperature and child respiratory mortality is lacking. Methods We linked Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2021 mortality estimates (rates use a fixed 2022 population denominator, so rate trends equal death-count trends) for China - lower respiratory infections (LRI), ages 0-19, and asthma, ages 0-24, 1990-2021 - with C-LSAT 0.5 degree gridded temperature data (1990-2019), aggregated nationally and to five climate zones. Four annual indicators (mean temperature, diurnal temperature range, seasonal amplitude, interannual variability) entered regressions of log mortality rates with Newey-West standard errors. A bootstrapped (500 resamples) quadratic model probed the minimum mortality temperature (MMT), with PM2.5-adjusted analyses and future-exposure, permutation, and detrended falsification tests. Changes in China's national thermal regime for 2041-2060 were additionally projected under three CMIP6 SSP scenarios (SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5; WorldClim v2.1 1970-2000 baseline, MRI-ESM2-0) using a matched-cell delta method. Results LRI deaths fell by 96.3% (330,194 in 1990 to 12,098 in 2021; 95% uncertainty interval 9,669-14,891) and asthma deaths by 94.9% (3,287 to 167), while mean temperature rose 0.364 degrees C per decade and diurnal temperature range narrowed 0.092 degrees C per decade. Baseline coefficients were large (mean temperature -1.696, SE 0.174; diurnal temperature range +2.408, SE 0.336; seasonal amplitude -0.162, SE 0.082; interannual variability +2.924, SE 1.514, per 1 degree C in log rate), but the future-exposure test failed and detrending nullified every coefficient: the associations are trend-level, and short-cycle causal effects are not identifiable. Nor was the national MMT identifiable - observed temperature support spans only 6.66-8.13 degrees C, and the nominal turning point of 35.84 degrees C is an extrapolation artifact (quadratic term p = 0.963). Within the observed range, warming and declining mortality moved in the same direction. A CMIP6 scenario projection (WorldClim v2.1, MRI-ESM2-0, matched-cell national means) indicates a further +2.19 to +3.02 degrees C of national warming by 2041-2060, with little change in diurnal temperature range or seasonal amplitude. Conclusions The 96% decline in childhood respiratory mortality cannot be attributed to warming. China sits on the low-temperature side of the optimum, and the marginal direction of future warming requires stronger designs to establish. The falsification framework offers a discipline for climate-health inference in China. Bias-corrected scenario projections place China's 2050s mean temperature (approximately 9.4-10.3 degrees C on the C-LSAT scale) still far below multi-country optima (14.7-19.8 degrees C), noting that an annual-mean construct is not fully comparable with daily-scale MMT estimates.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：三十年间，中国儿童呼吸道死亡率下降超过 90%，同期全国持续变暖，但仍缺乏关于温度与儿童呼吸道死亡率的全国长期证据。方法：我们将全球疾病负担（GBD）2021 的死亡率估计值（率采用固定的 2022 年人口分母，因此率的趋势与死亡数趋势相同）——中国 0–19 岁下呼吸道感染（LRI）和 0–24 岁哮喘，1990–2021 年——与 C-LSAT 0.5 度网格温度数据（1990–2019）相链接，汇总至全国及五个气候区。四个年度指标（平均温度、昼夜温差、季节振幅、年际变率）进入以对数死亡率为因变量的回归，采用 Newey-West 标准误。一个自助法（500 次重抽样）二次模型探究最低死亡温度（MMT），并开展 PM2.5 调整分析以及未来暴露、置换和去趋势证伪检验。此外，采用匹配格点 delta 方法，在三种 CMIP6 SSP 情景（SSP1-2.6、SSP2-4.5 和 SSP5-8.5；WorldClim v2.1 1970–2000 基线，MRI-ESM2-0）下预测中国 2041–2060 年全国热力状况的变化。结果：LRI 死亡下降 96.3%（1990 年 330,194 例降至 2021 年 12,098 例；95% 不确定区间 9,669–14,891），哮喘死亡下降 94.9%（3,287 降至 167），而平均温度每十年上升 0.364 摄氏度，昼夜温差每十年收窄 0.092 摄氏度。基线系数很大（平均温度 −1.696，SE 0.174；昼夜温差 +2.408，SE 0.336；季节振幅 −0.162，SE 0.082；年际变率 +2.924，SE 1.514，均为每 1 摄氏度对应的对数率变化），但未来暴露检验未通过，去趋势使所有系数归零：这些关联处于趋势层面，短周期因果效应无法识别。全国 MMT 也无法识别——观测到的温度支撑范围仅为 6.66–8.13 摄氏度，而 35.84 摄氏度的名义转折点是外推假象（二次项 p = 0.963）。在观测范围内，变暖与死亡率下降方向相同。一项 CMIP6 情景预测（WorldClim v2.1、MRI-ESM2-0、匹配格点全国均值）表明，到 2041–2060 年全国将再升温 +2.19 至 +3.02 摄氏度，昼夜温差或季节振幅变化很小。结论：儿童呼吸道死亡率下降 96% 不能归因于变暖。中国位于最适温度的低温度一侧，未来变暖的边际方向需要更强的设计才能确定。该证伪框架为中国气候—健康推断提供了一种规范。偏差校正的情景预测显示，中国 2050 年代平均温度（按 C-LSAT 尺度约为 9.4–10.3 摄氏度）仍远低于多国最适温度（14.7–19.8 摄氏度），并指出年均值构念与日尺度 MMT 估计并不完全可比。

items.title_en: Metasurfaces with Anisotropic Electric and Magnetic Conductivities: Parameter Retrieval for Arbitrary Incidence and Polarization
items.title_zh: 具有各向异性电导率与磁导率的超表面：面向任意入射与极化的参数反演
items.abstract_en: Metasurfaces come in a great variety of unit cell geometries and material composition. A common approach for describing them relies on retrieving effective surface parameters (e.g., electric and magnetic conductivities) from plane-wave scattering data. Conventional retrieval methods are often limited to isotropic unit cells, a uniform host material, or lead to increased complexity by requiring reflection and transmission coefficients from both sides of the metasurface. Here, we derive analytical expressions for the equivalent surface conductivities of an electrically- and magnetically-polarizable anisotropic metasurface under oblique plane-wave incidence with arbitrary polarization. The proposed formulation does not require bidirectional scattering information, thus simplifying the process especially in experimental studies. The method is validated through representative electric and magnetic meta-atoms at microwave and THz frequencies, respectively. Their ability for polarization conversion is demonstrated and discussed relying on the physical insight provided by the retrieved anisotropic conductivities. In addition, we present the inverse expressions for calculating the reflection and transmission coefficients from known surface conductivity tensors, which can prove useful for metasurface synthesis and radiation problems.
items.abstract_zh: 超表面具有种类繁多的单元胞几何结构与材料组成。描述它们的一种常见方法依赖于从平面波散射数据中反演有效表面参数（例如电导率与磁导率）。传统反演方法往往局限于各向同性单元胞、均匀主介质，或需要超表面两侧的反射与透射系数而增加复杂度。本文推导了在斜入射平面波、任意极化条件下，电与磁可极化的各向异性超表面的等效表面电导率的解析表达式。所提公式不需要双向散射信息，因而简化了流程，尤其在实验研究中。该方法分别通过微波与太赫兹频率下具有代表性的电、磁超原子进行了验证。基于反演所得各向异性电导率提供的物理洞见，展示并讨论了它们的极化转换能力。此外，我们给出了由已知表面电导率张量计算反射与透射系数的逆表达式，这对超表面综合与辐射问题可能有用。

items.title_en: A Recipe for Physical Action Model Training
items.title_zh: 物理动作模型训练的实施方案
items.abstract_en: Choosing robot model capacity and demonstration budgets also requires decisions about data composition, representation, optimization, and deployment. We connect these decisions through a common conditional-distribution target. Nested learning oracles give exact risk accounting; local information geometry, conditional mutual information, and empirical convergence provide conditional training prescriptions. Known-target numerical checks expose capacity-data coupling, representation-induced mixture mismatch, and an example where deployment KL increases while negative log-likelihood decreases. An analysis of 206 public PushT trajectories evaluates fixed-feature information-design criteria without fitting a policy. Under asymmetric evaluation targets, the selected allocations reduce this criterion by 4.5-6.2% relative to target matching; balanced targets show no benefit. These results clarify which quantities can support training recommendations and when an apparently favorable predictive metric has a different interpretation.
items.abstract_zh: 选择机器人模型容量与示范数据预算，还需要就数据组成、表示、优化与部署做出决策。我们通过一个共同的条件分布目标将这些决策联系起来。嵌套学习预言机给出精确的风险核算；局部信息几何、条件互信息与经验收敛性提供条件化的训练处方。已知目标的数值检验揭示了容量—数据耦合、表示诱发的混合失配，以及一个部署 KL 上升而负对数似然下降的例子。对 206 条公开 PushT 轨迹的分析在不拟合策略的情况下评估固定特征的信息设计准则。在非对称评估目标下，所选分配使该准则相对目标匹配降低 4.5–6.2%；平衡目标则无收益。这些结果厘清了哪些量可支撑训练建议，以及一个看似有利的预测指标何时具有不同的解释。

items.title_en: SimRec: Learning to Search, Ask, and Recommend from Simulated Interaction
items.title_zh: SimRec：从模拟交互中学习搜索、询问与推荐
items.abstract_en: LLM-based recommendation agents can search catalogs, inspect products, ask users, and revise rejected recommendations. However, these behaviors are often governed by hand-designed workflows, while existing training methods optimize isolated components such as query rewriting or list ranking rather than the interaction policy as a whole. We present SimRec, a reinforcement learning framework that trains the full interaction policy of a tool-integrated recommendation agent. SimRec introduces two components. A task-anchored user simulator provides feedback on every recommendation: conditioned on the current task need rather than on user profile, and it can be an external LLM or the recommender itself under self-play. A task-aligned reward optimizes the whole trajectory with GRPO, crediting natural retrieval quality and valid tool use alongside the final hit, with training-only target injection to handle sparse hits over large catalogs. On ESCI and Amazon C4, SimRec improves the NDCG@100 of a Qwen3-4B agent from 32.23% to 35.42% and from 22.94% to 24.72%}, outperforming training-free agents on far larger backbones and task-aligned baselines on NDCG. Analysis shows that the trained agent verifies candidates, uses preferences, and recovers from rejected recommendations far more often than its untrained counterpart. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/SimRec .
items.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的推荐智能体能够搜索商品目录、查看商品、询问用户，并对被拒绝的推荐进行修正。然而，这些行为往往由手工设计的工作流控制，而现有训练方法优化的是查询改写或列表排序等孤立组件，而非作为整体的交互策略。我们提出 SimRec，一个强化学习框架，用于训练工具集成推荐智能体的完整交互策略。SimRec 引入两个组件。一个任务锚定的用户模拟器对每条推荐给出反馈：其条件基于当前任务需求而非用户画像，且可以是外部 LLM，或在自我博弈下由推荐器自身充当。一个任务对齐的奖励用 GRPO 优化整条轨迹，在最终命中之外还对自然检索质量与有效工具使用给予信用，并采用仅在训练时使用的目标注入以处理大目录下的稀疏命中。在 ESCI 和 Amazon C4 上，SimRec 将 Qwen3-4B 智能体的 NDCG@100 从 32.23% 提升至 35.42%，从 22.94% 提升至 24.72%，在 NDCG 上优于规模大得多的骨干上的免训练智能体以及任务对齐基线。分析表明，训练后的智能体验证候选、利用偏好并从被拒绝的推荐中恢复的频率远高于未训练版本。代码见 https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/SimRec 。

items.title_en: Hibikino-Musashi@Home 2026 Team Description Paper
items.title_zh: Hibikino-Musashi@Home 2026 队伍描述论文
items.abstract_en: This paper presents an overview of the integrated technologies developed for the Open Platform League at RoboCup@Home 2026 in Incheon. A vision system integrated with learning-based, training-free models enables robust object recognition for both known and unknown objects. We introduce a RoomPlan-based method that semi-automatically registers furniture geometry and labels to generate semantic maps. Additionally, a large language model-based planner interprets the instructions recognized by Whisper and generates primitive skill sequences for execution. A reservoir-computing framework serves as a lightweight temporal-processing model for action recognition. Its field-programmable gate array-based implementation enables low-power, real-time operation. This is key to removing operational time constraints for service robots. Open-source releases, including task environments, dataset tools, and navigation frameworks, enhance reproducibility, reuse, and continuous progress within the RoboCup@Home community.
items.abstract_zh: 本文概述了为在仁川举行的 RoboCup@Home 2026 开放平台联赛所开发的集成技术。一个集成了基于学习的免训练模型的视觉系统，能够对已知和未知物体进行稳健的物体识别。我们介绍一种基于 RoomPlan 的方法，可半自动地注册家具几何与标签以生成语义地图。此外，一个基于大语言模型的规划器解释由 Whisper 识别出的指令，并生成用于执行的原语技能序列。一个储备池计算框架作为动作识别的轻量级时序处理模型。其基于现场可编程门阵列的实现支持低功耗、实时运行。这对于消除服务机器人的运行时间限制至关重要。开源发布包括任务环境、数据集工具和导航框架，增强了 RoboCup@Home 社区内的可复现性、复用与持续进展。

items.title_en: ThermalSplat: Generalizable Pose-Free Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Thermal 3D Reconstruction
items.title_zh: ThermalSplat：面向稀疏视角热红外三维重建的可泛化无位姿高斯泼溅
items.abstract_en: Thermal infrared imaging is vital for applications like search-and-rescue and autonomous navigation, yet trans- lating it into 3D scene representations remains a critical bottleneck. The low-texture nature and view-dependent emissivity of thermal images cause standard pose estima- tors to fail catastrophically, collapsing standard 3D Gaus- sian Splatting pipelines under sparse-view constraints. Fur- thermore, existing thermal reconstruction methods rely heavily on dense capture and computationally expensive per-scene optimization. Critically, many of these ap- proaches depend on aligned RGB-thermal datasets to ob- tain reliable camera poses and initial point clouds, ren- dering them unusable in purely thermal, unposed envi- ronments. To break this bottleneck, we present Thermal- Splat, the first generalizable, feed-forward Gaussian splat- ting framework that reconstructs 3D scenes directly from sparse thermal images without requiring known camera poses, RGB guidance, or per-scene training. We over- come thermal-specific challenges using a soft census loss for brightness-invariant structural matching and a bound- ary structure loss to explicitly supervise temperature discon- tinuities. Trained on an aggregated multi-source dataset, ThermalSplat synthesizes sharp reconstructions of unseen scenes in a single feed-forward pass. Extensive experi- ments demonstrate that ThermalSplat holds a strict advan- tage over scene-specific thermal splatting methods in the sparse regime. Furthermore, even compared against these baselines operating under their ideal dense capture set- tings, ThermalSplat achieves superior perceptual fidelity. By eliminating the need for computationally expensive per scene optimization, ThermalSplat offers an efficient and generalizable approach to thermal 3D reconstruction.
items.abstract_zh: 热红外成像对于搜救和自主导航等应用至关重要，但将其转化为三维场景表示仍是一个关键瓶颈。热图像的低纹理特性和视角依赖的发射率会使标准位姿估计器灾难性失效，并在稀疏视角约束下使标准三维高斯泼溅流程崩溃。此外，现有热红外重建方法严重依赖密集采集和计算昂贵的逐场景优化。关键的是，其中许多方法依赖对齐的RGB-热红外数据集来获得可靠相机位姿和初始点云，使其在纯热红外、无位姿环境中无法使用。为打破这一瓶颈，我们提出ThermalSplat，这是首个可直接从稀疏热红外图像重建三维场景的可泛化前馈高斯泼溅框架，无需已知相机位姿、RGB引导或逐场景训练。我们通过用于亮度不变结构匹配的软Census损失和用于显式监督温度不连续的边界结构损失，克服了热红外特有的挑战。在聚合多源数据集上训练后，ThermalSplat可在单次前馈过程中合成未见场景的清晰重建。大量实验表明，在稀疏条件下，ThermalSplat相对于场景特定热红外泼溅方法具有严格优势。此外，即使与在理想密集采集设置下运行的这些基线相比，ThermalSplat也实现了更优的感知保真度。通过消除计算昂贵的逐场景优化需求，ThermalSplat为热红外三维重建提供了一种高效且可泛化的方法。

items.title_en: After the vaccine era: sequencing platform investments as the childhood pneumonia spectrum diversifies
items.title_zh: 疫苗时代之后：儿童肺炎病原谱多样化背景下的测序平台投资
items.abstract_en: Background The historic decline in childhood pneumonia mortality was driven substantially by single-pathogen vaccines against Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib) and Streptococcus pneumoniae. Yet the pathogen spectrum underlying child pneumonia deaths is diversifying: the effective number of pathogens rose from 5.57 in 1990 to 9.94 in 2023, and the residual burden is shifting toward opportunistic and hospital-associated pathogens for which no licensed childhood vaccines exist. This paper asks how resources should be sequenced between single-pathogen interventions and platform investments as this transition proceeds. Methods We analyzed Global Burden of Disease Study 2023 deaths from 29 pathogens in ages 0-19 years by super-region, combined with WHO/UNICEF Estimates of National Immunization Coverage (WUENIC) for PCV3 and Hib3. We quantified the spectrum transition under two denominators (26- and 29-pathogen calibers), constructed a share-by-intervenability matrix assigning each pathogen to a dominant intervention channel (vaccine-reachable, mixed, platform-sensitive) under explicit classification rules, compared platform-sensitive deaths with a transparently computed scenario of residual vaccine-preventable deaths, and cross-classified pathogens by age tropism and poverty lock. We anchored platform interventions to verified published evidence. Results The vaccine-preventable group share fell from 54.0% to 40.2% while the opportunistic/hospital group rose from 18.1% to 23.1% (29-pathogen caliber, 1990-2023). Super-region vaccine coverage showed no significant association with pathogen-share change (PCV3 Spearman rho = 0.108, p = 0.818; Hib3 rho = -0.036, p = 0.939), a null result we report as evidence that simple coverage-burden correlations do not hold at the regional level, not as evidence against vaccine value. In 2023, vaccine-reachable pathogens accounted for 441,410 deaths (45.7%, channel including COVID-19), mixed for 126,926 (13.1%), and platform-sensitive pathogens for 396,995 (41.1%). Platform-sensitive deaths were 2.9-5.1 times the scenario estimate of residual vaccine-preventable deaths (52,435-77,512). Nine of 14 classifiable pathogens fell into the poverty-locked, infant-tropic cell (480,922 deaths; Fisher OR = 9.0, p = 0.1758). Conclusions The marginal value of single-pathogen strategies declines as the spectrum diversifies and residual deaths concentrate in platform-sensitive, poverty-locked, infant-tropic pathogens. Vaccine scale-up remains a certain and sizeable opportunity; the next increment of marginal resources should increasingly fund platform capabilities (oxygen systems, antimicrobial access and stewardship, infection prevention and control, referral, and nutrition) delivered as a package to the populations where the residual burden is locked.
items.abstract_zh: 背景 儿童肺炎死亡率的历史性下降在很大程度上由针对b型流感嗜血杆菌（Hib）和肺炎链球菌的单病原体疫苗驱动。然而，儿童肺炎死亡背后的病原谱正在多样化：病原体有效数从1990年的5.57上升到2023年的9.94，且剩余负担正转向尚无获批儿童疫苗的机会性和医院相关病原体。本文追问在这一转变推进过程中，资源应如何在单病原体干预与平台投资之间排序。方法 我们分析了2023年全球疾病负担研究中0-19岁、按超级区域划分的29种病原体所致死亡，并结合WHO/UNICEF PCV3和Hib3国家免疫覆盖率估计（WUENIC）。我们在两种分母（26种和29种病原体口径）下量化了病原谱转变，构建按可干预性划分的份额矩阵，在明确分类规则下将每种病原体归入主要干预渠道（疫苗可及、混合、平台敏感），将平台敏感死亡与透明计算的剩余疫苗可预防死亡情景进行比较，并按年龄趋向性和贫困锁定对病原体进行交叉分类。我们将平台干预锚定于经核实的已发表证据。结果 疫苗可预防组份额从54.0%降至40.2%，而机会性/医院相关组从18.1%升至23.1%（29种病原体口径，1990-2023年）。超级区域疫苗覆盖率与病原体份额变化无显著关联（PCV3 Spearman rho=0.108，p=0.818；Hib3 rho=-0.036，p=0.939），我们将这一零结果报告为简单覆盖率-负担相关性在区域层面不成立的证据，而非反对疫苗价值的证据。2023年，疫苗可及病原体占441,410例死亡（45.7%，该渠道包括COVID-19），混合渠道占126,926例（13.1%），平台敏感病原体占396,995例（41.1%）。平台敏感死亡是剩余疫苗可预防死亡情景估计值（52,435-77,512）的2.9-5.1倍。14种可分类病原体中有9种落入贫困锁定、婴儿趋向性单元格（480,922例死亡；Fisher OR=9.0，p=0.1758）。结论 随着病原谱多样化且剩余死亡集中于平台敏感、贫困锁定、婴儿趋向性病原体，单病原体策略的边际价值下降。疫苗扩大仍是一个确定且规模可观的机遇；下一增量边际资源应越来越多地资助平台能力（氧气系统、抗菌药物可及性与管理、感染预防与控制、转诊和营养），并作为一揽子措施提供给剩余负担被锁定的人群。

items.title_en: Machine-accelerated extraction of experimental superconducting parameters for physical insight and prediction across thousands of materials
items.title_zh: 机器加速提取实验超导参数：面向数千种材料的物理洞察与预测
items.abstract_en: New superconductors could unlock next-generation technologies from nuclear fusion to lossless electronics. Machine learning can predict candidate superconductors but lacks validated experimental training data beyond the critical temperature. Here we present AutoSuperCon, a database of eight superconducting parameters, containing 20354 entries for 6793 superconductors. The data were extracted from over 47000 arXiv preprints using a large language model and validated against reference datasets ($R^2 = 0.96$ with NIMS SuperCon). Using AutoSuperCon, we show that median gap ratios rise from 3.6 in conventional superconductors to 6.4 in cuprates, 28% of upper critical fields exceed the Pauli limit, and critical temperatures lie below a ceiling proportional to the superfluid density. Further, we train composition-based predictors for the critical temperature ($R^2_{\log}=0.83$) and the upper critical field ($R^2_{\log}=0.69$), boosted by transfer learning. Within known superconducting families, composition alone is sufficient to screen candidates for both parameters. AutoSuperCon thus enables physical insight and data-driven discovery across thousands of superconductors.
items.abstract_zh: 新型超导体可能解锁从核聚变到无损电子学的下一代技术。机器学习可以预测候选超导体，但除临界温度外缺乏经过验证的实验训练数据。在此，我们提出AutoSuperCon，一个包含八种超导参数的数据库，收录了6793种超导体的20354条记录。这些数据使用大语言模型从超过47000篇arXiv预印本中提取，并对照参考数据集进行了验证（与NIMS SuperCon的R^2=0.96）。利用AutoSuperCon，我们表明中位能隙比从传统超导体中的3.6上升到铜氧化物中的6.4，28%的上临界场超过泡利极限，且临界温度低于与超流密度成正比的上限。此外，我们训练了基于成分的预测器来预测临界温度（R^2_log=0.83）和上临界场（R^2_log=0.69），并通过迁移学习得到提升。在已知超导家族内，仅凭成分就足以筛选这两个参数的候选材料。因此，AutoSuperCon能够在数千种超导体中实现物理洞察和数据驱动发现。

items.title_en: HybridCT: ML Accelerated Tomography for Climate Relevant 3D Cloud Observations
items.title_zh: HybridCT：面向气候相关三维云观测的机器学习加速层析成像
items.abstract_en: Low-level clouds are one of the largest sources of uncertainty in climate predictions, partly because we lack detailed three-dimensional (3D) measurements of their internal structure. Here, we present HybridCT, a cloud tomographic reconstruction scheme accelerated by machine learning (ML) that recovers 3D cloud extinction directly from passive multi-angle observations. An ML emulator maps radiances from multiple viewing angles to cloud optical thickness (COT), producing path-integrated projections, and a Simultaneous Algebraic Reconstruction Technique (SART) explicitly inverts these projections to retrieve 3D extinction. Training observations are generated from synthetic 3D cloud fields using radiative transfer simulations for nine viewing angles between $\pm$70$^{\circ}$. HybridCT reconstructs extinction with RMSE 13.3 km$^{-1}$ in 3.5 s, compared to 22.7 km$^{-1}$ in approx. 30 min for the state-of-the-art physics-based tomography framework AT3D, a speedup exceeding 500$\times$. HybridCT thus provides a scalable route toward large-scale observations of 3D cloud structure relevant to radiative-budget interpretation and evaluation of high-resolution cloud simulations.
items.abstract_zh: 低云是气候预测中最大的不确定性来源之一，部分原因是我们缺乏对其内部结构的详细三维（3D）测量。在此，我们提出HybridCT，一种由机器学习（ML）加速的云层析重建方案，可直接从被动多角度观测中恢复三维云消光。ML模拟器将多个视角的辐射亮度映射为云光学厚度（COT），产生路径积分投影，而同时代数重建技术（SART）显式反演这些投影以获取三维消光。训练观测由合成三维云场通过辐射传输模拟生成，覆盖±70°之间的九个视角。HybridCT以3.5秒、RMSE 13.3 km^-1重建消光，而最先进的基于物理的层析框架AT3D约需30分钟、RMSE 22.7 km^-1，加速超过500倍。因此，HybridCT为大规模观测与辐射收支解释及高分辨率云模拟评估相关的三维云结构提供了一条可扩展路径。

items.title_en: A Time-Frequency-Condition Multimodal Fusion Foundation Model for Universal Rotating-Machinery Fault Diagnosis under Multi-Element Heterogeneous Scenarios
items.title_zh: 面向多要素异构场景下通用旋转机械故障诊断的时频-工况多模态融合基础模型
items.abstract_en: Intelligent fault diagnosis models are typically developed for a single machine under a specific set of operating conditions, such that each new machine or condition requires retraining from scratch. This one-machine-one-model paradigm scales poorly. Although transfer learning and domain generalization can reduce the labeling burden, they primarily seek domain-invariant commonality, potentially discarding machine-specific characteristics that are critical for diagnosis. This paper proposes TFC-MMFD, a time-frequency-condition multimodal fusion foundation model for rotating-machinery fault diagnosis under multi-element heterogeneous scenarios. Statistical indicators, time-frequency images, vibration sequences, and textual machine and condition descriptions are tokenized into a unified language-like space, allowing inputs of different physical origin to be represented as a single sequence. A LLaMA backbone, together with cross-modal bidirectional attention and a Q-Former, then distills this sequence into fault-mode queries. Diagnosis is performed by matching these queries against natural-language fault-mode anchors rather than fixed class indices, while regression-adversarial condition disentanglement and condition-conditioned masked pre-training improve robustness to changing conditions. Across four progressive tasks on ten public bearing datasets spanning diverse bearing types, speeds, and loads, TFC-MMFD attains 99.40% accuracy and 99.16% macro-F1, maintains over 80% accuracy on most interpolated unseen conditions without adaptation, and improves from 20.26% to 95.63% accuracy on an unseen machine with only five labeled samples per class. It outperforms the strongest of eight domain-generalization baselines by 10.57 percentage points and compares favorably with a recent bearing foundation model while using less than half of its fine-tuning data.
items.abstract_zh: 智能故障诊断模型通常针对特定工况下的单台机器开发，因此每台新机器或每种新工况都需要从头重新训练。这种一机一模型范式扩展性很差。尽管迁移学习和域泛化可以减轻标注负担，但它们主要寻求域不变共性，可能丢弃对诊断至关重要的机器特定特征。本文提出TFC-MMFD，一种面向多要素异构场景下旋转机械故障诊断的时频-工况多模态融合基础模型。统计指标、时频图像、振动序列以及文本化的机器和工况描述被标记化为统一的类语言空间，使不同物理来源的输入可表示为单一序列。LLaMA主干网络连同跨模态双向注意力和Q-Former，随后将该序列蒸馏为故障模式查询。诊断通过将这些查询与自然语言故障模式锚点匹配而不是固定类别索引来进行，而回归对抗工况解耦和工况条件掩码预训练提高了对变化工况的鲁棒性。在十个公开轴承数据集上跨越不同轴承类型、转速和负载的四个渐进任务中，TFC-MMFD达到99.40%准确率和99.16%宏F1，在大多数插值未见工况下无需适配仍保持超过80%的准确率，并在仅每类五个标注样本的未见机器上从20.26%提升到95.63%准确率。它比八个域泛化基线中最强者高出10.57个百分点，并与近期一个轴承基础模型相比具有优势，同时使用的微调数据不到其一半。

items.title_en: Adapting Monocular Depth Estimation in Novel Scenes through Disparity Refinement and Robot Ego-Motion
items.title_zh: 通过视差细化与机器人自运动在新场景中适配单目深度估计
items.abstract_en: The geometric understanding of a scene is a crucial component for safe and efficient robotic operations in novel and unstructured environments. The recent emergence of foundation models for Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) has provided an opportunity to enrich robotic perception capabilities with dense long-range depth predictions, replacing expensive onboard hardware (e.g., LiDARs and stereo cameras). However, these offline models are primarily trained on affine-invariant depth representations, and their generalization to novel scenes remains unclear. In this work we present EM-ViT, a monocular depth estimation model that learns to adapt online relative depth inputs from a foundation model prior to the metric scale with observations collected during robotic operations. Motivated by the stereo camera parameterization, our method decomposes depth prediction via dense disparity refinement to recover the scene's relative structure and an effective baseline scalar prediction to determine the missing metric scale. The learning process leverages sparse LiDAR points and, optionally, the robot's Ego-Motion (EM) to rapidly train a lightweight Vision Transformer (ViT), while an internal gradient matching loss preserves the fine-grained semantic structure of the input disparity in real-time. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method on publicly available sequences, such as KITTI, and show that our online learning pipeline can adapt to novel scenes faster and with higher accuracy than existing MDE foundation models. The code and supplementary materials will be publicly available at https://emvit-mde.github.io.
items.abstract_zh: 对场景的几何理解是机器人在新颖且非结构化环境中安全高效运行的关键组成部分。单目深度估计（MDE）基础模型的近期出现，为利用稠密长程深度预测丰富机器人感知能力提供了机会，从而替代昂贵的车载硬件（如LiDAR和立体相机）。然而，这些离线模型主要是在仿射不变深度表示上训练的，其对新场景的泛化能力仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们提出EM-ViT，一种单目深度估计模型，它学习利用机器人运行期间收集的观测，在线适配来自基础模型先验、处于度量尺度之前的相对深度输入。受立体相机参数化启发，我们的方法通过稠密视差细化恢复场景相对结构，并通过有效基线标量预测确定缺失的度量尺度，从而分解深度预测。学习过程利用稀疏LiDAR点，并可选地利用机器人自运动（EM）来快速训练轻量级视觉Transformer（ViT），同时内部梯度匹配损失实时保留输入视差的细粒度语义结构。我们在KITTI等公开可用序列上证明了该方法的有效性，并表明我们的在线学习流程比现有MDE基础模型更快、更准确地适应新场景。代码和补充材料将在https://emvit-mde.github.io公开提供。

items.title_en: Emergent Vision-Shaped Thinking in Text-Only Reasoning through Multimodal Training
items.title_zh: 通过多模态训练在纯文本推理中涌现的视觉形态思维
items.abstract_en: Does multimodal training shape how a language model thinks, even when the input is text only? We test this with targeted causal ablations across 10 multimodal configurations from 6 model families, with matched text-only backbones and cross-family transfer controls. We contrast spatial-imagery tasks that invite mental scene construction with symbol-manipulation tasks solvable by symbolic rules alone. We identify a vision-language axis in hidden-state space and ablate its projection at inference. In Chameleon-7B, this ablation drops accuracy on BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) navigate by 27.6 pp while leaving boolean expressions intact (+5.6 pp), a 33.2 pp double dissociation. The effect is direction-specific and layer-localized, extends to mental-simulation tasks such as mental rotation, paper folding, and perspective taking, and is not explained by task difficulty, reasoning depth, or sequential update load. Together, these results reveal emergent vision-shaped thinking (EVT): text-only reasoning that causally recruits representations introduced or strengthened by vision-language training, without assuming an image-like internal format. The measured effect is spatially concentrated at 7-8B and broadens to non-spatial visual attribute binding in the tested 32B configuration. In dual-path unified models (BAGEL, Janus-Pro), the causal handle localizes to the generation pathway as a compact one-dimensional carrier. The understanding pathway also encodes spatial information in a higher-rank, probe-decodable form, but is not the causal handle. To separate decodability from causal use, we analyze concentration, alignment, and semantic location. These diagnostics explain why behavior, probing, and intervention can diverge. Multimodal training thus reshapes the geometry of text-only reasoning, not just how visual input is processed.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态训练是否会塑造语言模型的思考方式，即使输入仅为文本？我们通过对来自6个模型家族的10种多模态配置进行有针对性的因果消融，并设置匹配的纯文本骨干和跨家族迁移对照来检验这一点。我们将邀请心理场景构建的空间意象任务与仅靠符号规则即可解决的符号操作任务进行对比。我们在隐藏状态空间中识别出一个视觉-语言轴，并在推理时消融其投影。在Chameleon-7B中，该消融使BIG-Bench Hard（BBH）navigate的准确率下降27.6个百分点，而布尔表达式保持不变（+5.6个百分点），形成33.2个百分点的双重分离。该效应具有方向特异性和层局部性，并扩展到心理旋转、折纸和视角采择等心理模拟任务，且不能用任务难度、推理深度或序列更新负载来解释。总之，这些结果揭示了涌现性视觉形态思维（EVT）：纯文本推理因果性地调用由视觉-语言训练引入或强化的表征，而不假设其具有类图像的内部格式。测得的效应在7–8B规模上空间集中，并在测试的32B配置中扩展到非空间视觉属性绑定。在双路径统一模型（BAGEL、Janus-Pro）中，因果控制点定位到生成路径，表现为紧凑的一维载体。理解路径也以更高秩、可由探针解码的形式编码空间信息，但不是因果控制点。为了将可解码性与因果使用区分开，我们分析了集中度、对齐和语义位置。这些诊断解释了行为、探测和干预为何可能分离。因此，多模态训练重塑了纯文本推理的几何结构，而不仅仅是处理视觉输入的方式。

items.title_en: Multi-Ancestry Rare and Low-Frequency Variant Analysis Reveals Novel and Convergent Biological Pathways for Cannabis Use Disorder
items.title_zh: 多祖先罕见和低频变异分析揭示大麻使用障碍的新颖且趋同的生物通路
items.abstract_en: Large disparities in Cannabis Use Disorder (CUD) prevalence exist across U.S ethnic groups, yet genetic research has disproportionately focused on individuals of European descent. This study investigated the genetic architecture of CUD severity across three populations--American Indians, Mexican Americans, and European Americans--focusing on rare and low-frequency variants (minor allele frequency < 5%). CUD severity was measured using a validated composite of 20 cannabis-related life events, enhancing phenotypic resolution and power. In American Indians, ten genome-wide significant common variants were identified. Analyses of rare and low-frequency functional variants revealed novel, convergent biological pathways across ancestries. Notably, the arylsulfatases activation pathway was significantly associated with CUD severity in Mexican Americans and supported in American Indians, implicating sulfated lipids such as sphingolipids in CUD neurobiology. Related, in European Americans, the heparan sulfate degradation pathway--central to synaptic remodeling and extracellular matrix regulation--showed significant negative association with CUD severity. The integrin beta-1 cell surface interaction pathway, critical for neuronal adhesion and signaling, was uniquely enriched in Mexican Americans. Immune-related pathways, including shared involvement of a p38-gamma/delta MAPK signaling cascade, were supported across multiple cohorts. These findings highlight both ancestry-specific and shared mechanisms contributing to CUD severity, emphasizing the biological complexity of addiction. Importantly, these pathways represent potential therapeutic targets, suggesting that modulation of sulfated lipid metabolism and extracellular matrix remodeling may offer novel strategies for intervention. By integrating multi-ethnic cohorts and rare variant analyses, this study identifies underappreciated genetic contributors to CUD and underscores the importance of population-informed addiction genetics research.
items.abstract_zh: 大麻使用障碍（CUD）患病率在美国不同族裔群体之间存在巨大差异，然而遗传研究不成比例地集中于欧洲血统个体。本研究考察了三个群体——美洲印第安人、墨西哥裔美国人和欧洲裔美国人——中CUD严重程度的遗传结构，重点关注罕见和低频变异（次要等位基因频率<5%）。CUD严重程度使用由20个与大麻相关的生活事件组成的经验证复合指标测量，从而提高了表型分辨率和统计功效。在美洲印第安人中，鉴定出十个全基因组显著常见变异。对罕见和低频功能变异的分析揭示了跨祖先的新颖且趋同的生物通路。值得注意的是，芳基硫酸酯酶激活通路在墨西哥裔美国人中与CUD严重程度显著相关，并在美洲印第安人中得到支持，提示硫酸化脂质（如鞘脂）参与CUD神经生物学。相关地，在欧洲裔美国人中，对突触重塑和细胞外基质调控至关重要的硫酸乙酰肝素降解通路与CUD严重程度呈显著负相关。对神经元黏附和信号传导至关重要的整合素β-1细胞表面相互作用通路在墨西哥裔美国人中独特富集。免疫相关通路，包括共同涉及的p38-γ/δ MAPK信号级联，在多个队列中得到支持。这些发现突出了促成CUD严重程度的祖先特异性和共享机制，强调了成瘾的生物学复杂性。重要的是，这些通路代表潜在治疗靶点，表明调节硫酸化脂质代谢和细胞外基质重塑可能提供新的干预策略。通过整合多种族队列和罕见变异分析，本研究识别出未被充分认识的CUD遗传贡献因素，并强调基于人群的成瘾遗传学研究的重要性。

items.title_en: Effect of Gas Pressure and Molecular Structure in the Spatial-Mode Conversion of Terahertz Radiation from a Plasma Filament
items.title_zh: 气体压力和分子结构对等离子体细丝太赫兹辐射空间模式转换的影响
items.abstract_en: In this work, the generation of terahertz (THz) radiation under single color filamentation of a femtosecond laser pulse in an optical cell with compressed gases (argon, nitrogen, CO2) in broad pressure range from 0.001 to 25 atm is experimentally studied for the first time. A nonmonotonic dependence of the integral energy of the THz signal on the gas pressure is revealed, which can be attributed to the competition between an increase in the plasma density and the development of plasma selfabsorption processes, multiple filamentation of the femtosecond pump, and collision induced absorption in the neutral medium. We show that the molecular structure of the gas critically determines the pressure optimum of generation, shifting the maximum of the THz energy yield to the region of elevated pressures (from 10 to 15 atm) for monatomic argon and to the region of subatmospheric pressures (approx. 0.1 atm) for molecular carbon dioxide due to strong vibrational rotational dissipation. On the basis of numerical 3D modeling, it is shown that the cylindrical metal waveguide insert used for signal collection operates in a strongly multimode regime and substantially transforms the angular spectrum of the THz source. We demonstrate that the conical structure of the THz radiation recorded in the experiment is a consequence of intermode interference and diffraction at the output end face of the waveguide, which transforms the true parameters of THz generation in the plasma channel.
items.abstract_zh: 本工作首次在0.001至25 atm的宽压力范围内，实验研究了飞秒激光脉冲在充有压缩气体（氩气、氮气、CO2）的光学池中单色成丝时太赫兹（THz）辐射的产生。揭示了THz信号积分能量对气压的非单调依赖关系，这可归因于等离子体密度增加与等离子体自吸收过程发展、飞秒泵浦的多重成丝以及中性介质中的碰撞诱导吸收之间的竞争。我们表明，气体的分子结构关键性地决定产生的压力最优值：由于强烈的振动-转动耗散，单原子氩气将THz能量产额最大值移至高压区（10至15 atm），而分子CO2则移至亚大气压区（约0.1 atm）。基于数值三维建模，表明用于信号收集的圆柱形金属波导插件在强多模状态下工作，并大幅改变THz源的角谱。我们证明，实验中记录的THz辐射的锥形结构是模式间干涉和波导输出端面衍射的结果，这会改变等离子体通道中THz产生的真实参数。

items.title_en: A Mechanistic Interpretability Study of an Astronomy Foundation Model
items.title_zh: 一个天文学基础模型的机制可解释性研究
items.abstract_en: Foundation models are increasingly used across the sciences, but whether their internal computations correspond to known scientific operations or proceed through different mechanisms remains unclear. Understanding these mechanisms is essential for assessing reliability, identifying failure modes, and learning new science from the models. We present, to our knowledge, the first causal mechanistic interpretability study of an astronomy foundation model, AION-1, focusing on its multimodal advantage in redshift prediction, where combining imaging with photometry outperforms photometry alone. We find that this advantage is largest for spatially extended and dust-attenuated galaxies, and that most of it is localized to the first of the encoder's twelve blocks. Within that block, how well a property is linearly decodable does not predict whether it can be localized. Spatial extent is causally used, and one attention head dominates linear probing for it, yet ablating that head has negligible effect on redshift prediction: the information is distributed across heads and is decodable again one layer after we erase it. Dust attenuation shows the opposite pattern: it is only weakly decodable anywhere in the encoder, yet a single head is necessary for most of the multimodal advantage, particularly for the most dust-attenuated galaxies, and keeping that head as the only active head in its block preserves nearly all of the advantage. None of the astrophysically motivated operations we tested explains what this head computes. Whether this reflects a limitation of current interpretability methods or a computation that does not correspond to any known astrophysical operation remains open, and resolving it is a prerequisite for using interpretability as a tool for scientific discovery.
items.abstract_zh: 基础模型越来越多地用于各科学领域，但其内部计算是否对应于已知科学操作，还是通过不同机制进行，仍不清楚。理解这些机制对于评估可靠性、识别失效模式以及从模型中学习新科学至关重要。据我们所知，我们提出了首个针对天文学基础模型AION-1的因果机制可解释性研究，聚焦其在红移预测中的多模态优势，即结合成像与测光优于仅使用测光。我们发现，这种优势对空间延展和尘埃衰减的星系最大，且其中大部分定位于编码器十二个模块中的第一个模块。在该模块内，一个属性的线性可解码程度并不能预测其是否可被定位。空间延展被因果性地使用，且一个注意力头在其线性探测中占主导，然而消融该头对红移预测的影响可忽略：信息分布在多个头中，并且在我们将其擦除后的一层中又可被解码。尘埃衰减表现出相反模式：它在编码器任何位置都仅能被弱解码，然而单个头对大部分多模态优势是必要的，尤其是对尘埃衰减最严重的星系；并且将该头保留为其模块中唯一活跃的头，几乎保留了全部优势。我们测试的基于天体物理动机的操作均不能解释该头计算什么。这反映的是当前可解释性方法的局限，还是一种不对应任何已知天体物理操作的计算，仍待解决；而解决这一问题是将可解释性用作科学发现工具的前提。

items.title_en: An LLM Is All You Need: Data-Efficient Adaptation to Full-Duplex, Word-Level Spoken Dialogue
items.title_zh: 一个LLM就够了：面向全双工、词级口语对话的数据高效适配
items.abstract_en: Full-duplex spoken dialogue, in which a system listens while it speaks and can backchannel, yield the floor, and be interrupted, is usually obtained by training on hundreds of thousands to millions of hours of speech. This is costly, rewrites the language model that supplies the system's knowledge, and still leaves turn-taking either implicit or decided coarsely rather than word by word. We show that a frozen, general-purpose multimodal LLM can instead be adapted into a word-level full-duplex system with little data. Our system is a thinker-talker cascade on an 80 ms frame clock. The thinker keeps the LLM frozen and trains only lightweight adapters and a few new token embeddings (97M parameters); at every frame it emits one token of agent text, with pauses, yields, and onsets represented as tokens of the same vocabulary and kept legal by a finite-state machine. A four-stage curriculum, each stage anchored to the model's own behavior under the previous format, performs the conversion in about 30 GPU-hours. The talker reads only the thinker's discrete tokens, so the two halves are trained independently. On Full-Duplex-Bench and InteractionBench, the system is competitive with open-source full-duplex systems built through large-scale speech training: among them, it is the least likely to take the floor when the user merely pauses, backchannels most often, and leads in spoken-task accuracy, groundedness, and coherence over long conversations.
items.abstract_zh: 全双工口语对话——系统在说话的同时聆听，并能够反馈、让出话轮和被中断——通常通过在数十万到数百万小时语音上训练来获得。这成本高昂，会重写提供系统知识的语言模型，并且仍然使话轮转换要么是隐式的，要么是粗略决定的，而非逐词决定。我们表明，一个冻结的通用多模态LLM反而可以用少量数据适配为词级全双工系统。我们的系统是在80 ms帧时钟上的思考者-说话者级联。思考者保持LLM冻结，仅训练轻量适配器和少量新词元嵌入（9700万参数）；在每一帧，它输出一个智能体文本词元，其中停顿、让出和起始被表示为同一词表中的词元，并由有限状态机保持合法。四阶段课程中，每个阶段都以模型在前一格式下的自身行为为锚点，在约30 GPU小时内完成转换。说话者只读取思考者的离散词元，因此两半独立训练。在Full-Duplex-Bench和InteractionBench上，该系统与通过大规模语音训练构建的开源全双工系统相比具有竞争力：在它们之中，当用户仅仅停顿时，它最不可能抢占话轮，最常进行反馈，并在口语任务准确率、有据性和长对话连贯性方面领先。

items.title_en: CT-SGAL-LIO: Causal Continuous Time Refinement of Discrete LiDAR Inertial Odometry
items.title_zh: CT-SGAL-LIO：离散LiDAR惯性里程计的因果连续时间细化
items.abstract_en: State-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial odometry methods, including those on richer state manifolds, achieve strong global accuracy, yet their pose stream alternates between propagation and correction and can oscillate over short horizons even when globally accurate. Most existing methods follow these approaches: they either modify the filter to enable faster updates or estimate a continuous-time trajectory from raw LiDAR and inertial data. The latter involves extra optimization, delaying state updates and becoming less robust during rapid rotations or accelerations. We propose CT-SGAL-LIO, a continuous-time refinement module that smooths the posterior pose stream of a discrete SGal(3) estimator without modifying the estimator itself. The key novelty is to perform continuous-time trajectory refinement directly on the projected SGal(3) posterior: we fit a cubic trajectory over a bounded window of recent poses and evaluate it at a small fixed lag. This places the query time within the observed interval, so the refined pose is obtained by interpolation rather than extrapolation, while preserving causal operation. CT-SGAL-LIO improves relative trajectory accuracy on 17 sequences from three public benchmarks. Across 17 sequences from GRAND-TOUR, MCD, and GEODE, CT-SGAL-LIO improves short-term motion accuracy while largely preserving global accuracy. RTE improves by up to 70% on GRAND-TOUR and on all seven GEODE sequences, with 9.9-51.1% reductions. A 19.5-min R-Campus run also reduces posterior jumps by 85.4% with only a 4.7 mm change in the end-to-start gap. We plan to release our source code and results to support community validation and reproducibility.
items.abstract_zh: 最先进的LiDAR-惯性里程计方法，包括那些在更丰富状态流形上的方法，实现了很强的全局精度，但其位姿流在传播和校正之间交替，并且即使全局准确，也可能在短时间范围内振荡。大多数现有方法遵循这些途径：要么修改滤波器以实现更快更新，要么从原始LiDAR和惯性数据估计连续时间轨迹。后者涉及额外优化，延迟状态更新，并在快速旋转或加速时变得不那么稳健。我们提出CT-SGAL-LIO，一个连续时间细化模块，可在不修改估计器本身的情况下平滑离散SGal(3)估计器的后验位姿流。关键创新是直接在投影后的SGal(3)后验上执行连续时间轨迹细化：我们在最近位姿的有界窗口上拟合三次轨迹，并在小的固定滞后处对其进行求值。这将查询时间置于观测区间内，因此细化后的位姿通过插值而非外推获得，同时保持因果操作。CT-SGAL-LIO提高了来自三个公开基准的17个序列上的相对轨迹精度。在来自GRAND-TOUR、MCD和GEODE的17个序列上，CT-SGAL-LIO提高了短期运动精度，同时基本保持全局精度。RTE在GRAND-TOUR和全部七个GEODE序列上最高提升70%，降幅为9.9–51.1%。一次19.5分钟的R-Campus运行还将后验跳变减少了85.4%，而终点到起点间隙仅变化4.7 mm。我们计划发布源代码和结果，以支持社区验证和可复现性。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.
