items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为神经辐射场用于视图合成
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入为单个连续5D坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出为该空间位置处的体积密度和与视角相关的发射辐射。我们通过沿相机光线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Systematic Benchmarking and Optimization of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for Clinical Phenotyping: A Type II Diabetes Case Study in an ICD-Screened Cohort
items.title_zh: 面向临床表型分析的检索增强生成（RAG）的系统性基准评估与优化：一项在ICD筛选队列中的2型糖尿病病例研究
items.abstract_en: Traditional EHR phenotyping methods can require substantial disease-specific development and long-term maintenance. While integrating large language models (LLMs) with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is promising, the impact of RAG configurations remains underexplored. We systematically evaluated these design choices for type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) phenotyping in an ICD-screened cohort. Using GPT-4o, we processed 170,678 clinical notes from 275 patients. We evaluated seven embedding models and three prompt strategies (baseline, improved zero-shot, and few-shot). Using the improved zero-shot prompt, we tested 350 embedding model-chunk size-retrieval depth combinations on the training set and selected eight optimized configurations for test-set evaluation. Combined with three prompts, these yielded 24 prompt-configuration combinations for comparison with ICD codes and the institutional PheNorm method. RAG achieved a mean sensitivity of 0.9019 (95% CI: 0.8866-0.9172), specificity of 0.7907 (0.7749-0.8066), PPV of 0.9405 (0.9365-0.9445), NPV of 0.6967 (0.6653-0.7281), and F1-score of 0.9204 (0.9124-0.9283). All combinations achieved higher PPV than ICD codes (0.7838). Compared with PheNorm, sensitivity was significantly higher (Holm-adjusted p < 0.001), while specificity differences were not significant. Paired bootstrap analyses showed higher NPV and F1-score , with no significant PPV difference. General-purpose embeddings showed higher sensitivity, whereas biomedical embeddings exhibited higher specificity and PPV. Few-shot prompting increased specificity and PPV but reduced sensitivity. Token usage varied substantially across embedding models. These findings suggest the importance of aligning RAG design with task-specific clinical priorities and token efficiency.
items.abstract_zh: 传统EHR表型分析方法可能需要大量疾病特异性开发和长期维护。将大语言模型（LLM）与检索增强生成（RAG）集成具有前景，但RAG配置的影响仍未充分探索。我们在一个ICD筛选队列中系统评估了这些设计选择用于2型糖尿病（T2DM）表型分析。使用GPT-4o，我们处理了来自275名患者的170,678份临床记录。我们评估了七种嵌入模型和三种提示策略（基线、改进的零样本和少样本）。使用改进的零样本提示，我们在训练集上测试了350种嵌入模型-块大小-检索深度组合，并选择八种优化配置用于测试集评估。结合三种提示，这些产生了24种提示-配置组合，用于与ICD编码和机构PheNorm方法比较。RAG达到平均灵敏度0.9019（95% CI：0.8866-0.9172）、特异度0.7907（0.7749-0.8066）、PPV 0.9405（0.9365-0.9445）、NPV 0.6967（0.6653-0.7281）和F1分数0.9204（0.9124-0.9283）。所有组合的PPV均高于ICD编码（0.7838）。与PheNorm相比，灵敏度显著更高（Holm校正p < 0.001），而特异度差异不显著。配对bootstrap分析显示NPV和F1分数更高，PPV差异不显著。通用嵌入显示更高灵敏度，而生物医学嵌入表现出更高特异度和PPV。少样本提示提高了特异度和PPV，但降低了灵敏度。不同嵌入模型的token使用量差异很大。这些发现表明，使RAG设计与任务特定临床优先级和token效率保持一致的重要性。

items.title_en: AI-assisted search for self-compressing gigawatt subcycle field waveforms
items.title_zh: AI辅助搜索自压缩吉瓦级亚周期场波形
items.abstract_en: We explore the physics behind pulse self-compression to high-power subcycle field waveforms and search for the optimal regimes of such compression over the parameter space as laid out by multimode nonlinear dynamics of ultrashort laser pulses in gas-filled hollow fibers. With the pertinent physical criteria for pulse contrast and no pulse breakup formalized as operational stopping rules, a radical speedup of such search is achieved by delegating its tedious preliminary stages to generative pretrained transformer models. The precise adjustment of self-compression dynamics vis-a-vis the desired compressed pulse output is, however, not yet delegable to AI agents, as the criteria for such search are still largely subjective, operating with fine aspects of subcycle field structure, not yet formalizable as clear search-stopping instructions. An ultimate precision in such subcycle field engineering is attainable via a management of field-phase-sensitive nonlinear processes, enabling pulse self-compression to high-power subcycle field waveforms and opening paths toward fiber-optic attosecond lightwave engineering.
items.abstract_zh: 我们探索脉冲自压缩到高功率亚周期场波形背后的物理机制，并在充气空心光纤中超短激光脉冲的多模非线性动力学所给出的参数空间内，搜索此类压缩的最佳区间。将脉冲对比度和无脉冲分裂的相关物理判据形式化为可操作的停止规则后，通过将此类搜索中繁琐的初步阶段委托给生成式预训练Transformer模型，实现了搜索的大幅加速。然而，针对所需压缩脉冲输出对自压缩动力学的精确调整尚不能委托给AI智能体，因为此类搜索的判据在很大程度上仍是主观的，涉及亚周期场结构的精细方面，尚不能形式化为明确的搜索停止指令。通过管理场相位敏感的非线性过程，可以实现此类亚周期场工程的最终精度，使脉冲自压缩到高功率亚周期场波形，并开辟通向光纤阿秒光波工程的道路。

items.title_en: Imputing Missing Near-Surface Air Temperature using Graph Attention Networks with Distance-Aware Edge Features
items.title_zh: 使用具有距离感知边特征的图注意力网络插补缺失的近地表气温
items.abstract_en: We introduce a graph attention network for reconstructing near-surface air temperature fields from incomplete observations. The model represents each grid cell as a node connected to its $k$ nearest neighbors, with attention weights that depend on node features, distance, and land-ocean transitions. This graph representation avoids the polar distortions associated with treating the globe as a flat latitude-longitude image, as most deep learning reconstruction methods do. This is particularly relevant for historical temperature records, which extend back to the mid-nineteenth century but remain incomplete, with the largest gaps early in the record and at high latitudes. We train our model on CMIP6 CESM2 historical simulations masked with the time-varying HadCRUT5 observational coverage from 1850 to 2014. We then compare our approach with ordinary kriging, GraphEM, and the LaMa inpainting network on a held-out realization. The graph model achieves the lowest spatial RMSE (0.997 K), 10.1% lower than LaMa and approximately 31% lower than kriging and GraphEM. The largest gains occur in the Arctic and Antarctic, while LaMa remains slightly more accurate in the densely observed tropics. The graph model's error also falls faster as coverage increases, so its advantage over LaMa grows by more than a third from the 1850s to the 2000s. An ablation study shows that the model's skill comes mainly from the geometric graph construction rather than from auxiliary physical covariates.
items.abstract_zh: 我们引入一种图注意力网络，用于从不完整观测中重建近地表气温场。该模型将每个网格单元表示为与 $k$ 个最近邻相连的节点，注意力权重取决于节点特征、距离和海陆过渡。这种图表示避免了将地球视为平坦经纬度图像（大多数深度学习重建方法所做的那样）所带来的极地畸变。这与历史温度记录尤其相关，这些记录可追溯到19世纪中叶但仍不完整，最大缺口出现在记录早期和高纬度地区。我们在CMIP6 CESM2历史模拟上训练模型，该模拟用1850年至2014年随时间变化的HadCRUT5观测覆盖进行掩膜。然后，我们在一个留出实现上将我们的方法与普通克里金、GraphEM和LaMa修复网络进行比较。图模型实现了最低的空间RMSE（0.997 K），比LaMa低10.1%，比克里金和GraphEM低约31%。最大增益出现在北极和南极，而LaMa在观测密集的热带地区仍略更准确。随着覆盖增加，图模型的误差下降也更快，因此其相对于LaMa的优势从1850年代到2000年代增长超过三分之一。消融研究表明，该模型的技能主要来自几何图构建，而非辅助物理协变量。

items.title_en: Disentangling Spurious Correlations: How IRM Handles Diverse Shortcuts in Text Classification
items.title_zh: 解耦虚假相关：IRM如何处理文本分类中的多种捷径
items.abstract_en: In NLP, models trained via Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) often exploit spurious correlations, such as dialectal markers, at the expense of robust linguistic features, thereby degrading their out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. Invariant Risk Minimization (IRM) aims to suppress such shortcuts by identifying predictive relationships that remain stable across environments, but its practical utility for NLP remains debated. We use a causality-driven framework to evaluate IRM under three shortcut-generating mechanisms: label-generated features, confounding, and selection bias. Our results show that IRM successfully rejects shortcuts across the evaluated causal and anti-causal structures, including under limited environmental variation and increasing label noise. We then extend our analysis beyond controlled synthetic artifacts to two less constrained settings: gender-profession associations in Bias in Bios and semantically loaded actor-name shortcuts in ActorCorr. These experiments show that invariant learning can mitigate more realistic textual shortcuts, while semantically meaningful features require careful calibration of the invariance penalty.
items.abstract_zh: 在NLP中，通过经验风险最小化（ERM）训练的模型常常利用虚假相关（例如方言标记），而牺牲稳健的语言特征，从而降低其分布外（OOD）泛化能力。不变风险最小化（IRM）旨在通过识别跨环境保持稳定的预测关系来抑制此类捷径，但其在NLP中的实际效用仍存争议。我们使用因果驱动框架，在三种产生捷径的机制下评估IRM：标签生成特征、混杂和选择偏差。我们的结果表明，IRM在所评估的因果和反因果结构中成功拒绝捷径，包括在有限环境变化和标签噪声增加的情况下。然后，我们将分析扩展到受控合成伪影之外的两个约束较少的设置：Bias in Bios中的性别-职业关联，以及ActorCorr中语义负载的演员姓名捷径。这些实验表明，不变学习可以缓解更现实的文本捷径，而语义有意义的特征需要对不变性惩罚进行仔细校准。

items.title_en: What Can a VLA Learn from the Agent That Calls It? Task-Level Experience Distillation for Embodied Navigation
items.title_zh: VLA能从调用它的智能体中学到什么？面向具身导航的任务级经验蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Navigation agents use a large language model (LLM) planner to call a vision-language-action (VLA) model. Each episode needs the LLM, adding cost and delay. We distill successful agent experience into the VLA instead of distilling the planner. The VLA then navigates alone at test time. Agent sessions are not VLA demonstrations. They include motions driven by planner tools and sub-instructions, along with detours. We present H2E, a task-level experience distillation method that converts these sessions into VLA training data. Every motion becomes a VLA action under the original task instruction, with the resulting poses as targets. H2E masks the loss on steps that move away from the goal. It labels every visited state within 1 m of the goal as a stop. We then update the VLA with low-rank adaptation. The VLA learns to stop at the goal and find goals the base model never reaches. On all 3,189 REVERIE-CE val-unseen episodes, H2E raises the success rate of an 8B VLA from 35.0% to 44.9%.
items.abstract_zh: 导航智能体使用大语言模型（LLM）规划器调用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。每个回合都需要LLM，增加了成本和延迟。我们将成功的智能体经验蒸馏到VLA中，而不是蒸馏规划器。于是VLA在测试时单独导航。智能体会话不是VLA演示。它们包括由规划器工具和子指令驱动的运动，以及绕路。我们提出H2E，一种任务级经验蒸馏方法，将这些会话转换为VLA训练数据。每个运动在原始任务指令下成为VLA动作，并以结果位姿作为目标。H2E对远离目标的步骤掩蔽损失。它将目标1米内每个访问过的状态标记为停止。然后我们使用低秩适应更新VLA。VLA学会在目标处停止，并找到基础模型从未到达的目标。在所有3,189个REVERIE-CE val-unseen回合上，H2E将8B VLA的成功率从35.0%提高到44.9%。

items.title_en: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
items.title_zh: Duo：一种用于全双工交互的互惠世界模型
items.abstract_en: In this report, we introduce the Reciprocal World Model (RWM) and present Duo v1, a full-duplex world model that continuously perceives audiovisual inputs while responding to users in real time. The RWM treats intelligence and physical reality as equally fundamental to what constitutes a world. Existing world models largely focus on simulating the latter, leaving reasoning and decision-making as external controls rather than intrinsic parts of the world itself. In RWM, we identify two equally fundamental capabilities: Intent, which provides the cognition underlying world interactions, and Realization, which generates coherent audio-visual behavior. To realize this formulation, Duo v1 introduces three key technical designs: (1) Leveraging autoregressive modeling for continuous interaction reasoning and participation decisions, rather than restricting it to instruction understanding for diffusion models. (2) Constructing chunk-specific conditions and synchronize tokens across Intent and Realization on a unified timeline. Module-specific attention masks enforce causal dependencies both within and across chunks, preventing access to future inputs. (3) Mitigating distribution shift in both modules through dual rollout distillation, training on autoregressively generated Intent tokens and synthesized audiovisual histories from Realization. Both modules continuously perceive real-time audio, video, and text, enabling full-duplex interaction with spontaneous conversations and interruptions. Beyond conversation, users can share real objects, reshape virtual scenes, guide assistants, or play audiovisual games without mouse or keyboard controls. The release of Duo v1 makes our first step, with the next version coming soon. We look forward to broader exploration of this emerging field.
items.abstract_zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍互惠世界模型（RWM），并提出Duo v1——一个在实时回应用户的同时持续感知视听输入的全双工世界模型。RWM将智能与物理现实视为构成世界的同等基本要素。现有世界模型主要侧重于模拟后者，将推理和决策留作外部控制，而非世界本身的内在组成部分。在RWM中，我们确定了两项同等基本的能力：Intent，它提供世界交互背后的认知；Realization，它生成连贯的视听行为。为实现这一表述，Duo v1引入了三项关键技术设计：（1）利用自回归建模进行连续交互推理和参与决策，而不是将其限制为扩散模型的指令理解。（2）构建块特定条件，并在统一时间线上同步Intent与Realization的token。模块特定注意力掩码在块内和块间强制因果依赖，防止访问未来输入。（3）通过双 rollout 蒸馏缓解两个模块中的分布偏移，在自回归生成的Intent token和由Realization合成的视听历史数据上训练。两个模块持续感知实时音频、视频和文本，实现具有自发对话和打断的全双工交互。除对话外，用户还可以共享真实物体、重塑虚拟场景、引导助手或玩视听游戏，无需鼠标或键盘控制。Duo v1的发布迈出了我们的第一步，下一版本即将推出。我们期待对这一新兴领域进行更广泛的探索。

items.title_en: Pigmentation markers enable efficient co-CRISPR selection in the pantry moth Plodia interpunctella
items.title_zh: 色素标记可在印度谷螟 Plodia interpunctella 中实现高效的 co-CRISPR 选择
items.abstract_en: CRISPR co-targeting (co-CRISPR) of pigment genes facilitates the identification and recovery of genome-edited individuals in model organisms. Using Plodia interpunctella, an emerging lepidopteran model, we characterized mutant phenotypes of eight genes involved in the melanin and ommochrome biosynthesis pathways (black, ebony, yellow, tan, vermilion, kynurenine 3-monooxygenase/cinnabar (kmo/cn), scarlet, and white) to evaluate their suitability as co-CRISPR markers. Disruption of black, ebony, and yellow altered larval sclerite, pupal cuticle, and adult wing coloration. All four ommochrome pathway genes studied contributed to larval cuticle and adult eye pigmentation, whereas only vermilion and kmo/cn disruption produced visible phenotypes in the adult wings. Sequencing revealed low apparent mosaicism in some yellow and tan G0 individuals, along with recurrent deletions at the yellow and tan target sites consistent with possible microhomology-mediated end joining repair. Using white or scarlet as co-CRISPR selection markers, we identified G0 individuals carrying a secondary mutation in the yellow gene with a positive predictive value of 100% by scoring its knockout phenotype. Extending this approach to six meiosis-related genes without visibly scorable phenotypes, selection based on the white mutant phenotype identified sequence-confirmed mutations at the corresponding gene-of-interest in 191 of 206 G0 individuals (93%). Together, these findings establish white and scarlet as effective co-CRISPR selection markers and provide a practical strategy for facilitating functional genetic studies in Plodia.
items.abstract_zh: CRISPR共靶向（co-CRISPR）色素基因有助于在模式生物中识别和获得基因组编辑个体。以新兴鳞翅目模式生物印度谷螟为材料，我们表征了参与黑色素和眼色素生物合成途径的八个基因（black、ebony、yellow、tan、vermilion、kynurenine 3-monooxygenase/cinnabar（kmo/cn）、scarlet和white）的突变表型，以评估其作为co-CRISPR标记的适用性。敲除black、ebony和yellow改变了幼虫骨片、蛹表皮和成虫翅着色。所研究的四个眼色素途径基因均参与幼虫表皮和成虫眼色素沉着，而只有vermilion和kmo/cn敲除在成虫翅膀中产生可见表型。测序显示，在一些yellow和tan的G0个体中明显嵌合率较低，同时在yellow和tan靶位点出现反复缺失，符合可能的微同源介导末端连接修复。使用white或scarlet作为co-CRISPR选择标记，我们通过评分其敲除表型，鉴定出携带yellow基因二次突变的G0个体，阳性预测值为100%。将该方法扩展到六个无可肉眼评分表型的减数分裂相关基因，基于white突变表型的选择在206个G0个体中的191个（93%）中鉴定出对应目标基因的序列确认突变。总之，这些发现确立了white和scarlet作为有效的co-CRISPR选择标记，并提供了一种促进Plodia功能遗传学研究的实用策略。

items.title_en: Traces of Vacuum Squeezing: A Superconducting Transmission-Line Analogue of Cosmological Particle Creation
items.title_zh: 真空压缩的痕迹：宇宙学粒子产生的超导传输线模拟
items.abstract_en: Particle creation in time-dependent quantum fields is a central phenomenon in early-universe cosmology, yet it remains experimentally inaccessible in its original context. We show theoretically that superconducting circuits based on a waveguide-like transmission line loaded with dc-SQUIDs can provide a direct analogue of a scalar field in a radiation-dominated Friedmann--Robertson--Walker universe in conformal time. The mode equation of the circuit reduces to the Weber equation, the same equation governing cosmological particle creation in a radiation-dominated background, admitting an exact solution in terms of parabolic cylinder functions and an exponentially suppressed particle spectrum. We analyse the conditions under which the analogy holds, which require a compromise between the duration of the pulse, the uniformity of the modulation and the symmetry of the SQUIDs, and show that dissipation does not erase the cosmological signal. We use the anomalous moment of each mode as a witness of the Bogoliubov mixing: it vanishes for any thermal state and survives dissipation, and, together with the photon number, it certifies squeezing, and with the purity of the state, it identifies whether the pairs created from the vacuum dominate.
items.abstract_zh: 时间依赖量子场中的粒子产生是早期宇宙宇宙学的核心现象，但在其原始背景下仍无法通过实验实现。我们从理论上证明，基于加载直流SQUID的类波导传输线的超导电路，可以在共形时间中直接模拟辐射主导的Friedmann--Robertson--Walker宇宙中的标量场。电路的模式方程约化为Weber方程，这与辐射主导背景下支配宇宙学粒子产生的方程相同，并具有用抛物柱函数表示的精确解和指数抑制的粒子谱。我们分析了该类比成立的条件，这些条件需要在脉冲持续时间、调制的均匀性和SQUID的对称性之间取得折衷，并表明耗散不会抹去宇宙学信号。我们使用每个模式的反常矩作为Bogoliubov混合的见证：它对任何热态都消失并在耗散下存活；它与光子数一起证明压缩，并与态的纯度一起识别从真空产生的配对是否占主导。

items.title_en: Multimodal Semantic Communication using Shared and Unique Representation Decomposition
items.title_zh: 使用共享与独特表示分解的多模态语义通信
items.abstract_en: Semantic communication (SemCom) has emerged as a promising paradigm for bandwidth-constrained mobile and vehicular networks. This paper proposes a unified representation learning framework for multimodal SemCom (MSC), which encodes heterogeneous data into a compact semantic space for efficient transmission and source recovery. The framework addresses the multimodal semantic representation gap, which arises when at least one modality contains semantic information that cannot be fully inferred from the other. To preserve this information for reconstruction, the framework decomposes each representation into shared and modality-specific components. We formulate a mutual information objective for source reconstruction, cross-modal alignment of the shared components, and decoupling of the shared and modality-specific components. To enhance transmission efficiency, we introduce a shared knowledge base implemented as a compact codebook of semantic vectors learned during training. The shared components are transmitted digitally as codebook indices, while the modality-specific components are sent in analog form. We apply knowledge distillation during training, using a pretrained vision foundation model to guide the learning of quantized shared features. On image--text pairs over additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) and Extended Vehicular A (EVA) channels, the proposed framework improves image reconstruction over conventional separate source-channel coding (SSCC) and representative multimodal and unimodal SemCom systems. Further evaluations show gradual degradation under channel-estimation mismatch, complementary effects of alignment, decoupling, and knowledge distillation on the shared representation, and alignment of shared features across modalities with separation of the modality-specific features.
items.abstract_zh: 语义通信（SemCom）已成为带宽受限的移动和车辆网络中一种有前景的范式。本文提出一种用于多模态SemCom（MSC）的统一表示学习框架，将异构数据编码到紧凑的语义空间，以实现高效传输和源恢复。该框架解决多模态语义表示差距，当至少一个模态包含无法从另一模态完全推断的语义信息时，就会出现这种差距。为在重建中保留该信息，框架将每个表示分解为共享组件和模态特定组件。我们为源重建、共享组件的跨模态对齐以及共享组件与模态特定组件的解耦构建了一个互信息目标。为提高传输效率，我们引入共享知识库，其实现为训练期间学习到的语义向量的紧凑码本。共享组件以码本索引形式数字传输，而模态特定组件以模拟形式发送。我们在训练期间应用知识蒸馏，使用预训练视觉基础模型指导量化共享特征的学习。在加性白高斯噪声（AWGN）和Extended Vehicular A（EVA）信道上的图像--文本对中，所提框架在图像重建方面优于传统分离源信道编码（SSCC）以及代表性多模态和单模态SemCom系统。进一步评估显示，在信道估计失配下性能逐渐下降；对齐、解耦和知识蒸馏对共享表示具有互补效应；共享特征在跨模态间对齐，而模态特定特征相互分离。

items.title_en: Auditing AI peer reviewers: a benchmark on real scientific papers
items.title_zh: 审计AI同行评审员：基于真实科学论文的基准
items.abstract_en: LLM-based peer review is now used at production scale, but its evaluation remains limited. We introduce a benchmark that injects objective, localisable errors of four types (general issues, mathematics, numerics, citations) at three severity levels into real papers and measures each reviewer's detection rate by error type and severity, together with its false-positive rate on clean copies. We also present Skepthical, a multi-agent reviewer that verifies citation-backed claims by retrieving the cited papers, mathematics with computer algebra, and numerical claims with executed code. We apply the benchmark to two corpora of 15 recent arXiv preprints each, one in astrophysics and one in machine learning (ML), injecting a total of 357 errors, and evaluate twelve reviewer systems: six single-LLM reviewers, two Claude Code configurations, three publicly available reviewers, and Skepthical. The choice of model has the largest impact on detection rate: given the same prompt, three frontier LLMs differ by about 50 percentage points in total detection on both corpora. Tools and scaffolding help when they contribute what the model cannot supply on its own. In particular, on astrophysics, Claude Code improves on a single Claude call in mathematics and numerics detection, and enforced citation retrieval gives Skepthical the highest citation error detection rate of all systems by a large margin. This citation lead, however, is not observed on ML, where the models appear to know the literature better and Skepthical's citation detection rate is statistically indistinguishable from that of the best single LLM. False-positive rates are below 10% for most systems, but vary with prompt, model, and scaffolding, with mathematics flags the main source of false positives. The evaluation pipeline, the injected errors, and the adjudication logs are released as a benchmark.
items.abstract_zh: 基于LLM的同行评审现已在生产规模上使用，但其评估仍然有限。我们引入一个基准，将四类（一般问题、数学、数值、引用）客观、可定位的错误以三个严重程度注入真实论文，并按错误类型和严重程度测量每个评审者的检出率，以及在干净副本上的假阳性率。我们还提出Skepthical，一种多智能体评审者，通过检索被引论文验证有引用支撑的主张、用计算机代数验证数学、用执行代码验证数值主张。我们将该基准应用于两个语料库，每个语料库包含15篇近期arXiv预印本，一个在天体物理学，一个在机器学习（ML），共注入357个错误，并评估十二个评审系统：六个单LLM评审者、两种Claude Code配置、三个公开可用评审者和Skepthical。模型选择对检出率影响最大：在相同提示下，三个前沿LLM在两个语料库上的总检出率相差约50个百分点。当工具和脚手架能提供模型自身无法提供的内容时，它们就有帮助。特别地，在天体物理学上，Claude Code在数学和数值检出方面优于单次Claude调用，而强制引用检索使Skepthical以较大幅度获得所有系统中最高的引用错误检出率。然而，这一引用优势在ML上未观察到，在这些任务中模型似乎更了解文献，Skepthical的引用检出率与最佳单LLM在统计上无法区分。大多数系统的假阳性率低于10%，但随提示、模型和脚手架而变化，其中数学标记是假阳性的主要来源。评估流程、注入的错误和裁决日志作为基准发布。

items.title_en: Reading the Table: Sim-to-Real Game State Detection for the Chef's Hat Card Game
items.title_zh: 读懂桌面：Chef's Hat 卡牌游戏的仿真到真实游戏状态检测
items.abstract_en: Tabletop games offer a compelling scenario to study the interaction between artificial and human agents, combining social interaction with game state tracking and physical manipulation. To assess the game state, a robot needs to precisely detect closely related game objects, such as different card designs, requiring dedicated training data that is costly to annotate in the real world. Instead, we develop a fully automated synthetic data collection pipeline, using re-projection of known 3D coordinates to generate labels automatically and domain randomization to bridge the reality gap. This approach is used to collect a dataset of 25413 samples to finetune an object detection and a segmentation model, which are combined to assign detected cards to game-relevant zones and infer the game state. When evaluated on a real NICO humanoid robot, our pipeline achieves an F1-score of 0.906 for card-to-zone assignment, thus providing the perceptual foundation for a robot that can autonomously play Chef's Hat against human players.
items.abstract_zh: 桌面游戏提供了一个有吸引力的场景，用于研究人工代理与人类代理之间的交互，将社交互动与游戏状态跟踪和物理操作相结合。为评估游戏状态，机器人需要精确检测密切相关的游戏对象，例如不同卡牌设计，这需要专门的训练数据，而在真实世界中标注这些数据成本高昂。相反，我们开发了一个全自动合成数据收集流程，利用已知3D坐标的重投影自动生成标签，并使用域随机化弥合现实差距。该方法用于收集包含25413个样本的数据集，以微调目标检测和分割模型，并将二者结合，将检测到的卡牌分配到游戏相关区域并推断游戏状态。在真实NICO人形机器人上评估时，我们的流程在卡牌到区域分配上达到0.906的F1分数，从而为能够自主与人类玩家玩Chef's Hat的机器人提供感知基础。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为检测与跟踪，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Spatiotemporal learning improves quantification of pore-space evolution and fluid displacement
items.title_zh: 时空学习提升孔隙空间演化与流体驱替的定量表征
items.abstract_en: Pore-space evolution and fluid displacement influence how rocks transmit and store fluids, affecting geological carbon storage, underground hydrogen storage and groundwater contaminant transport. A single time-resolved micro-CT experiment may produce tens to hundreds of three-dimensional images, and segmentation is required to quantify physical properties and run image-based simulations. Traditional methods such as thresholding perform poorly on noisy, low-contrast images and need manual adjustment per image; 3D deep learning networks segment each image without temporal information, so their errors vary between images and could be mistaken for physical change. Here we introduce a transformer-based 4D segmentation framework combining spatial and temporal information. It uses sequential images to resolve ambiguous phase assignments and separate physical change from segmentation error. The method is tested on images of mineral dissolution: it measures pore-volume growth and rock boundaries more accurately than an equivalent 3D model that ignores temporal information. It also captures the increase in permeability verified against reference segmentations and flow simulations. The advantage transfers to another dissolution sample without retraining. On two other datasets of fluid displacement, it reduces spurious changes in predicted rock and porosity fluctuations and accurately identifies filling events. Spatiotemporal segmentation turns sequences of hundreds of three-dimensional images into more reliable quantitative measurements of pore-space evolution and fluid displacement without per-image parameter adjustment to support the analysis of time-resolved CT imaging.
items.abstract_zh: 孔隙空间演化与流体驱替影响岩石传输和储存流体的方式，进而影响地质碳封存、地下储氢和地下水污染物运移。单次时间分辨显微CT实验可能产生数十至数百幅三维图像，需要分割以量化物理性质并运行基于图像的模拟。阈值化等传统方法在噪声大、对比度低的图像上表现不佳，且需逐图手动调整；三维深度学习网络分割每幅图像时不利用时间信息，因此其误差在图像间变化，可能被误认为物理变化。本文提出一种基于Transformer的4D分割框架，结合空间与时间信息。该框架利用序列图像解决模糊的相分配，并将物理变化与分割误差区分开。方法在矿物溶解图像上测试：与忽略时间信息的等效3D模型相比，其测量孔隙体积增长和岩石边界更准确。它还能捕捉渗透率的增加，并经由参考分割和流动模拟验证。该优势可迁移至另一样品而无需重新训练。在另外两个流体驱替数据集上，它减少了预测岩石中的虚假变化和孔隙度波动，并准确识别充填事件。时空分割将数百幅三维图像的序列转化为更可靠的孔隙空间演化和流体驱替定量测量，无需逐图调整参数，以支持时间分辨CT成像分析。

items.title_en: Cell atlases of schistosome human infective stages reveal larval tissue fates and innovations
items.title_zh: 血吸虫感染人阶段的细胞图谱揭示幼虫组织命运与创新特征
items.abstract_en: Schistosomes infect over 250 million people, yet the cellular basis of their human-infective cercaria larva, that drives transmission and infection, remains poorly understood. We present single-cell atlases of Schistosoma mansoni cercariae, widely regarded as transcriptionally quiescent, and schistosomula, the first intra-mammalian stage. Twenty-two cercarial cell types either persist into schistosomula or are lost. The tail harbours several cercaria-specific innovations, including a novel tegument. Gene-age analysis supports the cercaria as the most recent addition to the life cycle and tail cells as younger than body cells. Persisting cell types undergo clear transcriptional transitions which give new insights into the dynamics of cercarial transformation into schistosomula. These findings link the recent origin of cercarial cell types to the evolution of active dispersal and transmission in digenean parasites.
items.abstract_zh: 血吸虫感染超过2.5亿人，但其感染人的尾蚴幼虫（驱动传播和感染）的细胞基础仍知之甚少。我们呈现曼氏血吸虫尾蚴（通常被认为转录静止）和童虫（首个哺乳动物体内阶段）的单细胞图谱。22种尾蚴细胞类型要么持续存在至童虫，要么丢失。尾部具有若干尾蚴特异性创新，包括一种新型体被。基因年龄分析支持尾蚴是生活史中最近新增的阶段，且尾部细胞比体细胞更年轻。持续存在的细胞类型经历明显的转录转变，为尾蚴向童虫转化的动态提供新见解。这些发现将尾蚴细胞类型的近期起源与复殖吸虫寄生虫主动扩散和传播的演化联系起来。

items.title_en: A deployed four-city entanglement-based QKD network with real-time key delivery, benchmarked against finite-key security bounds
items.title_zh: 已部署的四城市纠缠基QKD网络：实时密钥交付并以有限密钥安全界为基准
items.abstract_en: Quantum key distribution (QKD) generates shared secret keys whose security rests on the laws of physics rather than on computational assumptions. We report the entanglement-based segment of the Slovak national quantum communication infrastructure, connecting four cities in western Slovakia over deployed telecommunication fiber. Polarization-entangled photons generated at a central node are passively routed by wavelength to form a trusted-node-free, fully meshed sub-network of three cities, with the fourth connected through the central node and all links operated simultaneously. We also introduce a matrix formalism for passive wavelength routing that enables the algorithmic construction of uniquely and fully connected topologies. Unlike most previous demonstrations, which estimate key rates from raw coincidences, all rates reported here are obtained after the complete post-processing chain, with keys delivered in real time via ETSI GS QKD 014. With partial non-local chromatic dispersion compensation, we obtain 13.5 bit/s over 109 km, and 4.3 bit/s over 32.1 dB of accumulated loss between two cities without a direct fiber link. Benchmarking against finite-key security bounds shows that the implemented heuristic privacy amplification can exceed the finite-key bound, and that replacing detect-and-discard with error correction would increase the finite-key rate by a factor of 4.1-6.6, and yield a positive finite-key rate on the 142.9 km link where the implemented scheme yields none.
items.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（QKD）生成共享密钥，其安全性基于物理定律而非计算假设。我们报道斯洛伐克国家量子通信基础设施中基于纠缠的部分，通过已部署的电信光纤连接斯洛伐克西部四个城市。在中心节点产生的偏振纠缠光子按波长被动路由，形成三个城市组成的无信任节点、全网格子网，第四个城市通过中心节点连接，且所有链路同时运行。我们还引入用于被动波长路由的矩阵形式体系，可算法化构建唯一且全连接的拓扑。与以往大多数演示从原始符合计数估计密钥率不同，本文报告的所有密钥率均在完整后处理链之后获得，密钥通过ETSI GS QKD 014实时交付。在部分非局域色散补偿下，我们在109 km上获得13.5 bit/s，并在两个无直接光纤链路的城市之间、累积损耗32.1 dB下获得4.3 bit/s。对照有限密钥安全界进行基准测试表明，所实现的启发式隐私放大可能超过有限密钥界；用纠错替代检测并丢弃会使有限密钥率提高4.1–6.6倍，并在142.9 km链路上产生正的有限密钥率，而所实现方案在该链路上未产生任何正密钥率。

items.title_en: Joint Beamforming and Duplex-Mode Segment Selection for Secure Uplink Transmission in Pinching Antenna Systems
items.title_zh: 夹持天线系统中安全上行传输的联合波束成形与双工模式段选择
items.abstract_en: Pinching antenna systems (PASS) have recently emerged as a promising architecture for reconfigurable, flexible and proximity-driven signal delivery. In this paper, we propose a segmented waveguide-based PASS architecture for enabling secure uplink communications, where each segment activates at most one pinching antenna (PA), which inherently eliminates the inter-antenna re-radiation effect and yields a tractable uplink signal model. To protect the uplink transmission against eavesdropping, the base station (BS) injects artificial noise (AN) toward the eavesdroppers via selected downlink segments using a duplex-mode segment selection mechanism, which dynamically configures each segment for either uplink reception or downlink AN transmission through switch-controlled fiber connections. We formulate the secrecy energy efficiency (SEE) maximization problem as a mixed-integer nonlinear program (MINLP) that jointly optimizes the receive beamforming vector, AN covariance, user transmit power, pinching antenna positions, and duplex-mode segment assignment. Given the non-convex and combinatorial nature of the problem, we develop an efficient alternating optimization (AO) framework, where the resulting subproblems are solved using the Dinkelbach method combined with successive convex approximation (SCA) and penalty-based relaxation. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly outperforms benchmark schemes in terms of SEE and robustness against waveguide attenuation. Moreover, AN effectively suppresses information leakage, while PA mobility, duplex-mode segment allocation, and waveguide segmentation further improve secrecy performance through flexible positioning and reduced in-waveguide propagation loss.
items.abstract_zh: 夹持天线系统（PASS）近期成为一种有前景的架构，用于可重构、灵活且接近驱动的信号传输。本文提出一种基于分段波导的PASS架构以实现安全上行通信，其中每个段至多激活一个夹持天线（PA），这从根本上消除天线间再辐射效应，并得到可处理的上行信号模型。为保护上行传输免受窃听，基站（BS）通过双工模式段选择机制，经选定的下行段向窃听者注入人工噪声（AN）；该机制通过开关控制的光纤连接，将每个段动态配置为上行接收或下行AN传输。我们将保密能量效率（SEE）最大化问题建模为混合整数非线性规划（MINLP），联合优化接收波束成形向量、AN协方差、用户发射功率、夹持天线位置和双工模式段分配。鉴于问题的非凸和组合性质，我们提出一种高效交替优化（AO）框架，其中所得子问题采用Dinkelbach方法结合逐次凸近似（SCA）和基于惩罚的松弛求解。仿真结果表明，所提框架在SEE和对波导衰减的鲁棒性方面显著优于基准方案。此外，AN有效抑制信息泄漏，而PA移动性、双工模式段分配和波导分段通过灵活定位和降低波导内传播损耗进一步提升保密性能。

items.title_en: Human or Synthetic? What a Fixed Budget Buys for Post-Training
items.title_zh: 人工还是合成？固定预算能为后训练带来什么
items.abstract_en: Post-training of large language models typically combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with preference-based fine-tuning such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Human-annotated and synthetically generated preference data differ substantially in per-sample cost, but prior work typically holds sample count fixed when comparing the two. In this work, we explicitly study the interplay between cost and performance by comparing the effect of post-training with human and synthetic preference data under a fixed, dollar-matched annotation budget. We train and evaluate multiple base model families across helpfulness and summarization tasks. We find that synthetic data is far more cost-efficient at low-to-moderate budgets, achieving high win rates with as little as \$200--\$400. On helpfulness, human data closes the gap only at budgets roughly two orders of magnitude larger; on summarization, it does not close the gap at any tested budget. We also find that human-annotated data varies in reliability: one widely used human preference source substantially underperforms another, and the gap persists even after standard remedies such as domain restriction and deduplication.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的后训练通常将监督微调（SFT）与基于偏好的微调（如直接偏好优化，DPO）相结合。人工标注和合成生成的偏好数据在每样本成本上差异很大，但以往工作在比较二者时通常固定样本数量。本文在固定且金额匹配的标注预算下，比较使用人工和合成偏好数据进行后训练的效果，从而显式研究成本与性能之间的相互作用。我们在有用性和摘要任务上训练并评估多个基础模型系列。我们发现，在中低预算下，合成数据的成本效率高得多，仅用200–400美元即可达到高胜率。在有用性任务上，人工数据仅在预算约大两个数量级时才能缩小差距；在摘要任务上，在任何测试预算下都未能缩小差距。我们还发现，人工标注数据的可靠性存在差异：一个广泛使用的人工偏好来源的表现显著低于另一个，且即使采用领域限制和去重等标准补救措施，差距仍然存在。

items.title_en: UAV-Flow++: A Unified Suite for Benchmarking and Learning Language-Guided UAV Flight
items.title_zh: UAV-Flow++：用于基准测试和学习语言引导无人机飞行的统一套件
items.abstract_en: Language-guided UAV navigation has largely focused on long-horizon route planning, leaving short-range, object-relative flight maneuvers underexplored. To address this gap, we formulate Flying-on-a-Word (Flow), a task requiring a UAV to convert concise natural-language instruction, egocentric visual observation, and current state dynamics into continuous flight actions. Flow encompasses both primitive motion commands and complex object-interactive behaviors, assessing motion intent comprehension and spatial context grounding. To enable policy learning and closed-loop evaluation, we introduce UAV-Flow, a comprehensive dataset comprising 30,692 expert-piloted real-world trajectories across eight distinct motion categories, alongside 10,109 simulation trajectories in the UAV-Flow-Sim environment equipped with task-specific completion criteria. Furthermore, we develop FlowVLA, which undergoes imitation pretraining on mixed real-sim demonstrations and online post-training via Tail-Aware GRPO (TGRPO). By leveraging group reward distributions, TGRPO effectively reinforces high-reward action sequences. Evaluated on 273 held-out UAV-Flow-Sim episodes, pretrained FlowVLA achieves a mean success rate of 75.58%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.72 percentage points, which TGRPO post-training further elevates to 93.16% with superior sample efficiency. Physical UAV experiments demonstrate robust execution of object-relative commands in both indoor and outdoor real-world scenes. Together, Flow establishes a novel benchmark and learning framework for language-conditioned flight maneuvers.
items.abstract_zh: 语言引导的无人机导航主要集中于长时程路线规划，短程、相对于物体的飞行机动则研究不足。为填补这一空白，我们提出Flying-on-a-Word（Flow）任务，要求无人机将简洁的自然语言指令、自我中心视觉观察和当前状态动态转化为连续飞行动作。Flow涵盖基本运动命令和复杂的物体交互行为，评估运动意图理解和空间上下文落地。为支持策略学习和闭环评估，我们引入UAV-Flow，这是一个综合数据集，包含跨越八个不同运动类别的30,692条专家操控真实世界轨迹，以及UAV-Flow-Sim环境中配备任务特定完成标准的10,109条仿真轨迹。此外，我们开发FlowVLA，其在混合真实-仿真演示上进行模仿预训练，并通过Tail-Aware GRPO（TGRPO）进行在线后训练。通过利用组奖励分布，TGRPO有效强化高奖励动作序列。在273个留出的UAV-Flow-Sim回合上评估，预训练FlowVLA达到75.58%的平均成功率，比最强基线高6.72个百分点；TGRPO后训练进一步将其提升至93.16%，并具有更优的样本效率。物理无人机实验表明，在室内和室外真实场景中均能稳健执行相对于物体的命令。总之，Flow为语言条件飞行动作建立了新的基准和学习框架。

items.title_en: Transmission-Mode Multispectral Imaging for Estimation of Microcystis spp. Cell Concentration and ELISA-Equivalent Microcystin Concentration in Water
items.title_zh: 透射模式多光谱成像用于估算水中微囊藻属细胞浓度和ELISA当量微囊藻毒素浓度
items.abstract_en: Harmful algal blooms dominated by Microcystis spp. threaten freshwater systems through proliferation and microcystin (MC) production. Conventional measurements of cyanobacterial abundance and MC concentration commonly require laboratory processing, specialized instrumentation, or assay reagents. Because MC concentration cannot always be reliably inferred from cell abundance, complementary optical approaches for estimating both quantities are of interest. This study proposes and evaluates a transmission mode multispectral imaging (MSI) framework for estimating Microcystis spp. cell concentration and ELISA-equivalent MC concentration from culture derived dilution samples. A custom built MSI system acquiring twelve spectral bands from near-ultraviolet to near-infrared wavelengths measured transmitted light spectral responses. Following principal component analysis based dimensionality reduction, spectral variation was quantified using an aggregated Wasserstein distance descriptor for regression based prediction. Cell concentration estimation yielded $R^2=0.9819$ for calibration and $R^2=0.9754$ on held-out intermediate dilution levels, while ELISA-equivalent MC estimation yielded $R^2=0.9788$ for calibration and $R^2=0.9786$ on held-out intermediate dilution levels. These results demonstrate the feasibility of transmission-mode MSI as a dual output optical calibration framework for estimation of Microcystis spp. cell concentration and ELISA-equivalent MC concentration in water.
items.abstract_zh: 以微囊藻属（Microcystis spp.）为优势种的有害藻华通过增殖和微囊藻毒素（MC）生成威胁淡水系统。蓝细菌丰度和MC浓度的常规测量通常需要实验室处理、专用仪器或检测试剂。由于MC浓度并非总能由细胞丰度可靠推断，因此估算这两个量的互补光学方法受到关注。本研究提出并评估一种透射模式多光谱成像（MSI）框架，用于从来源于培养物的稀释样品中估算微囊藻属细胞浓度和ELISA当量MC浓度。一套定制的MSI系统采集从近紫外到近红外波长的12个光谱波段，测量透射光光谱响应。在基于主成分分析的降维之后，使用聚合Wasserstein距离描述符量化光谱变化，以进行基于回归的预测。细胞浓度估算在校准中给出$R^2=0.9819$，在留出的中间稀释水平上给出$R^2=0.9754$；ELISA当量MC估算在校准中给出$R^2=0.9788$，在留出的中间稀释水平上给出$R^2=0.9786$。这些结果证明透射模式MSI作为一种双输出光学校准框架，用于估算水中微囊藻属细胞浓度和ELISA当量MC浓度的可行性。
authors: K. A. D. S. A. Perera

items.title_en: Discovery of molecular glues for modulating MHC presentation of cancer neoantigens
items.title_zh: 调控癌症新抗原MHC呈递的分子胶的发现
items.abstract_en: Antigen presentation by MHC class I molecules is essential for cancer immunosurveillance, but many cancer-specific antigens fail to form complexes with Class I MHC and are poorly presented on the cell surface. In this study, we present a chemical strategy to overcome this limitation by identifying peptide MHC glues (PMGs) that promote the formation of peptide-MHC complexes with otherwise unpresentable cancer antigens. Crystal structures of these complexes show that our compounds stabilize antigen-MHC binding by making simultaneous interactions with the MHC protein and the antigen peptides. These findings reveal a new approach for chemically rewiring Class I MHC antigen presentation and accessing rare cancer antigens for therapeutic targeting.
items.abstract_zh: MHC I类分子的抗原呈递对癌症免疫监视至关重要，但许多癌症特异性抗原不能与I类MHC形成复合物，并且在细胞表面呈递较差。在本研究中，我们提出一种化学策略来克服这一限制，即识别肽-MHC胶（PMGs），其促进肽-MHC复合物与原本不可呈递的癌症抗原形成。这些复合物的晶体结构显示，我们的化合物通过与MHC蛋白和抗原肽同时相互作用来稳定抗原-MHC结合。这些发现揭示了一种化学重连I类MHC抗原呈递并获取稀有癌症抗原用于治疗靶向的新方法。

items.title_en: Implementation of a 1D Gaussian-modulated CV-QKD under finite-size parameter estimation
items.title_zh: 有限尺寸参数估计下的一维高斯调制CV-QKD实现
items.abstract_en: Continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CV-QKD) is a promising technology for quantum-secure communications, offering high secret-key rates and straightforward integration with coherent optical communication systems. Conventional Gaussian-modulated CV-QKD encodes information in both optical-field quadratures, increasing requirements for state preparation, modulation, and calibration, while potentially introducing additional preparation imperfections. Unidimensional (1D) Gaussian modulation offers a simpler alternative by encoding information in only one quadrature, while the conjugate quadrature constrains the protocol's security. However, an integrated experimental 1D implementation combining independent-laser coherent reception with practical reconciliation, finite-size parameter estimation, and privacy amplification remains challenging. Here, we experimentally demonstrate a 1D Gaussian-modulated CV-QKD system over 12~km of standard single-mode fiber using a local local oscillator (LLO) architecture with independent lasers and an integrated offline classical post-processing chain. The implementation includes coherent detection, digital signal processing, information reconciliation, parameter estimation, physicality-constrained security analysis, and privacy amplification. The 1D system achieves a privacy-amplified rate of $1.421$~Mbit/s under the asymptotic security treatment and $0.364$~Mbit/s under the finite-size scenario. These results establish an experimental baseline for the performance--complexity trade-off associated with unidimensional Gaussian modulation and provide an experimental basis for developing lower-complexity CV-QKD transmitters.
items.abstract_zh: 连续变量量子密钥分发（CV-QKD）是量子安全通信的一种有前景技术，具有高秘密密钥率以及与相干光通信系统直接集成的优势。传统高斯调制CV-QKD在光场两个正交分量中编码信息，增加了状态制备、调制和校准的要求，同时可能引入额外的制备不完美性。一维（1D）高斯调制通过仅在一个正交分量中编码信息提供了一种更简单的替代方案，而共轭正交分量约束协议的安全性。然而，将独立激光器相干接收与实际协调、有限尺寸参数估计和隐私放大相结合的一体化1D实验实现仍具有挑战性。在此，我们实验演示了在12 km标准单模光纤上使用本地本振（LLO）架构和独立激光器以及集成离线经典后处理链的1D高斯调制CV-QKD系统。该实现包括相干检测、数字信号处理、信息协调、参数估计、物理性约束安全性分析和隐私放大。1D系统在渐近安全性处理下实现1.421 Mbit/s的隐私放大速率，在有限尺寸场景下实现0.364 Mbit/s。这些结果为与一维高斯调制相关的性能-复杂度权衡建立了实验基线，并为开发更低复杂度的CV-QKD发射机提供了实验基础。

items.title_en: Symmetry in Time: A Representation Theory of Linear Recurrent Memory
items.title_zh: 时间中的对称性：线性递归记忆的表示理论
items.abstract_en: State space models (SSMs) are an emerging alternative to Transformers. SSMs offer linear-time inference and parallel training, but most implementations make the parallel scan efficient by making the recurrence diagonal: each channel of the hidden state is multiplied by an input-dependent real or complex number. These numbers commute, so the state records which inputs occurred but not their order. We formalize this with representation theory, which explains and fixes the state-tracking failures previously reported for SSMs. The state update defines a linear representation of the monoid of input sequences, and we show that an SSM tracks a group at every sequence length exactly when that group is a quotient of the group generated by its transition matrices. Two consequences follow. Diagonal real- and complex-valued SSMs can track only commutative groups, while the transition matrices of any SSM that can track a group must split into independent blocks over the real, complex, and quaternion numbers. We then introduce HyperSSM, which adds quaternion channels while keeping linear-time inference and parallel training. Trained only on final answers, HyperSSM solves the group tasks of recent state-tracking benchmarks exactly with at most five state numbers. This includes $S_5$ with 32 generators, where previous SSMs are at chance, and HyperSSM generalizes to sequences 25 times longer than those seen in training. Because the theory says what the transitions must encode, the learned weights of the linear recurrence can be interpreted directly. We demonstrate this by recovering the calibration of a real gyroscope, the rotations of imperfect qubit gates and the geometry of protein backbones.
items.abstract_zh: 状态空间模型（SSM）是Transformer的新兴替代方案。SSM提供线性时间推理和并行训练，但大多数实现通过使递归对角化来使并行扫描高效：隐藏状态的每个通道乘以一个输入依赖的实数或复数。这些数可交换，因此状态记录发生了哪些输入，但不记录其顺序。我们用表示理论对此形式化，该理论解释并修复了先前报道的SSM状态跟踪失败。状态更新定义了输入序列幺半群的线性表示，并且我们证明，一个SSM在每条序列长度上跟踪一个群，当且仅当该群是由其转移矩阵生成的群的商。由此得到两个推论。对角实值和复值SSM只能跟踪交换群，而任何能够跟踪一个群的SSM的转移矩阵必须在实数、复数和四元数上分裂为独立块。然后我们引入HyperSSM，它在保持线性时间推理和并行训练的同时增加四元数通道。仅用最终答案训练，HyperSSM以至多五个状态数精确解决近期状态跟踪基准中的群任务。这包括具有32个生成元的$S_5$，此前SSM处于随机水平，并且HyperSSM可泛化到比训练中见到的序列长25倍的序列。由于理论说明了转移必须编码什么，线性递归的学习权重可以直接解释。我们通过恢复真实陀螺仪的校准、不完美量子比特门的旋转以及蛋白质骨架的几何结构来演示这一点。

items.title_en: Outcome-Mass Alignment: Controlling Length-Dependent Trajectory Influence in Multi-Turn LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 结果-质量对齐：控制多轮LLM智能体强化学习中长度相关的轨迹影响
items.abstract_en: To keep long interaction contexts tractable, stepwise group-relative training for multi-turn LLM agents materializes each source trajectory into multiple response rows and valid tokens. This expansion creates an outer-accounting problem distinct from within-trajectory credit assignment: row-based outcome statistics can count one episode outcome multiple times, while token-level reduction can assign unequal aggregate objective mass across trajectories. We term these effects outcome-statistics multiplicity and objective-mass imbalance. We introduce Outcome-Mass Alignment (OMA), a two-component method that makes both accounting choices explicit. Outcome Alignment computes outcome statistics over unique source trajectories, while Mass Alignment controls aggregate objective mass after within-trajectory aggregation of optimizer-native token objectives. Neither redesigns the base optimizer's credit assignment, importance ratios, or clipping. Across matched ALFWorld GRPO comparisons at two model scales, where failed trajectories typically expand much more than successful ones, OMA improves matched-horizon endpoint success by 7.0-9.4 percentage points. Ordinary WebShop exhibits weak or reversed expansion-outcome coupling and correspondingly mixed effects, whereas in a success-oriented WebShop setting, WebShop-SOL, OMA improves success nAUC from 0.399 to 0.511. Component ablations and GiGPO and GSPO comparisons further support component separability and cross-optimizer compatibility. These results show that trajectory expansion always defines an implicit weighting rule, but its practical effect depends on how expansion couples to outcomes and optimizer-native updates.
items.abstract_zh: 为保持长交互上下文可处理，多轮LLM智能体的逐步组相对训练将每个源轨迹具体化为多个响应行和有效token。这种扩展产生了一个不同于轨迹内信用分配的外部核算问题：基于行的结果统计可能将一个回合结果计数多次，而token级归约可能在轨迹之间分配不相等的聚合目标质量。我们将这些效应称为结果统计多重性和目标质量失衡。我们引入结果-质量对齐（OMA），一种双组件方法，使两种核算选择都显式化。结果对齐在唯一源轨迹上计算结果统计，而质量对齐在优化器原生token目标进行轨迹内聚合之后控制聚合目标质量。二者均不重新设计基础优化器的信用分配、重要性比率或裁剪。在两个模型规模的匹配ALFWorld GRPO比较中，失败轨迹通常比成功轨迹扩展得多得多，OMA将匹配时域端点成功率提高7.0-9.4个百分点。普通WebShop表现出较弱或反向的扩展-结果耦合，并相应产生混合效应；而在面向成功的WebShop设置WebShop-SOL中，OMA将成功率nAUC从0.399提高到0.511。组件消融以及GiGPO和GSPO比较进一步支持组件可分离性和跨优化器兼容性。这些结果表明，轨迹扩展总是定义一种隐式加权规则，但其实际效果取决于扩展如何与结果和优化器原生更新耦合。

items.title_en: Maximizing LLM Utility While Managing LLM Fallibility
items.title_zh: 在管理LLM易错性的同时最大化LLM效用
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can supply autonomous systems with plans, predictions, and judgments, but these contributions are sometimes wrong. This review asks how a system can maximize an LLM's utility while managing its fallibility. Our answer is to adapt the system's reliance on the LLM as evidence about the LLM's performance accumulates. Systems built from imperfect components, such as noisy sensors and faulty software, have long worked in this way, and the classical methods they use can be applied to LLM-based systems as well. A system can change its reliance on an LLM in several ways, depending on the LLM's role and on the other components in the system. Each change needs an estimate of the LLM's reliability, and the LLM's role and the kind of contribution it makes determine what to estimate. Classical methods from decision theory, estimation, and online learning then turn these estimates into reliance decisions. These decisions can reduce how often LLM errors affect the system. However, some errors matter even when they are rare. An independently verified mechanism can prevent such errors from being executed. Without one, adapting reliance using reliability estimates can still keep their risk within a bound. Studies on adapting reliance on LLMs are emerging but limited, and the reviewed comparisons suggest that adapting reliance can improve system performance.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）可为自主系统提供计划、预测和判断，但这些贡献有时是错误的。本综述询问系统如何在管理LLM易错性的同时最大化LLM效用。我们的答案是，随着关于LLM性能的证据积累，调整系统对LLM的依赖。由不完美组件（如噪声传感器和故障软件）构建的系统长期以来一直以这种方式工作，它们使用的经典方法也可以应用于基于LLM的系统。系统可以通过多种方式改变对LLM的依赖，具体取决于LLM的角色以及系统中的其他组件。每种改变都需要对LLM可靠性进行估计，而LLM的角色及其贡献类型决定了需要估计什么。来自决策理论、估计和在线学习的经典方法随后将这些估计转化为依赖决策。这些决策可以减少LLM错误影响系统的频率。然而，有些错误即使很少见也很重要。独立验证机制可以防止此类错误被执行。若没有这种机制，使用可靠性估计调整依赖仍可将其风险保持在界限内。关于调整对LLM依赖的研究正在出现但有限，所综述的比较表明，调整依赖可以提高系统性能。

items.title_en: Kosmo-GFM: A Production-Ready Geometry Foundation Model
items.title_zh: Kosmo-GFM：一个可用于生产的几何基础模型
items.abstract_en: We present Kosmo-GFM, a scene reconstruction system that integrates a geometry foundation model (GFM), a pose optimization engine (PoseEngine), and reconstruction-derived supervision from KosmoWorld. GFM predicts camera parameters, depth, cross-view correspondences, and dynamic 3D points from images and videos. PoseEngine combines these predictions with geometric optimization to recover scene-level camera poses and geometry for downstream 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting. KosmoWorld generates images and geometric supervision from reconstructed real-world scenes to improve GFM's geometric predictions. On the Sparse and Medium subsets of SpatialBench, GFM achieves the lowest absolute relative depth error and the highest relative-pose AUC at 5 degrees among the compared methods. It also achieves the lowest mean endpoint errors for dynamic points and scene flow across the five evaluated datasets. Across 34 scenes completed by all compared reconstruction systems, PoseEngine achieves the highest scene-averaged pose AUC at thresholds of 1, 3, and 5 degrees, with a cumulative runtime of 14.07 hours, approximately 20% of GLUEMAP's 69.67 hours. PoseEngine Flash provides a further accuracy-efficiency trade-off, with a measured mixed-precision runtime of 2.62 hours, approximately 4% of GLUEMAP's runtime. Separate scaling experiments show generally favorable trends with increased data, model computation, and training budgets. These results support the use of learned geometric priors within a scene-level reconstruction pipeline.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Kosmo-GFM，一个场景重建系统，集成了几何基础模型（GFM）、位姿优化引擎（PoseEngine）以及来自 KosmoWorld 的重建导出监督。GFM 从图像和视频中预测相机参数、深度、跨视图对应关系和动态 3D 点。PoseEngine 将这些预测与几何优化结合，恢复场景级相机位姿和几何，用于下游 3D 和 4D Gaussian Splatting。KosmoWorld 从重建的真实世界场景生成图像和几何监督，以改进 GFM 的几何预测。在 SpatialBench 的 Sparse 和 Medium 子集上，GFM 在对比方法中取得最低的绝对相对深度误差和 5 度阈值下最高的相对位姿 AUC。在五个评估数据集上，它还取得动态点和场景流的最低平均端点误差。在所有对比重建系统均完成的 34 个场景上，PoseEngine 在 1、3、5 度阈值下取得最高的场景平均位姿 AUC，累计运行时间为 14.07 小时，约为 GLUEMAP 的 69.67 小时的 20%。PoseEngine Flash 提供进一步的精度—效率权衡，测得的混合精度运行时间为 2.62 小时，约为 GLUEMAP 运行时间的 4%。单独的扩展实验显示，随着数据、模型计算和训练预算增加，总体呈有利趋势。这些结果支持在场景级重建流程中使用学习到的几何先验。

items.title_en: Temporally Dynamic Waves of Selection on Archaic Variation in Peruvians
items.title_zh: 秘鲁人群中古老变异选择的时间动态波次
items.abstract_en: Introgression introduced deeply diverged archaic variation into modern human populations and contributed to local adaptation. In Indigenous American populations, however, the landscape of adaptive introgression remains poorly resolved. Genome-wide scans have reported numerous candidate loci, but complex demographic histories and recent admixture make genuine signals difficult to distinguish from false positives. Here, we systematically re-evaluated previously reported candidates of adaptive introgression in Peruvians using a multilayered framework and refined more than 150 putative signals to 25 high-confidence candidate loci with concordant evidence of Neanderthal- or Denisovan-like ancestry and positive selection. Using ancestral recombination graph (ARG) approaches, we inferred selection onset windows for 21 loci. These onsets were non-uniformly distributed across Peruvian population history, revealing temporally dynamic selection without robust evidence for a fixed number of discrete waves. Together with pre-Columbian ancient DNA evidence, the inferred histories support the inheritance of the candidate adaptive archaic haplotypes through ancestral Native American populations rather than first introduction through post-Columbian admixture. Functional analyses identified network-level signals consistent with polygenic selection in lipid metabolic and immune-related pathways, elevated regulatory effects predicted across archaic haplotypes, and occasional coding variation of potential functional relevance, including a missense variant at the immune-related gene CXCR4. Our results show that archaic introgressed variation remained evolutionarily important and available to selection long after introgression, providing a reservoir of genetic variation that could be repeatedly recruited by selection at different points in American population history.
items.abstract_zh: 基因渗入将深度分化的古老变异引入现代人群，并促成本地适应。然而在美洲原住民人群中，适应性渗入的图景仍不清楚。全基因组扫描已报告许多候选位点，但复杂的人口历史和近期混合使真实信号难以与假阳性区分。本文使用多层框架系统重新评估此前报告的秘鲁人群适应性渗入候选，将 150 多个推定信号精炼为 25 个高置信度候选位点，这些位点具有尼安德特人或丹尼索瓦人样祖源与正选择的一致证据。使用祖先重组图（ARG）方法，我们推断了 21 个位点的选择起始窗口。这些起始时间在秘鲁人群历史中非均匀分布，揭示出时间动态的选择，但没有稳健证据支持固定数量的离散波次。结合前哥伦布时期古 DNA 证据，推断的历史支持候选适应性古老单倍型通过祖先美洲原住民人群遗传，而不是首先通过后哥伦布时期混合引入。功能分析识别出与脂质代谢和免疫相关通路中多基因选择一致的网络级信号、预测古老单倍型具有升高的调控效应，以及偶见的可能具有功能相关性的编码变异，包括免疫相关基因 CXCR4 的错义变异。结果表明，古老渗入变异在渗入很久之后仍具有进化重要性并可被选择利用，提供了一个遗传变异储备库，可在美洲人群历史的不同时点被选择反复招募。

items.title_en: Programming Quantum Circuit Parameters with Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 用大型语言模型编程量子电路参数
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated the ability to generate parameters for variational quantum circuits without conventional optimization. However, the conditions under which this approach is effective remain unclear. Here, we investigate a frozen, general-purpose LLM that generates complete circuit parameter vectors from symbolic circuit and Hamiltonian descriptions, with optional iterative energy feedback. We evaluate the approach on general random Hamiltonians, structured parent Hamiltonians, and molecular systems. For general Hamiltonians, LLM-generated parameters exhibit larger energy errors than conventional Adam optimization, while additional feedback generally provides limited improvement. In contrast, for structured Hamiltonians, the LLM can generate promising low-energy parameter configurations, suggesting that identifiable physical and mathematical structure facilitates parameter inference. We also show that direct LLM predictions of minimum energies can violate the Hamiltonian spectral lower bound, whereas generated circuit parameters allow independent evaluation of physically realizable energy expectation values. Finally, we investigate blind circuit interpretation and find that the LLM can predict measurement outcomes even when it fails to identify the underlying quantum algorithm. These findings highlight the role of problem structure, the limitations of iterative LLM optimization, and the importance of independently verifiable predictions in quantum parameter programming.
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）最近展示了无需传统优化即可为变分量子电路生成参数的能力。然而，这种方法在何种条件下有效仍不清楚。本文研究一个冻结的通用 LLM，它从符号电路和哈密顿量描述生成完整的电路参数向量，并可选择使用迭代能量反馈。我们在一般随机哈密顿量、结构化父哈密顿量和分子系统上评估该方法。对于一般哈密顿量，LLM 生成的参数比传统 Adam 优化表现出更大的能量误差，而额外反馈通常只带来有限改进。相反，对于结构化哈密顿量，LLM 能生成有前景的低能量参数配置，表明可识别的物理和数学结构有助于参数推断。我们还表明，LLM 直接预测最小能量可能违反哈密顿量谱下界，而生成的电路参数允许独立评估物理可实现的能量期望值。最后，我们研究盲电路解释，发现即使 LLM 未能识别底层量子算法，它也能预测测量结果。这些发现突出问題结构的作用、迭代 LLM 优化的局限，以及可独立验证预测在量子参数编程中的重要性。

items.title_en: An Invariant Neural-Network Eddy-Viscosity Closure with Iterative Solver Coupling for Molten Salt Fast Reactor Thermal-Hydraulics
items.title_zh: 用于熔盐快堆热工水力学的、与迭代求解器耦合的不变神经网络涡黏性闭合模型
items.abstract_en: System thermal-hydraulics codes such as the System Analysis Module (SAM) close turbulence on coarse meshes with algebraic zero-equation mixing-length models. These models cannot represent the non-equilibrium turbulence, flow separation, and large-scale recirculation of open-cavity advanced reactors. We develop an invariant neural-network eddy-viscosity closure for SAM and apply it to the Molten Salt Fast Reactor (MSFR). The closure predicts the turbulent kinetic energy and timescale of each element from the flow and geometry of its neighbors, without solving turbulence transport equations. The resulting non-negative eddy viscosity enters the implicit diffusive operator, which keeps the momentum equations well conditioned. We prove that the closure is exactly invariant to translation, Galilean boost, rotation, reflection, and neighbor ordering. A network trained on high-order Nek5000 fields sees a different feature distribution on the coarse SAM mesh. We remove this covariate shift by iteratively retraining the network on SAM flow states against fixed Nek5000 targets. For a held-out steady state, the coupled closure reproduces the single recirculation cell and eddy-viscosity plume of the Nek5000 reference. In a 120 s pump-coastdown transient, it halves the velocity error of the mixing-length model, from 37.6% to 17.7%, and matches the Nek5000 eddy viscosity with a time-averaged relative error of 12%. The remaining velocity error comes from the coarse mesh. The coupled transient takes about 0.2 core-hours, compared with about 330 core-hours for Nek5000. The results show that the closure can recover two-equation RANS turbulence behavior in a coarse-mesh system code at a small fraction of the CFD cost.
items.abstract_zh: 诸如系统分析模块（SAM）的系统热工水力学程序在粗网格上使用代数零方程混合长度模型封闭湍流。这些模型无法表示开放腔式先进反应堆的非平衡湍流、流动分离和大尺度再循环。我们为 SAM 开发了一种不变神经网络涡黏性闭合模型，并将其应用于熔盐快堆（MSFR）。该闭合模型根据每个单元邻居的流动和几何预测其湍动能和时间尺度，而不求解湍流输运方程。得到的非负涡黏性进入隐式扩散算子，使动量方程保持良态。我们证明该闭合模型对平移、伽利略助推、旋转、反射和邻居排序严格不变。在高阶 Nek5000 场训练的网格在粗 SAM 网格上会看到不同的特征分布。我们通过在 SAM 流状态上针对固定的 Nek5000 目标迭代重新训练网络，消除了这种协变量偏移。对于留出稳态，耦合闭合模型再现了 Nek5000 参考的单个再循环单元和涡黏性羽流。在 120 s 泵惰转瞬态中，它将混合长度模型的速度误差减半，从 37.6% 降至 17.7%，并以 12% 的时间平均相对误差匹配 Nek5000 涡黏性。剩余速度误差来自粗网格。耦合瞬态计算约需 0.2 核时，而 Nek5000 约需 330 核时。结果表明，该闭合模型能以 CFD 成本的一小部分在粗网格系统程序中恢复双方程 RANS 湍流行为。

items.title_en: EvenVLM: A Text and Multimodal Dataset for the Even Language with Vision-Language Fine-Tuning
items.title_zh: EvenVLM：一个用于埃文语的文本与多模态数据集及视觉—语言微调
items.abstract_en: We present EvenVLM, the first text and multimodal (VQA) dataset for Even (Lamut), an endangered Northern Tungusic language spoken by approximately 6,800 people in Siberia. Our dataset comprises 50,521 structured Even-Russian entries extracted from dictionary and phrasebook sources via GPT-4o Mini-based parsing, from which we synthetically generate 107,543 training examples spanning translation, grammar, reading comprehension, and semantic classification. To address tokenization inefficiency on Even's agglutinative morphology, we propose a three-step tokenizer expansion algorithm that adds Even-specific graphemes (eng, oe, o-umlaut), whitelisted vocabulary, and BPE merges, reducing average tokens per word by 27% (4.99 to 3.64). Using LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3-VL-4B, we adapt the model for text tasks (0.53% trainable parameters, rank 32) and separately for visual question answering (rank 64, frozen vision encoder). Our best configuration achieves 11.4% exact match and a 13.6 weighted score on text benchmarks, 0.1283 chrF for sentence translation, and 65% accuracy on VQA (up from 0% for the base model and text-only fine-tuning). We release our datasets, evaluation benchmarks, and training pipeline to support further research on Even and other low-resource languages.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 EvenVLM，这是首个埃文语（Even，Lamut）文本与多模态（VQA）数据集；埃文语是一种濒危的北通古斯语，在西伯利亚约有 6800 人使用。我们的数据集包含 50,521 条结构化埃文语—俄语条目，这些条目通过基于 GPT-4o Mini 的解析从词典和常用语手册来源中提取，并由此合成生成 107,543 个训练示例，涵盖翻译、语法、阅读理解和语义分类。为解决埃文语黏着形态导致的分词效率低下，我们提出一种三步分词器扩展算法，加入埃文语特定字素（eng、oe、o-umlaut）、白名单词汇和 BPE 合并，使每词平均词元数减少 27%（从 4.99 降至 3.64）。通过对 Qwen3-VL-4B 进行 LoRA 微调，我们将模型适配于文本任务（0.53% 可训练参数，秩 32），并单独适配于视觉问答（秩 64，冻结视觉编码器）。我们的最佳配置在文本基准上取得 11.4% 精确匹配和 13.6 加权分数，在句子翻译上取得 0.1283 chrF，在 VQA 上取得 65% 准确率（相较基础模型和纯文本微调的 0% 有所提升）。我们发布数据集、评估基准和训练流程，以支持对埃文语及其他低资源语言的进一步研究。

items.title_en: Informative Path Planning with Gaussian Processes: Error Bounds, Algorithms, and Benchmarks
items.title_zh: 基于高斯过程的信息路径规划：误差界、算法与基准
items.abstract_en: Accurate environmental monitoring relies on Informative Path Planning (IPP) to deploy autonomous systems that maximize information gain. While Gaussian Processes (GPs) provide a robust mathematical foundation for modeling the environment, contemporary IPP approaches remain hindered by heuristic operational constraints and the lack of simultaneous theoretical guarantees for worst-case estimation error and approximation quality. Rather than introducing yet another heuristic, this paper presents a rigorous theoretical analysis of existing error bounds and algorithms to further develop the mathematical foundation for IPP. By evaluating probabilistic and deterministic bounds on reconstruction error, we establish that predictive variance is the theoretically ideal optimization objective for GP-based IPP. Furthermore, we analyze GreedyCover, a recent approach for optimizing predictive variance, and demonstrate that its near-optimal approximation guarantee matches the fundamental hardness-of-approximation limit for the problem. Comprehensive benchmarking confirms that this approach delivers superior estimation accuracy and computational efficiency compared to prominent information-theoretic objectives and optimization methods used in IPP. Finally, this theoretical analysis establishes a rigorous, near-optimal foundation for discrete offline IPP under bounded uncertainty constraints, offering clear and principled guidance for future work in continuous-space and online formulations.
items.abstract_zh: 准确的环境监测依赖信息路径规划（IPP）来部署自主系统，以最大化信息增益。虽然高斯过程（GP）为环境建模提供了稳健的数学基础，但当代 IPP 方法仍受启发式操作约束的阻碍，并且缺乏对最坏情况估计误差和近似质量的同时理论保证。本文不引入又一个启发式方法，而是对现有误差界和算法进行严格理论分析，以进一步发展 IPP 的数学基础。通过评估重建误差的概率界和确定性界，我们确立预测方差是基于 GP 的 IPP 在理论上理想的优化目标。此外，我们分析 GreedyCover——一种近期用于优化预测方差的方法——并证明其近最优近似保证与该问题的基本近似硬度极限相匹配。综合基准测试确认，与 IPP 中使用的著名信息论目标和优化方法相比，该方法具有更优的估计精度和计算效率。最后，该理论分析为有界不确定性约束下的离散离线 IPP 建立了严格且近最优的基础，为连续空间和在线形式化的未来工作提供了清晰且有原则的指导。

items.title_en: Visual Cipher Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Visual Reasoning
items.title_zh: Visual Cipher Bench：对LLM智能体进行长时程视觉推理基准测试
items.abstract_en: While language-model agents excel at long-horizon coding and terminal tasks, this success relies on two conditions: explicit text specifications and immediate execution feedback. However, neither condition holds in real-world problems where critical information exists only in images, leaving it unclear whether long-horizon capability transfers from text to visual reasoning. In such visual settings, because rules and clues resist text transcription and lack test-case feedback, agents must repeatedly inspect images, simulate spatial transformations, and autonomously cross-check clues. Despite this challenge, existing evaluations fail to capture such capability: visual reasoning benchmarks largely reduce tasks to single-turn, short-chain question answering, whereas agent benchmarks focus on text-based environments or interactive states that permit trial-and-error. To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual Cipher Bench, a collection of 40 original visual puzzles across four categories: spatial manipulation and simulation, logical constraints and planning, rule induction, and knowledge-based decoding. Each puzzle provides only one to three black-and-white line drawings and a minimal submission instruction, requiring agents to discover the underlying solving mechanism entirely from the images. Across 29 reasoning-effort configurations of eight frontier models, even the strongest model, GPT-6 Astra (max), achieves only 26.7% accuracy, while five of the eight models score below 1%. Yet on a ten-task subset, providing a single non-spoiler mechanism hint boosts accuracy from 7.8% to 55.6%. This sharp contrast shows that the primary bottleneck of current agents lies not in executing multi-step plans, but in autonomously discovering rules from visual evidence. Visual Cipher Bench thus provides a rigorous benchmark for measuring long-horizon visual reasoning in agents.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管语言模型智能体在长时程编码和终端任务上表现出色，但这种成功依赖两个条件：显式文本规范和即时执行反馈。然而，在关键信息仅存在于图像中的现实问题里，这两个条件都不成立，因此尚不清楚长时程能力能否从文本迁移到视觉推理。在此类视觉环境中，由于规则和线索难以转写为文本且缺乏测试用例反馈，智能体必须反复检查图像、模拟空间变换并自主交叉核对线索。尽管存在这一挑战，现有评估未能捕捉这种能力：视觉推理基准大多将任务简化为单轮、短链问答，而智能体基准则聚焦于基于文本的环境或允许试错的交互状态。为弥合这一差距，我们提出Visual Cipher Bench，它包含40个原创视觉谜题，分为四类：空间操作与模拟、逻辑约束与规划、规则归纳以及基于知识的解码。每个谜题仅提供一到三幅黑白线条图和一条最少的提交说明，要求智能体完全从图像中发现底层求解机制。在八个前沿模型的29种推理努力配置中，即使最强的模型GPT-6 Astra（max）也仅达到26.7%的准确率，而八个模型中有五个得分低于1%。然而，在一个包含十个任务的子集上，提供一条非剧透的机制提示可将准确率从7.8%提升至55.6%。这种鲜明对比表明，当前智能体的主要瓶颈不在于执行多步计划，而在于从视觉证据中自主发现规则。因此，Visual Cipher Bench为衡量智能体的长时程视觉推理提供了严格的基准。

items.title_en: A Three-Dimensional Bioprinted Skin Melanoma Model for High-Throughput Drug Screening
items.title_zh: 用于高通量药物筛选的三维生物打印皮肤黑色素瘤模型
items.abstract_en: Melanoma is the deadliest form of skin cancer, and despite major advances in immunotherapy and targeted therapies, most patients with advanced disease eventually develop treatment resistance. The lack of physiologically relevant, scalable preclinical models that recapitulate the tumor microenvironment (TME) remains a major barrier to identifying more effective therapies. Here, we present a novel high-throughput screening platform based on a bioprinted, full-thickness human melanoma skin model that combines the biological complexity of native skin with the scalability required for drug discovery. The 3D tissue construct comprises a dermal region containing primary human dermal fibroblasts, melanoma tumor-like cell clusters localized at the dermal-epidermal interface, and an overlying differentiated epidermis composed of primary human keratinocytes cultured at the air-liquid interface, thereby recapitulating key structural and cellular features of the melanoma TME. To enable multiplexed, high-content analysis, melanoma cells and fibroblasts were engineered to express red and green fluorescent proteins, respectively, allowing automated confocal imaging to simultaneously quantify tumor growth and stromal viability. This dual-readout strategy provides an intrinsic counterscreen to distinguish melanoma-selective compounds from nonspecific cytotoxic agents. The assay was implemented in a 96-well bioprinted format compatible with high-throughput screening of compound libraries across multiple concentrations. Using this platform, we identified compounds that selectively reduced melanoma cell viability while sparing surrounding stromal cells, demonstrating the value of incorporating the TME into primary drug screens. By integrating bioprinting, human tissue engineering, and automated high-content imaging into a scalable workflow, this platform provides a robust and clinically relevant approach for melanoma therapeutic discovery and has the potential to improve the translation of preclinical findings into effective treatments for advanced melanoma.
items.abstract_zh: 黑色素瘤是致死性最高的皮肤癌，尽管免疫治疗和靶向治疗取得了重大进展，但大多数晚期疾病患者最终会产生治疗耐药性。缺乏可重现肿瘤微环境（TME）的生理相关、可扩展的临床前模型，仍是识别更有效疗法的主要障碍。在此，我们提出一种基于生物打印全层人黑色素瘤皮肤模型的新型高通量筛选平台，该模型将天然皮肤的生物学复杂性与药物发现所需的可扩展性相结合。该三维组织构建体包括：含有原代人真皮成纤维细胞的真皮区域、定位于真皮-表皮界面的黑色素瘤肿瘤样细胞簇，以及由气液界面培养的原代人角质形成细胞组成的上层分化表皮，从而重现黑色素瘤TME的关键结构和细胞特征。为实现多重、高内涵分析，黑色素瘤细胞和成纤维细胞分别被工程化表达红色和绿色荧光蛋白，使自动化共聚焦成像能够同时量化肿瘤生长和基质活力。这种双读出策略提供了一种内在的反筛，用于区分黑色素瘤选择性化合物与非特异性细胞毒性药物。该检测以96孔生物打印格式实施，兼容对化合物库在多个浓度下的高通量筛选。利用该平台，我们鉴定出能选择性降低黑色素瘤细胞活力而不损伤周围基质细胞的化合物，证明了将TME纳入初步药物筛选的价值。通过将生物打印、人体组织工程和自动化高内涵成像整合为可扩展的工作流程，该平台为黑色素瘤治疗发现提供了一种稳健且临床相关的方法，并有望改善临床前发现向晚期黑色素瘤有效治疗的转化。

items.title_en: Exact characterization of three-terminal fermion counting under one-body scattering
items.title_zh: 单体散射下三终端费米子计数的精确表征
items.abstract_en: Quantum scattering is a fundamental probe of the scattering region and the quantum dynamics of outgoing particles. In two terminals, the statistics of non-interacting fermions is described by a generalized binomial distribution, that arises from the Pauli exclusion principle, while deviations are a signature of interactions. In this work, we extend this result to a scattering region coupled to three outgoing terminals (or channels), obtaining exact bounds for the statistics of the outgoing fermions. In particular, for two fermions and three terminals, four inequalities involving six measured probabilities determine whether a non-interacting scatterer can explain the observed statistics. Applying these inequalities to recent scattering experiments in cold atoms, we are able to identify a regime where interactions have a significant contribution on the outgoing particles. Therefore, our work opens up the possibility of identifying fermion interactions at the nanoscale in systems that range from mesoscopic conductors to optical traps in cold atoms.
items.abstract_zh: 量子散射是探测散射区域及出射粒子量子动力学的基本手段。在两终端情形下，非相互作用费米子的统计由泡利不相容原理产生的广义二项分布描述，而偏离则成为相互作用的特征。在本工作中，我们将这一结果扩展到与三个出射终端（或通道）耦合的散射区域，获得了出射费米子统计的精确边界。特别地，对于两个费米子和三个终端，涉及六个测量概率的四个不等式决定了非相互作用散射体能否解释观测到的统计。将这些不等式应用于近期冷原子散射实验，我们能够识别出相互作用对出射粒子有显著贡献的区间。因此，我们的工作开辟了在从介观导体到冷原子光阱等系统中于纳米尺度识别费米子相互作用的可能性。

items.title_en: Flexible Intelligent Metasurfaces for Enhancing Secure MISO Communications
items.title_zh: 用于增强安全MISO通信的柔性智能超表面
items.abstract_en: This letter investigates flexible intelligent metasurface (FIM)-aided secure multiple-input single-output (MISO) communications in the presence of a multi-antenna eavesdropper. By exploiting the morphing capability of the FIM, the transmit array geometry can be dynamically reconfigured to reshape the legitimate and eavesdropping channels. We formulate a secrecy rate maximization (SRM) problem by jointly optimizing the transmit covariance matrix and the FIM surface shape. For a given FIM surface shape, the optimal transmit covariance matrix is shown to be rank one and is obtained in closed form from the dominant generalized eigenvector. For a fixed transmit covariance matrix, a projected gradient ascent (PGA) method is developed to optimize the FIM shape. Based on these two subproblems, a block coordinate ascent (BCA) algorithm is proposed. Moreover, for the special line-of-sight (LoS) scenario, we derive a globally optimal closed-form joint transmit covariance matrix and FIM surface shape design under a sufficient morphing-range condition. Numerical results demonstrate that FIM effectively improves the secrecy rate over a conventional rigid antenna array (RAA). Moreover, FIM achieves a transmit-power saving of about 2.5 dB compared with the RAA benchmark at the same secrecy rate.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究在多天线窃听者存在下，由柔性智能超表面（FIM）辅助的安全多输入单输出（MISO）通信。利用FIM的变形能力，可以动态重构发射阵列几何结构，以重塑合法信道和窃听信道。我们通过联合优化发射协方差矩阵和FIM表面形状，构建了保密速率最大化（SRM）问题。对于给定的FIM表面形状，最优发射协方差矩阵被证明为秩一，并由主广义特征向量以闭式获得。对于固定的发射协方差矩阵，开发了投影梯度上升（PGA）方法来优化FIM形状。基于这两个子问题，提出了块坐标上升（BCA）算法。此外，对于特殊的视距（LoS）场景，我们在充分变形范围条件下推导了全局最优的闭式联合发射协方差矩阵和FIM表面形状设计。数值结果表明，FIM相比传统刚性天线阵列（RAA）有效提高了保密速率。此外，在相同保密速率下，FIM相比RAA基准实现了约2.5 dB的发射功率节省。

items.title_en: Beyond Compressing Everything: Contrastive Memory Learning for Selective Context Compression
items.title_zh: 超越压缩一切：面向选择性上下文压缩的对比记忆学习
items.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) advance toward increasingly long inputs, soft context compression offers a promising approach to efficient inference by converting long inputs into compact memory slots. Under limited memory budgets, effective context compression remains challenging because task-relevant evidence varies substantially across queries, ranging from localized evidence to multiple distant spans or information dispersed throughout the full document. Instead of compressing everything indiscriminately, we propose CoMem, a query-guided selective context compression framework that learns memory representations conditioned on both the document and the query. CoMem develops Contrastive Compressor Learning to achieve query-sensitive yet context-preserving memory representations. To inject a strong prior over query-dependent evidence distributions, we devise a same-context hard negative mining strategy by pairing a single document with multiple queries, requiring the compressor to selectively retain information according to each query's distinct evidence needs. To address the restricted information flow imposed by causal masking, we further enable bidirectional attention among memory slots. Experiments demonstrate that CoMem consistently outperforms existing context compression methods across compression ratios on question answering and RULER-NIAH benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/scar-on/CoMem.
items.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）朝着越来越长的输入发展，软上下文压缩通过将长输入转换为紧凑记忆槽，为高效推理提供了一种有前景的方法。在有限记忆预算下，有效的上下文压缩仍然具有挑战性，因为任务相关证据在不同查询之间差异很大，从局部证据到多个相距较远的片段，或分散于整个文档中的信息。我们没有不加区分地压缩所有内容，而是提出CoMem，一种查询引导的选择性上下文压缩框架，它学习以文档和查询为条件的记忆表示。CoMem开发了对比压缩器学习，以实现查询敏感且保留上下文的记忆表示。为了注入关于查询相关证据分布的强先验，我们设计了一种同上下文难负样本挖掘策略，通过将单个文档与多个查询配对，要求压缩器根据每个查询不同的证据需求选择性保留信息。为解决因果掩码带来的信息流受限问题，我们进一步在记忆槽之间启用双向注意力。实验表明，在问答和RULER-NIAH基准上，CoMem在不同压缩比下始终优于现有上下文压缩方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/scar-on/CoMem获取。

items.title_en: RGB-D SLAM on the Edge: Benchmarking and Profiling RTAB-Map and ORB-SLAM3 on the Raspberry Pi 5
items.title_zh: 边缘端RGB-D SLAM：在树莓派5上对RTAB-Map和ORB-SLAM3进行基准测试与性能剖析
items.abstract_en: Micro aerial vehicles that operate without GPS often run SLAM on ARM-based edge boards, yet there is little published data on how standard RGB-D SLAM systems behave on such hardware. We benchmark RTAB-Map and ORB-SLAM3 on the Raspberry Pi 5 using six TUM RGB-D sequences at three image resolutions, recording tracking coverage, trajectory error, time per frame, memory, CPU load and temperature for every run, and we profile both systems at the stage and function level. RTAB-Map was configured to process and keep every frame, so its back end runs on every frame rather than at its default rate of 1 Hz. On the sequences that every configuration tracked, its front end takes 38-74 ms per frame and its full pipeline 150-462 ms, compared with 13-45 ms and 26-62 ms for ORB-SLAM3. RTAB-Map's main cost is optimizing a pose graph that keeps growing, because its working memory is unbounded by default; ORB-SLAM3's local bundle adjustment costs about as much as its tracking but runs in a parallel thread. At quarter resolution, both systems lose tracking on most sequences, and runs that lose tracking finish sooner and report lower error on the poses they keep, so time and accuracy must be read alongside coverage. Timing is repeatable to within 1-5%, but trajectory error varies by up to 27% between identical runs, so the accuracy differences between the two systems are inconclusive. No thermal throttling occurred.
items.abstract_zh: 在没有GPS的情况下运行的微型飞行器通常基于ARM边缘板运行SLAM，但关于标准RGB-D SLAM系统在此类硬件上的表现，已发表数据很少。我们在树莓派5上使用六个TUM RGB-D序列、三种图像分辨率对RTAB-Map和ORB-SLAM3进行基准测试，记录每次运行的跟踪覆盖率、轨迹误差、每帧时间、内存、CPU负载和温度，并在阶段和函数层面剖析这两个系统。RTAB-Map被配置为处理并保留每一帧，因此其后端在每一帧上运行，而不是按其默认的1 Hz速率运行。在所有配置都能跟踪的序列上，其前端每帧耗时38–74 ms，完整流水线耗时150–462 ms，而ORB-SLAM3分别为13–45 ms和26–62 ms。RTAB-Map的主要开销是优化一个不断增长的位姿图，因为其工作内存默认无界；ORB-SLAM3的局部光束法平差开销大约与其跟踪相当，但运行在并行线程中。在四分之一分辨率下，两个系统在大多数序列上都会丢失跟踪，而丢失跟踪的运行会更快结束，并且在其保留的位姿上报告更低的误差，因此时间和精度必须与覆盖率一起解读。计时可重复性在1–5%以内，但相同运行之间的轨迹误差变化高达27%，因此两个系统之间的精度差异尚无定论。未发生热降频。

items.title_en: Learning the Missing Derivative: Neural Multiple-Scattering Operators for Inverse Volume Rendering
items.title_zh: 学习缺失的导数：用于逆体积渲染的神经多重散射算子
items.abstract_en: Reconstructing optically thick media from photographs requires modeling multiple scattering and its response to changes in extinction. Frozen-source tomography discards this derivative; differentiable path tracing estimates it through expensive, noisy sampling. We instead predict the multiple-scattering field with a neural operator and differentiate through it during inverse rendering, while computing transmittance and single scattering directly. A further challenge arises during optimization: an operator that predicts the field accurately on held-out media can still produce poor derivatives at the density states visited by the optimizer. We address this by fine-tuning on states generated during inversions driven by the operator, using Monte Carlo scattering-field supervision. On held-out optically thick clouds, our method improves relighting over frozen-source tomography at equal time and outperforms differentiable path tracing given substantially more time. Training on inversion trajectories also improves derivative alignment at visited states and reduces optimization drift.
items.abstract_zh: 从照片重建光学厚介质需要建模多重散射及其对消光变化的响应。冻结源层析丢弃了该导数；可微路径追踪通过昂贵且含噪的采样来估计它。我们改为用神经算子预测多重散射场，并在逆渲染过程中通过该算子求导，同时直接计算透射率和单次散射。优化过程中还会出现另一个挑战：一个在留出介质上能准确预测场的算子，在优化器所访问的密度状态下仍可能产生较差的导数。我们通过在由该算子驱动的反演过程中生成的状态上进行微调，并使用蒙特卡洛散射场监督来解决这一问题。在留出的光学厚云上，我们的方法在相同时间下相比冻结源层析改善了重光照，并在给出显著更多时间时优于可微路径追踪。在反演轨迹上训练还改善了在访问状态处的导数对齐，并减少了优化漂移。

items.title_en: An expanded, phenotypically distinct tumor cell subset with low HPV mRNA increases recurrence risk
items.title_zh: 一个扩增的、表型独特的 HPV mRNA 低表达肿瘤细胞亚群增加复发风险
items.abstract_en: Human papillomavirus-related (HPV+) cancers harbor a subset of tumor cells expressing certain senescence-related transcripts and reduced levels of HPV mRNAs. We aimed to define this HPV-low population's biologic traits and clinical significance via integrated analysis of recurrence-prone human HPV+ oropharyngeal cancers (OPCs) and patient-derived xenografts (PDXs) of variable therapy sensitivity. Single-cell mRNA sequencing of PDXs and human tumors detected gene expression profiles in HPV-low cells indicating lack of senescence or terminal differentiation and intact tumorigenic capacity. HPV-low cells in cisplatin-refractory PDXs and particular human OPCs differentially upregulated multiple pathways linked to aggressive tumor biology, including RAS signaling, IL-6 signaling, and EMT. Predicted loss of cell-cell interactions among HPV-low cells reflected reduced epithelial identity, further supporting their more aggressive biology. Accordingly, the size of the pre-treatment HPV-low fraction had strong, independent association with recurrence risk. Genetic subclones within OPCs varied widely in content of HPV-low cells, which were enriched in particular lineages. Our findings uncover novel pro-tumor functions of HPV-low cells and support a central role for them in therapy resistance as well as potential utility as a clinical biomarker. Further elucidating mechanisms of cooperativity and plasticity between HPV-low and high states holds promise to reveal targets in treatment-refractory HPV+ malignancies.
items.abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒相关（HPV+）癌症包含一个肿瘤细胞亚群，其表达某些衰老相关转录本且 HPV mRNA 水平降低。我们旨在通过对易复发的人 HPV+ 口咽癌（OPCs）和治疗敏感性各异的患者来源异种移植瘤（PDXs）进行整合分析，界定这一 HPV 低表达群体的生物学特征和临床意义。对 PDXs 和人肿瘤的单细胞 mRNA 测序检测到，HPV 低表达细胞中的基因表达谱表明其缺乏衰老或终末分化，并具有完整的致瘤能力。在顺铂难治性 PDXs 和特定人 OPCs 中，HPV 低表达细胞差异性上调了多条与侵袭性肿瘤生物学相关的通路，包括 RAS 信号、IL-6 信号和 EMT。预测的 HPV 低表达细胞间细胞-细胞相互作用缺失反映了上皮身份降低，进一步支持其更具侵袭性的生物学。相应地，治疗前 HPV 低表达比例的大小与复发风险有强且独立的关联。OPCs 内的遗传亚克隆在 HPV 低表达细胞含量上差异很大，而这些细胞在特定谱系中富集。我们的发现揭示了 HPV 低表达细胞新的促肿瘤功能，并支持它们在治疗耐药中的核心作用以及作为临床生物标志物的潜在用途。进一步阐明 HPV 低表达和高表达状态之间协同性与可塑性的机制，有望揭示治疗难治性 HPV+ 恶性肿瘤的靶点。
