items.title_en: UV and deep-UV ultrafast harmonic generation enhanced by resonant gold nano-pillar metasurface
items.title_zh: 共振金纳米柱超表面增强的紫外与深紫外超快谐波产生
items.abstract_en: We report experimental observations and full-vector numerical simulations of second and third-harmonic generation from a two-dimensional periodic gold nano-pillar metasurface, for efficient ultrafast light conversion from near-infrared to the UV and deep-UV spectral ranges. The metasurface is designed to support an angle-tunable plasmonic resonance in the near-infrared spectral range, with its resonance wavelength shifting as a function of the pump angle of incidence. Under resonant conditions, strong electromagnetic-field confinement near the nano-pillar corners enhances the nonlinear light-matter interactions. Compared with a flat gold mirror, the nanostructured metal exhibits enhanced nonlinear frequency conversion, with conversion efficiencies of second and third-harmonic generation increased by two and three orders of magnitude, respectively. Full-wave theoretical modeling of linear and nonlinear light-matter interaction in nanoscale structures validates the experimental results. We demonstrate that periodically arranged square gold pillars can be engineered to achieve enhanced second and third-harmonic generation at wavelengths that can be tailored through the structural design, without requiring complex geometries or hybrid structures that pose fabrication challenges. The close agreement between theoretical predictions and experimental measurements further advances our understanding of surface-mediated nonlinear optical processes in metals and highlights the potential of metallic nanostructures as ultrafast light sources in the UV and deep-UV.
items.abstract_zh: 我们报道了二维周期性金纳米柱超表面的二次和三次谐波产生的实验观测与全矢量数值模拟，用于从近红外到紫外和深紫外光谱范围的高效超快光转换。该超表面设计为在近红外光谱范围内支持角度可调的等离激元共振，其共振波长随泵浦入射角变化而移动。在共振条件下，纳米柱角附近的强电磁场约束增强了非线性光-物质相互作用。与平坦金镜相比，纳米结构金属表现出增强的非线性频率转换，二次和三次谐波产生的转换效率分别提高两个和三个数量级。对纳米尺度结构中线性和非线性光-物质相互作用的全波理论建模验证了实验结果。我们证明，周期性排列的方形金柱可以被设计为在可通过结构设计定制的波长处实现增强的二次和三次谐波产生，而无需复杂几何结构或带来制造挑战的混合结构。理论预测与实验测量之间的高度一致进一步推进了我们对金属中表面介导非线性光学过程的理解，并突显了金属纳米结构作为紫外和深紫外超快光源的潜力。

items.title_en: MutAtlas: A PDB-Wide Energy-Guided Atlas of Protein Mutation Effects
items.title_zh: MutAtlas：全 PDB 能量引导的蛋白质突变效应图谱
items.abstract_en: Protein mutation effect prediction is fundamental to protein engineering and disease variant interpretation, yet experimentally measured mutation data remain accurate but extremely sparse. To provide scalable supplementary mutation signals, we construct a PDB-wide mutation augmentation dataset that exhaustively enumerates single-site substitutions on experimentally resolved protein structures and aligns mutation signals from physics-based energy models, protein language models, and inverse folding models. Large-scale analysis under a unified mutation preference representation reveals substantial differences in the consistency, concentration, and substitution patterns of mutation distributions across models, indicating that disagreement is pervasive and reflects conflicting inductive biases rather than random noise. Motivated by these observations, we propose an unsupervised multi-source mutation preference distillation framework that learns from relative mutation preferences while explicitly modeling cross-source disagreement. Without using any experimental mutation labels during training, our approach achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated zero-shot baselines and naive multi-source fusion strategies on ProteinGym. We release the dataset and evaluation pipeline to support reproducible studies of protein mutation effects.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质突变效应预测是蛋白质工程和疾病变异解读的基础，但实验测得的突变数据虽准确却极其稀疏。为提供可扩展的补充突变信号，我们构建了一个全 PDB 突变增强数据集，在实验解析的蛋白质结构上穷举单点替换，并整合来自基于物理的能量模型、蛋白质语言模型和逆折叠模型的突变信号。在统一的突变偏好表示下进行大规模分析，揭示了不同模型间突变分布的一致性、集中度和替换模式存在显著差异，表明分歧普遍存在，且反映的是相互冲突的归纳偏置而非随机噪声。受这些观察启发，我们提出一个无监督多源突变偏好蒸馏框架，它从相对突变偏好中学习，同时显式建模跨源分歧。训练期间不使用任何实验突变标签，我们的方法在 ProteinGym 上于所评估的零样本基线和朴素多源融合策略中取得最佳总体性能。我们发布数据集和评估流程，以支持蛋白质突变效应的可重复研究。

items.title_en: Benchmarking Multilingual Document Understanding in Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 视觉-语言模型的多语言文档理解基准评测
items.abstract_en: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform strongly on multimodal tasks, Document Understanding (DU) among them, but the benchmarks that measure them mostly cover English documents and narrow problems. How well current VLMs generalize across languages, tasks, styles and layouts therefore remains unclear. We introduce MDU, a multilingual DU benchmark of 23146 examples spanning 13 tasks and five languages: English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish. The tasks isolate complementary capabilities, from surface-level text and Markdown extraction through summarization, classification and named-entity recognition to layout-sensitive passage and layout extraction. We evaluate 45 state-of-the-art open-weight VLMs from 1.7B to 235B parameters, plus one commercial system under the same protocol. The benchmark is far from saturated: the best average is 69.0, only eight of the 45 evaluated systems reach 65, and the two best results come from 27B models rather than from the largest systems we evaluate. Performance is uneven in ways that scale does not fix. The gap between the strongest and weakest language does not close as models grow, and it survives controlling for the domain composition of each language. Capabilities also do not improve together: once we partial out overall model quality, per-task scores are largely uncorrelated, and transcription ability in particular trades off against semantic extraction.
items.abstract_zh: 近期的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在多模态任务（包括文档理解，DU）上表现强劲，但衡量它们的基准大多覆盖英文文档和狭窄问题。因此，当前 VLMs 在语言、任务、风格和版式之间的泛化能力仍不清楚。我们提出 MDU，一个包含 23146 个样本、跨越 13 项任务和五种语言（英语、法语、德语、意大利语和西班牙语）的多语言 DU 基准。这些任务分离出互补能力，从表层文本和 Markdown 提取，到摘要、分类和命名实体识别，再到对版式敏感的段落与版式提取。我们在同一协议下评估了 45 个参数规模从 1.7B 到 235B 的最先进开放权重 VLMs，外加一个商业系统。该基准远未饱和：最佳平均分为 69.0，45 个被评估系统中只有八个达到 65，且两个最佳结果来自 27B 模型，而不是我们评估的最大系统。性能的不均衡方式并非规模所能解决。最强与最弱语言之间的差距不会随模型增大而缩小，并且在控制每种语言的领域构成后仍然存在。各项能力也不会共同提升：一旦剔除整体模型质量，各任务得分基本不相关，尤其是文本转写能力与语义提取之间存在权衡。

items.title_en: QVS-LIVO RiskMap: Health- and Information-Aware View Selection for Multi-Camera LIVO and Off-Road Risk Mapping
items.title_zh: QVS-LIVO RiskMap：面向多相机 LIVO 和越野风险建图的健康与信息感知视图选择
items.abstract_en: Multi-camera observations in off-road environments vary significantly in reliability, posing challenges when complementing degraded geometric constraints. Motivated by this, we propose Quality-aware View Selection Lidar-Vision Odometry Risk Mapping (QVS-LIVO RiskMap), which decouples visual processing for state estimation from that for semantic mapping. The front end evaluates camera observations through read-only pretracking on a shared lidar-inertial posterior, combining observation health with geometric complementarity. Channel health memory and switching hysteresis govern selection of at most one eligible view for direct photometric correction. The posterior is retained when no view is eligible or the correction fails acceptance. The mapping back end integrates semantic observations from all available views in a shared world grid. Vehicle-scale geometry constrains semantic risk corrections, while spatial and temporal evidence supports risk confirmation. The system also produces a local bird's-eye-view (BEV) risk map and a global 2.5D semantic-terrain risk map with obstacle instance voxels. On two field sequences, QVS-LIVO achieved horizontal root mean square errors of 0.910 m and 1.664 m. It reduced error by 43.3% relative to FAST-LIO2 on the degraded long-route sequence. Across 12 controlled camera-fault configurations involving dropout, black frames and 60 ms timestamp shifts, it maintained complete trajectories with errors of 1.54-2.23 m. When deployed onboard an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, the system generates local and global maps at 9.94 Hz and 2.00 Hz, respectively, with a median local mapping latency of 32.4 ms. These runtime results demonstrate the real-time feasibility of selective visual state updates alongside multi-view semantic mapping under challenging off-road conditions. The code and related resources are available at: https://github.com/zihanPan-HIT/QVS-LIVO.
items.abstract_zh: 越野环境中的多相机观测在可靠性上差异显著，这给补充退化几何约束带来挑战。受此启发，我们提出质量感知视图选择激光雷达-视觉里程计风险建图（QVS-LIVO RiskMap），它将用于状态估计的视觉处理与用于语义建图的视觉处理解耦。前端通过在共享的激光雷达-惯性后验上进行只读预跟踪来评估相机观测，将观测健康度与几何互补性结合。通道健康记忆和切换迟滞控制至多选择一个合格视图用于直接光度校正。当没有视图合格或校正未通过接受时，保留该后验。建图后端在共享世界网格中整合来自所有可用视图的语义观测。车辆尺度几何约束语义风险校正，而空间和时间证据支持风险确认。系统还生成局部鸟瞰图（BEV）风险图，以及带有障碍物实例体素的全局 2.5D 语义地形风险图。在两条野外序列上，QVS-LIVO 实现了 0.910 m 和 1.664 m 的水平均方根误差。在退化的长路线序列上，它相对于 FAST-LIO2 将误差降低了 43.3%。在涉及丢帧、黑帧和 60 ms 时间戳偏移的 12 种受控相机故障配置中，它保持了完整轨迹，误差为 1.54–2.23 m。部署在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 上时，系统分别以 9.94 Hz 和 2.00 Hz 生成局部和全局地图，局部建图延迟中位数为 32.4 ms。这些运行结果表明，在具有挑战性的越野条件下，选择性视觉状态更新与多视图语义建图并行的实时可行性。代码和相关资源见：https://github.com/zihanPan-HIT/QVS-LIVO。

items.title_en: Learning-Based Interpolation of Detector Gaps in Photon-Counting X-ray Imaging
items.title_zh: 光子计数X射线成像中探测器间隙的基于学习插值
items.abstract_en: Image detectors assembled from tiled modules have physical gaps in the field of view that must be filled before downstream processing such as phase retrieval or tomographic reconstruction. Unlike natural-image inpainting, detector-gap interpolation must leave all other pixels unmodified and preserve the intensity statistics of the filled region, since even a small shift in mean intensity can cause ring artifacts after reconstruction. We adapted two generative models, a Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty (WGAN-GP) and a conditional Pix2Pix model, to this task. We implemented a masking strategy that restricts all changes to the gap pixels and loss terms that constrain the mean intensity and the intensity distribution of the filled region. Both models were trained on nanoCT projections with simulated gaps and compared with linear interpolation, Navier--Stokes inpainting, and the deep image-inpainting network MADF, quantitatively on simulated gaps and visually on real detector gaps. WGAN-GP and Pix2Pix achieved the best perceptual similarity (LPIPS) and histogram distance and, apart from linear interpolation, the shortest inference time. Pix2Pix required about five times fewer training GPU-hours than WGAN-GP. Ablation studies showed that masking the network output contributes by far the most to plausible inpainting results. Applied to sinograms, Pix2Pix produced the most natural gap filling but improved the reconstruction only slightly compared with linear interpolation. The source code and the weights of the final Pix2Pix model are available at https://github.com/J-3TO/detectorGapRemoval_Pix2Pix.
items.abstract_zh: 由拼接模块组装而成的图像探测器在视场中存在物理间隙，这些间隙必须在相位恢复或断层重建等下游处理之前被填充。与自然图像修复不同，探测器间隙插值必须使所有其他像素保持不变，并保持填充区域的强度统计特性，因为平均强度的微小偏移也可能在重建后引起环形伪影。我们将两种生成模型——带梯度惩罚的Wasserstein GAN（WGAN-GP）和条件Pix2Pix模型——适配到该任务。我们实现了一种掩蔽策略，将所有变化限制在间隙像素，并实现了约束填充区域平均强度和强度分布的损失项。两个模型均在带有模拟间隙的nanoCT投影上训练，并与线性插值、Navier--Stokes修复以及深度图像修复网络MADF进行比较：在模拟间隙上进行定量比较，在真实探测器间隙上进行视觉比较。WGAN-GP和Pix2Pix取得了最佳的感知相似性（LPIPS）和直方图距离，并且除线性插值外具有最短的推理时间。Pix2Pix所需的训练GPU小时数约为WGAN-GP的五分之一。消融研究表明，对网络输出进行掩蔽对产生合理的修复结果的贡献最大。应用于正弦图时，Pix2Pix产生了最自然的间隙填充，但与线性插值相比仅略微改善了重建结果。源代码和最终Pix2Pix模型的权重可在 https://github.com/J-3TO/detectorGapRemoval_Pix2Pix 获取。

items.title_en: Genetic Determinants of Disease Trajectory in Sarcoidosis
items.title_zh: 结节病疾病轨迹的遗传决定因素
items.abstract_en: Background: Sarcoidosis represents a complex inflammatory condition of unknown origin, characterized by diverse clinical profiles, particularly identifiable as Lofgren's syndrome (LS) and non-LS cases. Delving into the genetic underpinnings of chronic sarcoidosis phenotypes is essential for advancing our understanding and treatment of this disease. Methods: To classify chronicity, pulmonologists evaluated sarcoidosis phenotypes over a follow-up period of two years, distinguishing between chronic and nonchronic classifications. We assessed the genetics of these chronicity phenotypes in a Swedish cohort of 1,515 sarcoidosis cases (679 nonchronic and 836 chronic) alongside 3,085 controls using the Immunochip array. To confirm our findings, replication analysis was conducted in a German cohort of 1,216 sarcoidosis cases (485 nonchronic and 731 chronic) and 3,042 controls. A comprehensive meta-analysis of significant SNPs (p < 5e-8) was carried out using inverse variance weighting. Additionally, we employed gene-based analysis, enrichment mapping, and pathway analysis to gain deeper functional insights. Results: Our meta analysis uncovered significant genetic associations with chronic sarcoidosis phenotypes, including LS nonchronic (rs3135356; OR = 3.13, 95% CI: 2.38 - 4.12), nonLS nonchronic (rs2395162; OR = 2.34, 95% CI: 1.96 - 2.85), and nonLS chronic cases (rs1049550; OR = 0.68, 95% CI: 0.59 - 0.76). Specifically, gene based analysis revealed that CLIC1 is associated with nonchronic forms, while ANXA11 is linked to the chronic phenotype. Our enrichment analysis highlighted the expression of quantitative trait loci (eQTLs) in immune cells, whole blood, and lung tissues. The pathway analysis pinpointed the antigen presentation pathway as vital to understanding chronicity phenotypes. Conclusions: This study illuminates the distinct genomic features that differentiate chronic sarcoidosis phenotypes, underscoring the critical involvement of immune-related genes and regulatory networks. By advancing the knowledge of sarcoidosis chronicity, these findings pave the way for targeted therapeutic interventions and personalized treatment strategies that can significantly improve patient outcomes.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：结节病是一种病因未知的复杂炎症性疾病，具有多样的临床特征，尤其可识别为Lofgren综合征（LS）和非LS病例。深入研究慢性结节病表型的遗传基础对于推进对该疾病的理解和治疗至关重要。方法：为了对慢性性进行分类，肺科医生在为期两年的随访期内评估结节病表型，区分慢性和非慢性分类。我们在一个包含1,515例结节病病例（679例非慢性，836例慢性）和3,085名对照的瑞典队列中，使用Immunochip阵列评估了这些慢性性表型的遗传学。为确认我们的发现，在一个包含1,216例结节病病例（485例非慢性，731例慢性）和3,042名对照的德国队列中进行了复制分析。使用逆方差加权对显著SNP（p < 5e-8）进行了全面的荟萃分析。此外，我们采用了基于基因的分析、富集映射和通路分析，以获得更深入的功能见解。结果：我们的荟萃分析发现了与慢性结节病表型显著相关的遗传关联，包括LS非慢性（rs3135356；OR = 3.13，95% CI：2.38 - 4.12）、非LS非慢性（rs2395162；OR = 2.34，95% CI：1.96 - 2.85）和非LS慢性病例（rs1049550；OR = 0.68，95% CI：0.59 - 0.76）。具体而言，基于基因的分析显示CLIC1与非慢性形式相关，而ANXA11与慢性表型相关。我们的富集分析突出了表达数量性状位点（eQTLs）在免疫细胞、全血和肺组织中的表达。通路分析指出抗原呈递通路对理解慢性性表型至关重要。结论：本研究阐明了区分慢性结节病表型的独特基因组特征，强调了免疫相关基因和调控网络的关键参与。通过增进对结节病慢性性的认识，这些发现为靶向治疗干预和个性化治疗策略铺平了道路，这些策略可显著改善患者结局。

items.title_en: Entanglement detection from moments of the realigned state: application to continuous-variable quantum systems
items.title_zh: 从重排态的矩进行纠缠检测：在连续变量量子系统中的应用
items.abstract_en: Certifying entanglement is a central problem in quantum information sciences, especially for continuous-variable quantum systems where full state tomography is experimentally demanding. We introduce a family of separability criteria based on the singular moments and weak moments of the operator obtained by applying the realignment map to the density operator. In practice, we find that the criterion based on the second-order moments of the realigned operator is already sufficient to witness the entanglement of a wide range of quantum optical states. The realigned moments can be readily accessed using an optical scheme consisting of a linear interferometer that couples several identical copies of the state, similarly to the multicopy technique used to measure the partial-transpose moments of a state [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 033064 (2026)]. We illustrate the detection capability of the second-order realigned-moment method for both Gaussian and non-Gaussian states, including lossy NOON states.
items.abstract_zh: 认证纠缠是量子信息科学中的一个核心问题，尤其是对于连续变量量子系统，其中完整状态层析在实验上要求很高。我们引入了一类可分性判据，基于对密度算符应用重排映射所得算符的奇异矩和弱矩。在实践中，我们发现基于重排算符二阶矩的判据已足以见证广泛的量子光学态的纠缠。重排矩可以使用由线性干涉仪组成的光学方案方便地获取，该干涉仪耦合该状态的若干相同副本，类似于用于测量状态部分转置矩的多副本技术 [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 033064 (2026)]。我们展示了二阶重排矩方法对高斯态和非高斯态（包括有损NOON态）的检测能力。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为光学器件与计算，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Bilayer Periodically Poled Piezoelectric Thin-Film Lithium Tantalate Platform for Passive-Layer-Free Flexural and Torsional Actuation
items.title_zh: 用于无无源层弯曲与扭转驱动的双层周期极化压电薄膜钽酸锂平台
items.abstract_en: This work demonstrates, to the best of our knowledge, the first passive-layer-free thin-film lithium tantalate (LT) actuator platform, supporting both out-of-plane flexural and in-plane torsional actuation from a single bilayer periodically poled piezoelectric film (P3F) X-cut LT stack. The polarity reversal across the bond interface flips the piezoelectric stress below the neutral axis, generating a bending moment without any passive elastic layer. Moreover, the two layers share identical elastic and thermal-expansion constants, making the stack thermally matched by construction. Suspended cantilever devices were fabricated on a single 2$\times$1.5 $μ$m X-cut LT stack and verified by laser Doppler vibrometry (LDV). The tapered flexural resonator exhibits a 5.5$\times$ tip velocity amplification and a measured peak tip velocity of 10.3 m/s at $Q=634$, and a 0.49 MHz torsional cantilever resonator with $Q=514$ is demonstrated on the same stack. These results position bilayer P3F LT as a thermally matched, passive-layer-free actuation platform for vacuum-operated and optically interrogated MEMS such as scanners, gyroscopes, and ultrasonic transducers.
items.abstract_zh: 据我们所知，本工作展示了首个无无源层的薄膜钽酸锂（LT）驱动器平台，可从单个双层周期极化压电薄膜（P3F）X切LT叠层支持面外弯曲和面内扭转驱动。跨键合界面的极性反转使中性轴下方的压电应力翻转，从而在没有任何无源弹性层的情况下产生弯矩。此外，两层具有相同的弹性和热膨胀常数，使得该叠层在结构上天然热匹配。在单个2×1.5 μm X切LT叠层上制造了悬空悬臂梁器件，并通过激光多普勒振动计（LDV）进行了验证。锥形弯曲谐振器表现出5.5倍的尖端速度放大，在 Q=634 时测得峰值尖端速度为10.3 m/s，并且在同一叠层上展示了 Q=514 的0.49 MHz扭转悬臂谐振器。这些结果将双层P3F LT定位为一种热匹配、无无源层的驱动平台，适用于真空操作和光学询问的MEMS，如扫描仪、陀螺仪和超声换能器。

items.title_en: From Large Language Models to Efficient System One Models via Adaptive Computation
items.title_zh: 通过自适应计算从大语言模型到高效 System One 模型
items.abstract_en: Transferring LLMs into System One decision models typically replaces the language modeling head with a decision head while retaining the full backbone, making every decision pay for all layers. Yet it remains unclear how much depth such decisions require. We find that decision information is concentrated in intermediate layers, with early layers building essential features and the final six layers removable without loss, while independently trained smaller models largely mimic the full model rather than developing specialized decision capabilities. These findings suggest that efficiency requires not simply smaller backbones, but shared computation across different depths. Building on this, we propose \method{}, which jointly trains a full model with prefix sub-models that share its final layers and decision head through self-distillation. A lightweight gate reads the hidden state at each exit to determine whether additional computation is needed, allowing one model to operate at multiple layers. Across seven decision benchmarks, our approach matches or outperforms independently trained models at every depth, while achieving better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs through adaptive computation.
items.abstract_zh: 将LLM转换为System One决策模型通常会用决策头替换语言建模头，同时保留完整骨干，使得每个决策都要付出所有层的代价。然而，此类决策需要多少深度仍不清楚。我们发现决策信息集中在中间层，早期层构建必要特征，最后六层可以在无损失的情况下移除，而独立训练的较小模型在很大程度上模仿完整模型，而不是发展出专门的决策能力。这些发现表明，效率不仅需要更小的骨干，还需要跨不同深度的共享计算。在此基础上，我们提出 \method{}，它通过自蒸馏联合训练一个完整模型和共享其最终层与决策头的前缀子模型。一个轻量级门控读取每个出口处的隐藏状态，以确定是否需要额外计算，从而使一个模型能够在多个层上运行。在七个决策基准上，我们的方法在每个深度上匹配或优于独立训练的模型，同时通过自适应计算实现更好的准确率-效率权衡。

items.title_en: FloCOS: Predicting Compact Forward Occupancy Sets of Surrounding Vehicles via Conditional Flow Matching
items.title_zh: FloCOS：通过条件流匹配预测周围车辆的紧凑前向占用集
items.abstract_en: Existing methods for predicting surrounding vehicles' forward occupancy may under-approximate the ground-truth occupancy, exposing the ego vehicle to collision risk, or produce overly conservative regions that unnecessarily restrict feasible space and cause planning failures. To address these issues, we propose FloCOS, a conditional flow-matching framework that predicts compact forward occupancy sets with high occupancy coverage. FloCOS represents the forward occupancy set as a time-varying union of half-space convex polygons parameterized by temporal basis coefficients. Conditional flow matching captures the conditional distribution of these coefficients to govern the temporal evolution of the convex components, trained under coverage and union-area losses that penalize missed occupancy and excess area. For downstream trajectory optimization, the predicted nonconvex union is directly incorporated into hyperplane-based collision-avoidance constraints. Evaluations on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset show that FloCOS generates compact forward occupancy sets with high coverage and achieves a higher interaction completion rate than evaluated baselines. Real-world vehicle experiments further confirm its ability to support collision-free planning in interactive scenarios.
items.abstract_zh: 现有预测周围车辆前向占用的方法可能低估真值占用，使自车面临碰撞风险，或产生过度保守的区域，不必要地限制可行空间并导致规划失败。为解决这些问题，我们提出FloCOS，一个条件流匹配框架，可预测具有高占用覆盖率的紧凑前向占用集。FloCOS将前向占用集表示为半空间凸多边形的时变并集，这些多边形由时间基系数参数化。条件流匹配捕获这些系数的条件分布，以支配凸分量的时间演化，并在覆盖损失和并集面积损失下训练，这些损失惩罚遗漏占用和多余面积。对于下游轨迹优化，预测的非凸并集被直接纳入基于超平面的避碰约束。在Waymo Open Motion Dataset上的评估表明，FloCOS生成具有高覆盖率的紧凑前向占用集，并比所评估的基线实现更高的交互完成率。真实车辆实验进一步证实了其在交互场景中支持无碰撞规划的能力。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models
items.title_zh: TTB：用于仅解码器视图合成模型高效渲染的测试时烘焙
items.abstract_en: Decoder-only Large View Synthesis Models (LVSMs) with KV-cache have recently achieved state-of-the-art quality by regressing novel views from neural networks without reconstructing 3D geometry, while Test-Time Training (TTT) layers save computation but sacrifice quality. We propose Test-Time Baking (TTB), a strategy that learns to bake global scene information from cross-view attention into a lightweight MLP, enabling fast and high-fidelity novel-view decoding. The first key is to repurpose the fast-weight MLP of TTT to learn the cross-view attention mapping explicitly from its input-output pairs, rather than replacing attention entirely, achieving the same rendering efficiency as TTT while delivering substantially higher quality. The second key addresses a modality misalignment between context prefilling and novel-view rendering: we disentangle context tokens into camera-only context rendering tokens to serve as TTB input, and context ground-truth tokens with image content to serve as the TTB mapping target, ensuring the baked MLPs are relieved of the modality generalization challenge between context and novel-view processing. Our method achieves up to **23x** rendering speedup with quality on par with the state-of-the-art across several benchmarks. Project page: https://test-time-baking.github.io
items.abstract_zh: 带有KV-cache的仅解码器大型视图合成模型（LVSMs）近期通过从神经网络回归新视图而不重建3D几何，取得了最先进的质量，而测试时训练（TTT）层节省了计算但牺牲了质量。我们提出测试时烘焙（TTB），一种学习将来自跨视图注意力的全局场景信息烘焙到轻量级MLP中的策略，从而实现快速且高保真的新视图解码。第一个关键点是复用TTT的快速权重MLP，从其输入-输出对中显式学习跨视图注意力映射，而不是完全替代注意力，从而在达到与TTT相同渲染效率的同时提供显著更高的质量。第二个关键点解决了上下文预填充与新视图渲染之间的模态错配：我们将上下文token解耦为仅相机上下文渲染token以作为TTB输入，以及带有图像内容的上下文真值token以作为TTB映射目标，确保烘焙后的MLP免于上下文与新视图处理之间的模态泛化挑战。我们的方法在多个基准上实现了高达23倍的渲染加速，质量与最先进方法相当。项目页面：https://test-time-baking.github.io

items.title_en: Monocyte-to-lymphocyte and Platelet-to-lymphocyte ratios in Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorders: systematic review and meta-analysis
items.title_zh: 视神经脊髓炎谱系疾病中的单核细胞与淋巴细胞比值和血小板与淋巴细胞比值：系统综述与荟萃分析
items.abstract_en: Background: Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorders (NMOSD) are a group of neuroinflammatory conditions that affect the nervous system. MLR and PLR are simple inflammatory biomarkers and are studied in many autoimmune and demyelinating diseases. In this study, we investigate the available evidence to determine whether MLR and PLR are higher in NMOSD patients than in healthy subjects. Methods: Systematic review and meta-analysis of studies measuring levels of PLR and/or MLR in both NMOSD patients and healthy controls were conducted. Mean difference (MD) and 95% confidence interval (CI) were used to measure the difference in levels of MLR and PLR between patients and healthy subjects. Results: For MLR, the main meta-analysis yielded a pooled MD of 0.125 [-0.114; 0.363]. I2 was 83.8%. Subgroup meta-analysis of age- and sex-matched studies, demonstrated a pooled MD of 0.066 [0.012; 0.12]. For PLR, meta-analysis revealed a pooled MD of 23.99 [6.03; 41.96]. I2 was 82.3%. Subgroup analysis for age- and sex-matched studies for PLR, showed a pooled MD of 14 [-19.68; 47.68]. Conclusion: The main analysis suggests that MLR is not higher in NMOSD patients than in healthy controls. However, subgroup analysis of age- and sex-matched studies and leave-one-out analysis excluding the outlier study showed a statistically significant MLR increase in patients. PLR was found to exhibit a modest increase in NMOSD patients compared with healthy controls. Nonetheless, subgroup analysis of age- and sex-matched studies showed a statistically non-significant increase. Results should be interpreted cautiously. The available evidence is inconsistent and further research is needed.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：视神经脊髓炎谱系疾病（NMOSD）是一组影响神经系统的神经炎症性疾病。MLR和PLR是简单的炎症生物标志物，已在许多自身免疫性和脱髓鞘疾病中研究。在本研究中，我们调查现有证据，以确定NMOSD患者的MLR和PLR是否高于健康受试者。方法：对同时测量NMOSD患者和健康对照者PLR和/或MLR水平的研究进行系统综述与荟萃分析。使用均数差（MD）和95%置信区间（CI）衡量患者与健康受试者之间MLR和PLR水平的差异。结果：对于MLR，主荟萃分析得出合并MD为0.125 [-0.114; 0.363]。I2为83.8%。对年龄和性别匹配研究的亚组荟萃分析显示合并MD为0.066 [0.012; 0.12]。对于PLR，荟萃分析显示合并MD为23.99 [6.03; 41.96]。I2为82.3%。针对PLR的年龄和性别匹配研究的亚组分析显示合并MD为14 [-19.68; 47.68]。结论：主分析提示NMOSD患者的MLR并不高于健康对照。然而，年龄和性别匹配研究的亚组分析以及排除离群研究的留一法分析显示，患者MLR升高具有统计学显著性。与健康对照相比，发现NMOSD患者的PLR呈适度升高。尽管如此，年龄和性别匹配研究的亚组分析显示升高在统计学上不显著。结果应谨慎解读。现有证据不一致，需要进一步研究。

items.title_en: Monolayer MoSe2 as an Attenuator of Spintronic Terahertz Emission
items.title_zh: 单层MoSe2作为自旋电子太赫兹发射的衰减器
items.abstract_en: Understanding ultrafast spin-to-charge conversion at ferromagnetic/2D interfaces is critical for developing THz-frequency spintronic devices such as ultrafast memories, sensors, and compact THz sources. We investigate this by studying spintronic THz emission (STE) from Py/Au heterostructures capped with transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) monolayer MoSe2 using time-domain THz spectroscopy. We observe a pronounced reduction in emitted THz amplitude when a monolayer MoSe2 flake covers Py/Au or Py/Pt emitters compared with uncovered regions. A consistent, approximately fourfold attenuation occurs for both systems, despite an order-of-magnitude larger THz radiation from the bare Py/Pt emitter. These results indicate that the suppression is independent of emitter strength. We attribute the attenuation to THz absorption by free charge carriers and trions that are either present due to charge transfer from the metallic layer or photoexcited by the laser pulse, which can significantly diminish the detectable STE signal. This finding provides an explanation for the discrepancy between weak STE signals from FM/TMD heterostructures and magnetotransport reports of sizable spin-orbit torques in similar systems, and highlights the need to account for photoinduced THz attenuation when interpreting ultrafast spin-to-charge conversion measurements in 2D TMD heterostructures.
items.abstract_zh: 理解铁磁/二维界面处的超快自旋-电荷转换对于开发太赫兹频率的自旋电子器件（如超快存储器、传感器和紧凑型太赫兹源）至关重要。我们通过使用时域太赫兹光谱研究以过渡金属硫族化物（TMD）单层MoSe2覆盖的Py/Au异质结构的自旋电子太赫兹发射（STE）来研究这一点。我们观察到，与未覆盖区域相比，当单层MoSe2薄片覆盖Py/Au或Py/Pt发射器时，发射的太赫兹振幅显著降低。尽管裸Py/Pt发射器的太赫兹辐射高一个数量级，两种体系均出现一致的约四倍衰减。这些结果表明，抑制与发射器强度无关。我们将衰减归因于自由电荷载流子和三激子的太赫兹吸收，这些载流子要么由于来自金属层的电荷转移而存在，要么被激光脉冲光激发，从而可显著减弱可检测的STE信号。这一发现为FM/TMD异质结构的弱STE信号与类似体系中磁输运报道的可观自旋轨道力矩之间的差异提供了解释，并强调在解释二维TMD异质结构中的超快自旋-电荷转换测量时需要考虑光诱导的太赫兹衰减。

items.title_en: Full-Duplex Communication for Pinching Antenna Systems
items.title_zh: 夹持天线系统的全双工通信
items.abstract_en: This paper investigates multiuser full-duplex (FD) communication assisted by a multiwaveguide pinching-antenna system (PASS) where each dielectric waveguide can be dynamically configured to operate in either downlink transmission or uplink reception mode. We develop a channel model that accounts for in-waveguide power attenuation and cumulative pinching antenna (PA)-induced phase shift. Building on this model, we jointly optimize the waveguide modes, PA locations, PA radiation/collection coefficients, downlink beamformers, uplink receive combiners, and uplink transmit powers to maximize the downlink weighted sum-rate (WSR) subject to uplink quality-of-service (QoS) requirements and power constraints. To tackle the resulting mixed-integer nonconvex resource allocation problem, we propose a low-complexity hierarchical block coordinate descent algorithm that capitalizes on weighted minimum mean-square error, fractional programming, majorization-minimization, and the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) to obtain a high-quality suboptimal solution. Simulations demonstrate that the proposed FD-PASS outperforms an FD base station equipped with fixed antennas and exhibits greater robustness against residual self-interference. Moreover, ignoring cumulative PA-induced phase shifts can produce QoS-infeasible designs.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由多波导夹持天线系统（PASS）辅助的多用户全双工（FD）通信，其中每个介质波导可动态配置为在下行传输或上行接收模式下工作。我们建立了一个信道模型，考虑了波导内功率衰减和累积的夹持天线（PA）引起的相移。基于该模型，我们联合优化波导模式、PA位置、PA辐射/收集系数、下行波束成形器、上行接收合并器以及上行发射功率，以在上行服务质量（QoS）要求和功率约束下最大化下行加权和速率（WSR）。为解决由此产生的混合整数非凸资源分配问题，我们提出一种低复杂度的分层块坐标下降算法，利用加权最小均方误差、分式规划、主化-最小化以及交替方向乘子法（ADMM）来获得高质量次优解。仿真表明，所提出的FD-PASS优于配备固定天线的FD基站，并且对残余自干扰具有更强的鲁棒性。此外，忽略累积的PA引起相移可能产生QoS不可行的设计。

items.title_en: CoReMem: Cost-Internalizing Memory for Successive Coding Tasks with Prospective Valuation
items.title_zh: CoReMem：具有前瞻性估值的面向连续编码任务的成本内化记忆
items.abstract_en: Coding agents tackle successive tasks on an evolving repository, carrying forward edits and writing memory before the next task is known. Selecting memory for unknown next tasks requires balancing future usefulness against the costs of writing and reading it. The actor must also decide when acting on available memory saves effort as the task unfolds. We introduce Coding-Repository Memory (CoReMem), a cost-internalizing framework that guides memory design and actor adaptation through measured memory value on the next task. Prospective segment valuation compares runs of the next task with and without individual trajectory segments from the same inherited repository state, guiding a compact memory built around anchors: repository locations and executable checks. Actor adaptation estimates on-policy memory value within rollout groups with and without memory, using a reward that prioritizes resolution and penalizes step count in successful runs. Provenance-gated value credit assigns the additional value term to steps identified as using memory-supplied anchors, while every step retains outcome credit. On ChainSWE, CoReMem raises the 27B actor's resolve rate from 21.0% to 25.7%, with 17% fewer steps and 11% fewer total cache-aware tokens, including memory-module calls, relative to the untrained actor model without memory.
items.abstract_zh: 编码智能体在不断演化的代码仓库上处理连续任务，在下一个任务已知之前延续编辑并写入记忆。为未知的下一任务选择记忆需要在未来有用性与写入和读取它的成本之间进行权衡。行动者还必须决定在任务展开时何时依据可用记忆采取行动以节省精力。我们引入编码-仓库记忆（CoReMem），一个成本内化框架，通过测量记忆在下一任务上的价值来指导记忆设计和行动者适应。前瞻性片段估值比较在相同继承仓库状态下，下一任务运行中有无单个轨迹片段的情况，指导围绕锚点构建紧凑记忆：仓库位置和可执行检查。行动者适应在有无记忆的 rollout 组内估计在策略记忆价值，使用优先考虑解决并惩罚成功运行中步数的奖励。来源门控价值信用将额外价值项分配给被识别为使用记忆提供锚点的步骤，而每一步都保留结果信用。在ChainSWE上，CoReMem将27B行动者的解决率从21.0%提高到25.7%，相对于无记忆的未训练行动者模型，步数减少17%，总缓存感知token减少11%（包括记忆模块调用）。

items.title_en: A physics-constrained deep reinforcement learning method for autonomous mission planning of Titan deep space probes
items.title_zh: 一种用于土卫六深空探测器自主任务规划的物理约束深度强化学习方法
items.abstract_en: Titan is a compelling target for future deep space exploration, while its extreme Earth-Titan distance and complex environment make continuous ground-in-the-loop planning impractical. Existing planning methods, primarily developed for Earth-observation scenarios, have limited generalizability to uncertain deep space conditions and adaptability to time-varying mission states. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a physics-constrained maskable proximal policy optimization (PCM-PPO) method for Titan autonomous mission planning. A Titan-specific discrete-time Markov decision process is established to characterize mission feasibility and resource constraints. A system dynamics and geometric model is incorporated to enhance physical representation, including central gravity, J2 perturbation, third-body attraction, and downlink occultation. To accommodate opportunity targets under a bounded action dimension, PCM-PPO organizes predefined and opportunity targets through a fixed-capacity target pool and represents the mission state with a target-wise state matrix and a global state vector. A physics-constrained action mask constructs an admissible decision domain from current mission states, guiding policy learning toward physically executable decisions and avoiding infeasible exploration. An integrated training strategy facilitates policy optimization under coupled constraints. Comparative, ablation, and uncertainty experiments validate the effectiveness of PCM-PPO. PCM-PPO provides a feasible and interpretable scheme for autonomous mission planning of Titan deep space probes.
items.abstract_zh: 土卫六是未来深空探索的一个引人注目的目标，而其极端的地球-土卫六距离和复杂环境使持续的地面在环规划不切实际。现有规划方法主要针对地球观测场景开发，对不确定深空条件的泛化能力以及对时变任务状态的适应能力有限。为应对这些挑战，本文提出一种物理约束可掩码近端策略优化（PCM-PPO）方法，用于土卫六自主任务规划。建立了土卫六特定的离散时间马尔可夫决策过程，以刻画任务可行性和资源约束。引入系统动力学与几何模型以增强物理表征，包括中心引力、J2摄动、第三体引力和下行链路遮挡。为在有界动作维度下容纳机会目标，PCM-PPO通过固定容量目标池组织预定义目标和机会目标，并用逐目标状态矩阵和全局状态向量表示任务状态。物理约束动作掩码从当前任务状态构建可允许决策域，引导策略学习朝向物理上可执行的决策，并避免不可行探索。集成训练策略促进耦合约束下的策略优化。对比、消融和不确定性实验验证了PCM-PPO的有效性。PCM-PPO为土卫六深空探测器的自主任务规划提供了一种可行且可解释的方案。

items.title_en: STeP-C: Real-Time Neural Compression for Distributed Fiber-Optic Sensing at Scale
items.title_zh: STeP-C：面向大规模分布式光纤传感的实时神经压缩
items.abstract_en: Distributed fiber-optic sensing (DFOS) technologies such as Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) generate continuous, high-resolution spatio-temporal data at rates exceeding hundreds of megabytes per second, creating severe challenges for real-time storage and transmission. While neural compression methods can achieve strong rate-distortion performance on sensing data, prior approaches either require per-segment retraining incompatible with streaming, or have only been validated offline. None have been demonstrated end-to-end on a continuously streaming DAS acquisition system at scale. We present STeP-C (Spatio-Temporal Predictive Compression), a neural compression framework that decouples spatial encoding, temporal prediction, and entropy-optimized residual coding, trained end-to-end with a rate-distortion objective motivated by conditional entropy reduction. Critically, we identify entropy coding as the dominant bottleneck for streaming deployment. We address it through GPU-side symbol computation, cached probability tables, and parallel GIL-free arithmetic coding, together with FP16 inference and batched entropy coding, enabling a full real-time pipeline built around a GPU ring buffer. We validate this pipeline on a live DAS testbed, achieving a 98.85% file size reduction at 31.04 dB full-band PSNR and an average throughput of 535 MB/s, exceeding the 324 MB/s requirement for 1 kHz, 81 km DAS streams. We further show that STeP-C substantially outperforms conventional codecs at practical streaming bitrates, can be applied to unseen channel ranges within the same acquisition system without retraining, and largely maintains downstream detector consistency, with 96.62% high-confidence class agreement and 100% Jaccard similarity on detected event types.
items.abstract_zh: 分布式光纤传感（DFOS）技术，如分布式声学传感（DAS），以超过每秒数百兆字节的速率生成连续的高分辨率时空数据，给实时存储和传输带来严峻挑战。虽然神经压缩方法可以在传感数据上实现很强的率失真性能，但先前方法要么需要逐段重新训练而不兼容流式处理，要么仅在离线环境中得到验证。尚未有方法在持续流式DAS采集系统上大规模端到端演示。我们提出STeP-C（时空预测压缩），一种神经压缩框架，它将空间编码、时间预测和熵优化残差编码解耦，并以由条件熵降低驱动的率失真目标进行端到端训练。关键的是，我们指出熵编码是流式部署的主要瓶颈。我们通过GPU端符号计算、缓存概率表、无GIL的并行算术编码，结合FP16推理和批量熵编码来解决该问题，从而构建围绕GPU环形缓冲区的完整实时流水线。我们在实时DAS测试床上验证该流水线，在31.04 dB全频带PSNR下实现98.85%的文件大小缩减，平均吞吐量为535 MB/s，超过1 kHz、81 km DAS流所需的324 MB/s。我们进一步表明，在实际流式比特率下，STeP-C显著优于传统编解码器，可在同一采集系统内无需重新训练应用于未见过的通道范围，并在很大程度上保持下游检测器一致性，高置信类别一致率为96.62%，检测到的事件类型的Jaccard相似度为100%。

items.title_en: PSEN1 loss-of-function variants do not cause early-onset Alzheimer's disease
items.title_zh: PSEN1功能缺失变异不导致早发性阿尔茨海默病
items.abstract_en: PSEN1 variants are the most common cause of familial early-onset Alzheimer's disease (EOAD), but it is debated whether they act through a loss- or gain-of-function. Following a recent report of a duo with EOAD carrying a predicted loss-of-function (LoF) stop-gain variant (p.K109*) in PSEN1, we sought to determine whether PSEN1 LoF variants, as a class, cause EOAD. We identified 45 carriers of PSEN1 LoF variants predicted to trigger nonsense-mediated decay in the Alzheimer's Disease Sequencing Project, UK Biobank, and BioVU databases. None of these carriers had a recorded case of early-onset dementia, and 17 were older than 65 years at last follow-up with no dementia or AD reported. Re-analysis of the reported AD-associated variant p.K109* revealed a cryptic splice site predicted to produce an in-frame deletion of 5 amino acids (p.K109_L113del). These results suggest that PSEN1 variants must produce an altered PSEN1 protein product to cause EOAD, while true null LoF PSEN1 alleles do not cause EOAD.
items.abstract_zh: PSEN1变异是家族性早发性阿尔茨海默病（EOAD）最常见的原因，但关于它们是通过功能缺失还是功能获得发挥作用仍存在争议。近期一项报告报道了一对携带PSEN1中预测功能缺失（LoF）终止增益变异（p.K109*）的EOAD二人组，我们据此试图确定PSEN1 LoF变异作为一类是否导致EOAD。我们在阿尔茨海默病测序计划、英国生物银行和BioVU数据库中识别出45名携带预测会触发无义介导衰变的PSEN1 LoF变异的携带者。这些携带者中没有人记录有早发性痴呆病例，其中17人在最后一次随访时年龄超过65岁，未报告痴呆或AD。对已报道的AD相关变异p.K109*的重新分析揭示了一个隐蔽剪接位点，预测会产生5个氨基酸的框内缺失（p.K109_L113del）。这些结果表明，PSEN1变异必须产生改变的PSEN1蛋白产物才能导致EOAD，而真正的无效LoF PSEN1等位基因不导致EOAD。

items.title_en: Probing the extreme quantum violation of the Leggett-Garg inequality
items.title_zh: 探究Leggett-Garg不等式的极端量子违反
items.abstract_en: The Leggett-Garg (LG) inequalities were formulated for testing the incompatibility between the classical worldview of macrorealism and quantum theory. By analogy with the Tsirelson bound for Bell inequalities, the maximal quantum violation of LG inequalities is commonly referred to as the temporal Tsirelson bound (TTB). Nevertheless, several studies have claimed that, unlike the Tsirelson bound, the TTB can be exceeded within quantum theory. In particular, by employing degeneracy-breaking measurement in [\href{ https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevLett.113.050401}{Phys. Rev. Lett. \textbf{113}, 050401 (2014)}] and by using the superposition of unitaries in [\href{https://doi.org/10.1103/vydp-9qqq}{Phys. Rev. Lett. \textbf{135}, 220202 (2025)}], it is argued that the TTB can be violated. In this work, we critically examine the reasoning underlying these purported TTB violations and show that the corresponding arguments suffer from conceptual shortcomings. We further show that once these conceptual issues are addressed appropriately, the macrorealist bound of LG inequality reaches the algebraic maximum, and hence no violation of the TTB is obtained. In particular, we demonstrate that the proposed TTB violations rely on frameworks that go beyond the standard LG framework, and therefore are of no relevance for testing the incompatibility between macrorealism and quantum theory.
items.abstract_zh: Leggett-Garg（LG）不等式被提出来检验宏观实在论的经典世界观与量子理论之间的不相容性。类比于贝尔不等式的Tsirelson界，LG不等式的最大量子违反通常被称为时间Tsirelson界（TTB）。然而，若干研究声称，与Tsirelson界不同，TTB在量子理论内可以被超越。特别是，通过在[Phys. Rev. Lett. 113, 050401 (2014)]中采用破缺简并的测量，以及在[Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 220202 (2025)]中使用酉算符的叠加，有人论证TTB可以被违反。在本工作中，我们批判性地审视这些所谓TTB违反背后的推理，并表明相应论证存在概念上的缺陷。我们进一步表明，一旦适当处理这些概念问题，LG不等式的宏观实在论界达到代数最大值，因此不会得到对TTB的违反。特别地，我们证明所提出的TTB违反依赖于超出标准LG框架的框架，因此与检验宏观实在论和量子理论之间的不相容性无关。

items.title_en: Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon
items.title_zh: Metal Sandbox：Apple Silicon上GPU编码代理的隔离执行与命令调度
items.abstract_en: On-device inference requires kernels that make effective use of local accelerators. Efficient training and evaluation of models that generate Apple Metal kernels benefit from native macOS tools and concurrent agent sessions. These sessions alternate between model requests, development commands, and GPU execution, leaving GPU capacity idle for much of a rollout. We present Metal Sandbox, infrastructure that combines restricted per-instance file access, native command execution, and command-level scheduling across interconnected Macs. Each agent retains its workspace and private development environment. Parallel commands can run concurrently, while serial commands share one execution slot per node; eligible waiting commands can migrate to available Macs and return results to the original agent. Integration with Harbor supports task execution, automatic verification, and rollout collection through a common workflow. Controlled experiments on four Mac mini M4 nodes achieve $1.68\times$--$2.05\times$ gains in command throughput under concentrated demand. Sixteen static agent traces give an estimated $2.14\times$ sustained-throughput gain for four sessions per node versus one, assuming continuously replenished sessions and unchanged mean durations. Replaying these measured traces under dynamic scheduling reduces mean tool waiting by 18.8% and batch elapsed time by 22.3%, assuming unchanged phase durations. Metal Sandbox and its Harbor integration are open-source on GitHub.
items.abstract_zh: 设备端推理需要能有效利用本地加速器的内核。高效训练和评估生成Apple Metal内核的模型，受益于原生macOS工具和并发代理会话。这些会话在模型请求、开发命令和GPU执行之间交替，使得rollout的大部分时间里GPU容量处于空闲状态。我们提出Metal Sandbox，这是一种基础设施，结合了受限的每实例文件访问、原生命令执行以及跨互联Mac的命令级调度。每个代理保留其工作区和私有开发环境。并行命令可以并发运行，而串行命令在每个节点共享一个执行槽；符合条件的等待命令可以迁移到可用的Mac，并将结果返回给原始代理。与Harbor集成支持通过统一工作流执行任务、自动验证和rollout收集。在四个Mac mini M4节点上的受控实验在集中需求下实现命令吞吐量1.68倍至2.05倍的提升。十六条静态代理轨迹给出的估计是：在假设会话持续补充且平均时长不变的情况下，每节点四个会话相对于一个会话可实现2.14倍的持续吞吐量增益。在假设阶段时长不变的情况下，在动态调度下重放这些实测轨迹将平均工具等待时间减少18.8%，批处理经过时间减少22.3%。Metal Sandbox及其Harbor集成已在GitHub上开源。

items.title_en: Synthesis Smuggling: Maliciously Hiding Inferred Personal Attributes in LLM Outputs
items.title_zh: 合成走私：在LLM输出中恶意隐藏推断出的个人属性
items.abstract_en: We propose Synthesis Smuggling, a novel threat model in which an adversarial LLM infers sensitive information about a user from routine assistance-seeking interactions and steganographically encodes that into innocuous-looking model-generated content. The user may then unknowingly transmit that information by sharing the generated artifact, say as an email, social-media post, or message, through ordinary communication channels. An adversary monitoring these channels can discover this information. We demonstrate this threat by training two open-weight models to infer gender and age-group labels from conversational cues and encode their predictions using invisible characters or word choices. These results show that user-shared model outputs can become a covert channel for personal inferences, even when the model itself has no direct means of contacting an adversary.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出Synthesis Smuggling，一种新的威胁模型：对抗性LLM从常规的求助交互中推断用户的敏感信息，并以隐写方式将其编码到看似无害的模型生成内容中。用户随后可能通过普通通信渠道分享生成产物（例如电子邮件、社交媒体帖子或消息），在不知情的情况下传输该信息。监控这些渠道的对手可以发现该信息。我们通过训练两个开放权重模型从对话线索中推断性别和年龄组标签，并使用不可见字符或词语选择编码其预测，从而演示这一威胁。这些结果表明，用户共享的模型输出可以成为个人推断的隐蔽通道，即使模型本身没有直接联系对手的手段。

items.title_en: DroneDiffusion: Uncertainty-Guided Diffusion Path Planner for UAV Navigation
items.title_zh: DroneDiffusion：面向UAV导航的不确定性引导扩散路径规划器
items.abstract_en: We present DroneDiffusion, a perception-aware diffusion planner for local 3-D UAV trajectory generation that explicitly models and avoids failure zones caused by lens flare, overexposure, and reflective surfaces. A vision-language perceptual safety estimator produces a pixel-aligned reliability map that highlights regions of degraded sensing. A denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) is conditioned on this map together with the onboard RGB image, goal point, and initial velocity to generate egocentric 3-D trajectories. To enforce obstacle avoidance at inference time without retraining, we apply training-free CHOMP guidance over a 3-D Euclidean signed distance field. The model is trained entirely in simulation and deployed zero-shot on a real drone. Reliability conditioning raises the mean perceptual reliability along generated trajectories to 0.71, compared with 0.63 for a geometric baseline, while guidance halves the collision rate of the learned prior from 14.7% to 7.8%. Perceptual safety conditioning and geometric guidance are therefore complementary: treating sensor reliability as a first-class signal reduces incursions into unreliable regions while maintaining competitive navigation performance.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出DroneDiffusion，一种感知感知的扩散规划器，用于局部三维UAV轨迹生成，它显式建模并避开由镜头眩光、过曝和反射表面引起的失效区域。一个视觉-语言感知安全估计器产生像素对齐的可靠性图，突出感知退化的区域。去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）以该图以及机载RGB图像、目标点和初始速度为条件，生成以自我为中心的三维轨迹。为了在推理时无需重新训练而强制避障，我们在三维欧几里得符号距离场上应用免训练CHOMP引导。该模型完全在仿真中训练，并零样本部署到真实无人机上。可靠性条件化将生成轨迹沿线的平均感知可靠性提高到0.71，而几何基线为0.63，同时引导将学习先验的碰撞率从14.7%减半至7.8%。因此，感知安全条件化和几何引导是互补的：将传感器可靠性视为一等信号可减少进入不可靠区域的侵入，同时保持有竞争力的导航性能。

items.title_en: Automated PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Scoring with Uncertainty-Guided Triage in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
items.title_zh: 非小细胞肺癌中基于不确定性引导分诊的自动化PD-L1肿瘤比例评分
items.abstract_en: Programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) tumor proportion score (TPS) informs immunotherapy selection in non-small cell lung cancer. Near the 1% and 50% cutoffs, the score should also indicate when closer review is warranted. We designed a three-stage framework to follow the sequence of TPS assessment. Stage 1 identifies tumor regions and excludes macrophage-rich patches. Stage 2, a dual-branch cell counting network (D2Count-Net), counts PD-L1-positive and PD-L1-negative tumor cells in these regions to calculate TPS. Stage 3, TPS-Guard, an uncertainty-guided triage mechanism, reports model uncertainty as the disagreement among independently trained models, refers the most uncertain slides, and flags scores near the 1% or 50% cutoff when model estimates disagree across that cutoff. Flags state the reason for referral or alert the pathologist to possible scoring errors on auto-reported slides. In a retrospective, single-center study, 154 whole-slide images were scored by three pathologists, and the model and each pathologist were compared in turn with the mean of the other two. On the 114 slides unseen in training, model mean absolute error (MAE) was 6.96 percentage points, within the range of the three pathologists (4.24 to 8.29), and model uncertainty correlated with absolute TPS error (Spearman rho = 0.77) and inter-pathologist disagreement (rho = 0.71). After referral of the 15% most uncertain slides, model and pathologist MAE both decreased. Applied without retraining to an external, publicly available dataset, TPS-Guard still directed review to higher-error cases, and referring more uncertain cases raised sensitivity at the 50% cutoff. TPS-Guard provides reasons for reviewing individual automated scores and identifies slides that also produce greater disagreement among pathologists. Prospective reader studies should assess TPS-Guard's effect on TPS reporting.
items.abstract_zh: 程序性死亡配体1（PD-L1）肿瘤比例评分（TPS）可为非小细胞肺癌的免疫治疗选择提供依据。在1%和50%临界值附近，该评分还应提示何时需要更仔细的复核。我们设计了一个三阶段框架，以遵循TPS评估的流程顺序。第1阶段识别肿瘤区域并排除富含巨噬细胞的斑块。第2阶段是一个双分支细胞计数网络（D2Count-Net），在这些区域中计数PD-L1阳性和PD-L1阴性肿瘤细胞，以计算TPS。第3阶段是TPS-Guard，一种不确定性引导的分诊机制，将模型不确定性报告为独立训练模型之间的不一致，转诊最不确定的切片，并在模型估计跨越1%或50%临界值不一致时标记接近该临界值的评分。标记会说明转诊原因，或提醒病理学家注意自动报告切片上可能的评分错误。在一项回顾性单中心研究中，154张全切片图像由三名病理学家评分，模型和每名病理学家依次与另外两人的均值进行比较。在训练中未见的114张切片上，模型平均绝对误差（MAE）为6.96个百分点，处于三名病理学家的范围内（4.24至8.29），并且模型不确定性与TPS绝对误差（Spearman rho = 0.77）以及病理学家间分歧（rho = 0.71）相关。在转诊最不确定的15%切片后，模型和病理学家的MAE均下降。在未经重新训练的情况下应用于外部公开数据集时，TPS-Guard仍将复核引导至误差较高的病例，并且转诊更多不确定病例提高了50%临界值处的敏感性。TPS-Guard为复核单个自动评分提供理由，并识别出也会在病理学家之间产生更大分歧的切片。前瞻性阅片研究应评估TPS-Guard对TPS报告的影响。

items.title_en: The contribution of Neanderthal ancestry to cancer risk
items.title_zh: 尼安德特人血统对癌症风险的贡献
items.abstract_en: Modern human genomes harbor DNA inherited from interbreeding with Neanderthals. Genetic variants inherited from Neanderthals associate with variation in many immune and metabolic phenotypes, two systems with direct relevance to cancer. However, the influence of Neanderthal variants on germline cancer risk has not been comprehensively evaluated. Here, we evaluated genome-wide association study (GWAS) hits for 17 cancer types for Neanderthal ancestry. Twelve cancers have multiple Neanderthal alleles significantly associated with variation in risk. Next, we fine-mapped these risk loci and identified 32 associations across seven cancers where Neanderthal variants are likely causal (>= posterior inclusion probability). Fine-mapped loci include Neanderthal alleles that both increase and decrease cancer risk. Nine of the 32 Neanderthal associations, including the high frequency BNC2 Neanderthal variants, have signatures of adaptive introgression, and several suggest evidence of both mediated and antagonistic pleiotropy. Finally, we tested for enrichment of cancer heritability in genomic regions with Neanderthal ancestry. As expected, Neanderthal variants are depleted of heritability for most cancers. However, Neanderthal variants were enriched for heritability in breast cancer GWAS in both East Asian and Europeans, and this enrichment replicated using individual-level UK Biobank data. These results suggest that Neanderthal alleles that influence germline cancer risk were largely selected against. However, introgressed Neanderthal variants implicated in many cancers persist, potentially due to adaptive pleiotropic effects. This evolutionary perspective provides new insights into the complex evolution and etiology of cancer risk among modern human populations.
items.abstract_zh: 现代人类基因组携带因与尼安德特人杂交而继承的DNA。从尼安德特人继承的遗传变异与许多免疫和代谢表型的变异相关，这两个系统与癌症直接相关。然而，尼安德特人变异对种系癌症风险的影响尚未得到全面评估。在此，我们评估了17种癌症类型的全基因组关联研究（GWAS）命中位点的尼安德特人血统。12种癌症具有多个与风险变异显著相关的尼安德特人等位基因。接下来，我们对这些风险位点进行了精细定位，并在七种癌症中识别出32个关联，其中尼安德特人变异可能是因果性的（>= 后验纳入概率）。精细定位的位点包括既增加又降低癌症风险的尼安德特人等位基因。32个尼安德特人关联中的9个，包括高频BNC2尼安德特人变异，具有适应性渗入的特征，其中若干提示既有中介性多效性又有拮抗性多效性的证据。最后，我们检验了具有尼安德特人血统的基因组区域中癌症遗传力的富集情况。正如预期，尼安德特人变异在大多数癌症中遗传力耗竭。然而，在东亚人和欧洲人的乳腺癌GWAS中，尼安德特人变异的遗传力均富集，并且这一富集在使用个体水平UK Biobank数据时得到重复。这些结果表明，影响种系癌症风险的尼安德特人等位基因在很大程度上受到了负选择。然而，与许多癌症相关的渗入尼安德特人变异仍然存在，可能是由于适应性多效性效应。这一进化视角为现代人类群体中癌症风险的复杂演化和病因学提供了新见解。

items.title_en: Quantum Material Generation via Coherent Hamiltonian Search
items.title_zh: 基于相干哈密顿量搜索的量子材料生成
items.abstract_en: Discovering new materials with targeted properties is a central goal of materials science, yet the space of candidates is vast. Data-driven generative models learn the distribution of known materials, but they extrapolate poorly, and a generated structure is not known to be stable. A material's properties follow from its Hamiltonian, and a quantum computer can calculate them from it. We introduce the quantum material generative algorithm (QMage), a coherent search, guided by the Hamiltonian, over crystalline configurations of atomic composition, unit cell structure, and atomic positions, for one whose calculated properties meet the targets to within a given error tolerance. The computation is a single coherent quantum circuit in which each configuration's Hamiltonian is block-encoded, its target eigenstate isolated and properties evaluated, and the satisfying configurations amplified by fixed-point search and measured. One framework covers many targets, from formation energy and band gaps to elasticity and conductivity. We design the algorithm for the mature fault-tolerant era and estimate its cost in logical qubits and Toffoli depth from a classically routine benchmark to targets where established methods are unreliable. The approach generates candidate materials from first principles, rather than generalizing from those known, and could enable materials discovery when the target properties are difficult to predict classically.
items.abstract_zh: 发现具有目标性质的新材料是材料科学的核心目标，但候选空间极其庞大。数据驱动的生成模型学习已知材料的分布，但外推能力较差，而且生成的结构并不已知是稳定的。材料的性质由其哈密顿量决定，量子计算机可以据此计算这些性质。我们提出量子材料生成算法（QMage），这是一种由哈密顿量引导的相干搜索，在原子组成、晶胞结构和原子位置的晶体构型上进行搜索，以找到一个其计算性质在给定误差容限内满足目标的构型。该计算是一个单一的相干量子电路，其中每个构型的哈密顿量被块编码，其目标本征态被分离并评估性质，满足条件的构型通过定点搜索被放大并测量。一个框架涵盖许多目标，从形成能和带隙到弹性和电导率。我们为该算法面向成熟的容错时代进行设计，并估计其在逻辑量子比特数和Toffoli深度方面的成本，范围从经典上常规的基准到既有方法不可靠的目标。该方法从第一性原理生成候选材料，而不是从已知材料进行泛化，并可能在对目标性质难以经典预测时实现材料发现。

items.title_en: Linear Regression with Self-Selection Bias in Polynomial Time
items.title_zh: 多项式时间内带自选择偏差的线性回归
items.abstract_en: We revisit the problem of estimating $k$ linear regressors with self-selection bias in $n$ dimensions up to error $\varepsilon$ with the maximum self-selection criterion, as introduced by Cherapanamjeri, Daskalakis, Ilyas, and Zampetakis [CDIZ23, STOC]. Our main result is a $\mathrm{poly}(n,k,1/\varepsilon)$ time algorithm for the unknown-index variant of this problem, thereby improving upon the running times of the best known algorithms due to Gaitonde and Mossel [GM24] and Kalavasis, Mehrotra, and Zhou [KMZ26, COLT] with exponential dependence on $k$. Our algorithm succeeds in the presence of correlated noise between regressors, which captures the related setting of max-affine regression. Consequently, we also give the first polynomial-time algorithm for this problem, improving on the prior works of Ghosh, Pananjady, Guntuboyina, and Ramchandran [GPGR22, IEEE Transactions on Information Theory] and Gaitonde and Mossel [GM24] with exponential dependence on $k$. Prior works exhaustively search over a $k$-dimensional subspace spanned by the regressors, using conditional moments of the response to test candidates. In contrast, our algorithm is driven by an improved understanding of the moments of the covariates. We show that, restricting to observations with large response values, the degree-$(\log n)$ Hermite moment of the covariates approximately decomposes as a sum of tensor powers of the regressors. The first step of our algorithm can be viewed as a tensor decomposition algorithm for these implicitly represented high-order tensors, which outputs unit vectors parallel to the regressors. A secondary step based on a simple variant of ordinary least squares extracts estimates for the regressors given these unit vectors. We believe our analytic insight and algorithmic components may have applications to designing efficient algorithms for other latent-variable problems.
items.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视 Cherapanamjeri、Daskalakis、Ilyas 和 Zampetakis [CDIZ23, STOC] 提出的问题：在 $n$ 维中以最大自选择准则估计 $k$ 个带自选择偏差的线性回归量，误差至多 $\varepsilon$。我们的主要结果是为该问题的未知索引变体给出一个 $\mathrm{poly}(n,k,1/\varepsilon)$ 时间算法，从而改进了 Gaitonde 和 Mossel [GM24] 以及 Kalavasis、Mehrotra 和 Zhou [KMZ26, COLT] 所给出、对 $k$ 呈指数依赖的最佳已知算法的运行时间。我们的算法在回归量之间存在相关噪声时仍然成功，这涵盖了最大仿射回归的相关设定。因此，我们还给出了该问题的首个多项式时间算法，改进了 Ghosh、Pananjady、Guntuboyina 和 Ramchandran [GPGR22, IEEE Transactions on Information Theory] 以及 Gaitonde 和 Mossel [GM24] 对 $k$ 呈指数依赖的先前工作。先前工作穷举搜索由回归量张成的 $k$ 维子空间，并使用响应的条件矩来检验候选。相比之下，我们的算法由对协变量矩的改进理解所驱动。我们表明，在限制为具有大响应值的观测时，协变量的 $(\log n)$ 阶 Hermite 矩近似分解为回归量的张量幂之和。我们算法的第一步可视为针对这些隐式表示的高阶张量的张量分解算法，其输出与回归量平行的单位向量。基于普通最小二乘的简单变体的第二步在给定这些单位向量时提取回归量的估计。我们相信，我们的分析洞见和算法组件可能可用于为其他潜变量问题设计高效算法。

items.title_en: Parsed, Plausible, Wrong: Output Format Controls Silent Errors in Small-Model Semantic Parsing
items.title_zh: 可解析、看似合理、实则错误：输出格式控制小模型语义解析中的静默错误
items.abstract_en: A small fine-tuned parser that emits a well-formed but wrong tree fails silently: nothing downstream can tell. We ask whether the output format, a free design choice, controls how often this happens. On the PIZZA ordering benchmark we fine-tune two sub-billion models (Qwen3.5-0.8B and LFM2.5-350M) with LoRA on six lossless encodings of the same target tree, from 44.3 down to 10.9 tokens per order, including two matched-length pairs that vary surface form at fixed length. Across 300 runs (5 training pool sizes, 5 seeds) with a hierarchical bootstrap and Holm correction fixed before the results were read, shortening alone never helps, but writing the target in ordinary words does. The word encoding is the most accurate format on both models (87.5% vs. 85.8% exact match for the native s-expression on Qwen) while emitting 4.1x fewer tokens, and it cuts the silent error rate by 2.3x on Qwen and 1.8x on LFM2, separating at every pool size. Error analysis locates much of the gain in negation. All runs also learn to refuse off-menu input (held out: 95.9-99.0% handled) and to apply in-utterance self-corrections. Strict refusal has a measured price: 2.1-10.1% of real, mostly polite, orders are refused.
items.abstract_zh: 一个微调的小型解析器若输出格式良好但错误的树，会静默失败：下游无法察觉。我们询问输出格式这一自由设计选择是否控制这种情况发生的频率。在 PIZZA 订购基准上，我们使用 LoRA 对两个十亿参数以下的模型（Qwen3.5-0.8B 和 LFM2.5-350M）进行微调，采用同一目标树的六种无损编码，每个订单从 44.3 个 token 降至 10.9 个 token，其中包括两个在固定长度下改变表面形式的匹配长度对。在 300 次运行（5 种训练池大小、5 个随机种子）中，采用分层自助法和在读取结果前固定的 Holm 校正，仅缩短长度从无帮助，但用普通词语书写目标确实有帮助。词语编码在两个模型上都是最准确的格式（在 Qwen 上为 87.5% 对原生 s-表达式的 85.8% 精确匹配），同时输出的 token 少 4.1 倍，并在 Qwen 上将静默错误率降低 2.3 倍、在 LFM2 上降低 1.8 倍，且在每种池大小下均有区分。错误分析将大部分增益定位于否定。所有运行还学会拒绝菜单外输入（留出：95.9-99.0% 得到处理）并应用话语内自我纠正。严格拒绝有一个可测量的代价：2.1-10.1% 的真实且多为礼貌的订单被拒绝。

items.title_en: Are We Ready for Snow-tonomous Driving? Challenges Toward Robust Automated Driving in Extreme Weather
items.title_zh: 我们准备好迎接“雪中自动驾驶”了吗？极端天气下实现稳健自动驾驶所面临的挑战
items.abstract_en: Automated driving has gained remarkable momentum over the past decade, with both industry and academia investing substantial resources in developing perception and control solutions to advance vehicle autonomy. However, these efforts have largely focused on clear-weather scenarios, leaving harsh conditions, such as snow, rain, and fog, comparatively understudied. As a result, inclement weather remains one of the most significant hurdles for autonomous vehicles, often leading to substantial performance degradation in downstream perception and control tasks. In this paper, we present insights from the EU-funded Horizon Europe project ROADVIEW, which aims to develop robust, weather-aware perception and control modules for connected and automated vehicles operating under severe conditions, including snow, rain, and fog. Drawing on four years of large-scale development and real-world demonstrations across multiple vehicle platforms in different locations, we identify ten key challenges that hinder the development of weather-resilient autonomy, including data scarcity, domain shifts, limitations in multimodal perception, control robustness, and validation gaps, among others. We summarize these challenges and lessons learned toward enabling reliable snow-autonomous driving, highlighting critical directions for future research and standardization.
items.abstract_zh: 过去十年，自动驾驶获得了显著发展势头，工业界和学术界都投入大量资源开发感知与控制解决方案，以推进车辆自主性。然而，这些努力主要集中在晴朗天气场景，导致雪、雨和雾等恶劣条件相对研究不足。因此，恶劣天气仍是自动驾驶汽车最重要的障碍之一，往往导致下游感知和控制任务性能显著下降。在本文中，我们介绍欧盟资助的 Horizon Europe 项目 ROADVIEW 的见解，该项目旨在为在雪、雨和雾等严酷条件下运行的网联和自动驾驶车辆开发稳健的、天气感知的感知与控制模块。基于四年的大规模开发以及在多个地点、多个车辆平台上的真实世界演示，我们识别出阻碍天气韧性自主性发展的十项关键挑战，包括数据稀缺、域偏移、多模态感知的局限性、控制稳健性和验证缺口等。我们总结了这些挑战和经验教训，以推动实现可靠的雪中自动驾驶，并强调未来研究和标准化的关键方向。

items.title_en: Fog-FWL: A Large-Scale Full-Waveform LiDAR Dataset for Recovering Fog-Hidden Objects
items.title_zh: Fog-FWL：用于恢复雾中隐藏物体的大规模全波形激光雷达数据集
items.abstract_en: LiDAR is a core sensor for autonomous driving, yet it is highly vulnerable to fog. Fog scattering produces strong backscatter near the sensor and attenuates reflections from objects behind it, so weak object returns are often discarded by the peak detection that converts received signals into point clouds. Full-waveform LiDAR (FWL), which records the received optical signal before peak detection, retains these weak returns, but the lack of suitable data has prevented research on recovering fog-hidden objects from FWL. We present Fog-FWL, a dataset foundation for this task that consists of a real-world benchmark, Fog-FWL-Real, and a large-scale synthetic training set, Fog-FWL-Sim. Fog-FWL-Real contains 7,527 real foggy FWL frames from 8 scenes and 58 sequences, which is 579x larger than the only existing real foggy FWL data, together with histogram-level Object/Fog/Noise labels, 10,719 3D bounding boxes, and three difficulty levels defined by the attenuation of object reflections. Fog-FWL-Sim contains 12,000 frames generated by our physics-based simulator, Fog-FWL-Simulator, which integrates spatially heterogeneous fog density fields, time-resolved light transport including multiple scattering, and a photon-counting SPAD receiver model. The two subsets share the same sensor format and annotation protocol, enabling a strict sim-to-real evaluation in which no real waveforms are used for training. Our analysis shows that, under the hardest condition, object returns are included in the three strongest peaks for only 34.9% of object rays, underscoring the need for waveform-level recovery. Fog-FWL-Real, Fog-FWL-Sim, and the Fog-FWL-Simulator will be publicly released to facilitate research on fog-robust LiDAR perception.
items.abstract_zh: 激光雷达是自动驾驶的核心传感器，但极易受雾影响。雾散射会在传感器附近产生强后向散射，并衰减来自其后方物体的反射，因此弱物体回波常被峰值检测丢弃，而峰值检测正是将接收信号转换为点云的过程。全波形激光雷达（FWL）在峰值检测之前记录接收到的光信号，从而保留这些弱回波，但缺乏合适数据一直阻碍着从FWL中恢复雾中隐藏物体的研究。我们提出Fog-FWL，作为该任务的数据集基础，包含真实世界基准Fog-FWL-Real和大规模合成训练集Fog-FWL-Sim。Fog-FWL-Real包含来自8个场景、58个序列的7,527帧真实雾天FWL帧，是现有唯一真实雾天FWL数据的579倍，并附带直方图级物体/雾/噪声标签、10,719个3D边界框，以及按物体反射衰减定义的三个难度等级。Fog-FWL-Sim包含由我们基于物理的模拟器Fog-FWL-Simulator生成的12,000帧，该模拟器集成了空间非均匀雾密度场、包含多次散射的时间分辨光传输以及光子计数SPAD接收器模型。两个子集共享相同的传感器格式和标注协议，从而支持严格的仿真到真实评估，其中训练不使用任何真实波形。我们的分析表明，在最难条件下，仅34.9%的物体光线的物体回波包含在三个最强峰中，这凸显了波形级恢复的必要性。Fog-FWL-Real、Fog-FWL-Sim和Fog-FWL-Simulator将公开发布，以促进雾鲁棒激光雷达感知研究。

items.title_en: On the minimum energy required to trigger a spike
items.title_zh: 论触发尖峰所需的最小能量
items.abstract_en: We formulate and numerically study the problem of finding the minimum energy required to trigger a spike in a three-dimensional conductance-based excitable model. The variational formulation seeks a state trajectory that reaches the boundary of the spiking region with the least \textit{peak} cumulative work supplied through the membrane port. We approximate voltage histories by sums of real exponentials, reducing the problem to a finite-dimensional optimization. The best-found voltage waveform consists of a hyperpolarization phase followed by a depolarization phase, which seems to match the experimentally determined optimal stimulus in squid giant axons.
items.abstract_zh: 我们表述并数值研究在三维基于电导的可兴奋模型中寻找触发尖峰所需最小能量的问题。该变分表述寻求一条状态轨迹，使其以通过膜端口供给的最小峰值累积功到达放电区域边界。我们将电压历史近似为实指数之和，从而将问题约化为有限维优化。找到的最佳电压波形由超极化阶段后接去极化阶段组成，这似乎与鱿鱼巨轴突中实验确定的最优刺激相符。

items.title_en: Single Spin Hall Conversion in the Hall Response of Magnetic-Insulator/Heavy-Metal Bilayers Identified by Odd Spin-Hall-Angle Dependence
items.title_zh: 由奇自旋霍尔角依赖关系识别的磁性绝缘体/重金属双层霍尔响应中的单次自旋霍尔转换
items.abstract_en: The Hall response of magnetic-insulator/heavy-metal bilayers is usually ascribed to two successive spin Hall conversions and is therefore expected to be even in the spin Hall angle. Using distinct magnetic-field windows, we separate the Hall voltage of yttrium iron garnet bilayers with Ta and Pt of opposite spin Hall angle into contributions from magnetization- and magnetic-field-driven precession as well as from ordinary Hall effect. The field-driven component reverses sign between Ta and Pt, revealing a Hall response odd-in-spin-Hall-angle. The magnetization-driven component also has opposite signs for Ta and Pt, except for the thinnest heavy-metal layers. A drift-diffusion model with interface-generated spin currents describes this behavior: the field-driven component is predominantly carried by a single spin Hall conversion, and the magnetization-driven component is consistent with one as well. Other potential explanations, based on a description with a finite imaginary spin-mixing conductance rather than interface-generated spin currents, require unusually large values of this conductance, making this mechanism unlikely. Our findings advance the understanding of Hall responses in magnetic-insulator/heavy-metal bilayers toward a more general description.
items.abstract_zh: 磁性绝缘体/重金属双层的霍尔响应通常被归因于两次连续的自旋霍尔转换，因此预期其在自旋霍尔角中为偶函数。利用不同的磁场窗口，我们将具有相反自旋霍尔角的Ta和Pt的钇铁石榴石双层的霍尔电压分离为磁化驱动进动、磁场驱动进动以及普通霍尔效应的贡献。场驱动分量在Ta和Pt之间反号，揭示出霍尔响应在自旋霍尔角中为奇函数。磁化驱动分量在Ta和Pt中也具有相反符号，但最薄的重金属层除外。带有界面生成自旋电流的漂移-扩散模型描述了这种行为：场驱动分量主要由单次自旋霍尔转换承载，磁化驱动分量也与单次转换一致。其他潜在解释基于用有限虚部自旋混合电导而非界面生成自旋电流的描述，需要该电导具有异常大的值，使该机制不太可能。我们的发现推进了对磁性绝缘体/重金属双层中霍尔响应的理解，朝向更一般的描述。

items.title_en: Sheaf-Inspired Structured Scoring Extensions of LightGCN for Collaborative Filtering
items.title_zh: 受层论启发的LightGCN结构化评分扩展用于协同过滤
items.abstract_en: Graph-based collaborative filtering learns user and item representations by propagating embeddings over a user--item interaction graph. We investigate a modular, sheaf-inspired scoring extension placed on top of a three-layer LightGCN backbone. The motivation comes from cellular sheaves, where local vector spaces are related by linear restriction maps; here, this idea motivates structured, pair-dependent transformations of user and item embeddings rather than a change to graph propagation. We compare the identity inner-product scorer, diagonal, rank-one low-rank, and full matrix residual scorers, and a parameter-matched residual MLP baseline (\texttt{mlp\_full}) on Amazon-Book, Gowalla, MovieLens-1M, and Yelp2018. We report ranking quality and catalog coverage at cutoffs 10 and 20. The selected structured variants show modest, dataset-dependent changes in ranking quality and sometimes substantial changes in coverage. Our method is inspired by sheaf geometry but does not construct a cellular sheaf or implement sheaf-Laplacian diffusion; the experiments therefore do not establish a causal benefit from sheaf geometry itself.
items.abstract_zh: 基于图的协同过滤通过在用户-物品交互图上传播嵌入来学习用户和物品表示。我们研究一种模块化的、受层论启发的评分扩展，将其置于三层LightGCN主干之上。动机来自细胞层，其中局部向量空间通过线性限制映射相关联；在这里，这一思想激发对用户和物品嵌入进行结构化的、依赖对的变换，而不是改变图传播。我们在Amazon-Book、Gowalla、MovieLens-1M和Yelp2018上比较恒等内积评分器、对角评分器、秩一低秩评分器、全矩阵残差评分器，以及参数匹配的残差MLP基线（mlp_full）。我们报告截断10和20处的排序质量和目录覆盖率。所选结构化变体在排序质量上表现出适度的、依赖数据集的变化，有时在覆盖率上有显著变化。我们的方法受层几何启发，但不构建细胞层或实现层-拉普拉斯扩散；因此实验并未确立层几何本身的因果收益。

items.title_en: Optimal Single-History Tokenization Disambiguation for Provably Secure Linguistic Steganography
items.title_zh: 面向可证明安全语言隐写的最优单历史分词消歧
items.abstract_en: Provably secure linguistic steganography assumes that the receiver recovers the sender's tokens, but a text channel delivers only text, and ambiguous tokenizations break extraction. Existing fixes change the distribution, synchronize whole pools of tokens at a capacity that collapses with large vocabularies, or track several token histories. We prove that if extraction is exact and error-free across full-support language models, a single-history receiver is confined to a prefix-free candidate set at every step -- even if it reads the entire future text and the sender constrains later steps -- and must therefore give up the stop entropy, the entropy of deciding whether each prefix token ends there. Fixing these stop decisions on the prefix forest with shared randomness yields coin projection: a closed-form scheme that attains the bound, works with any distribution coder in one model call per token, preserves ordinary sampling, and refines SyncPool for every key. Across English, Chinese and Japanese, ambiguous text is rare (at most 11 in 1,000 tokens), yet the stop entropy at word and morpheme prefixes takes 7.2-9.0% of the entropy at every step; SyncPool's further loss comes from space and single-byte UTF-8 hubs that merge subtrees while carrying almost no stop uncertainty. Coin projection keeps 91-93% of the string entropy for the coder at every vocabulary size; with the full vocabulary, it turns 2.16-6.85 times as much entropy into message bits as SyncPool and recovers every completed message.
items.abstract_zh: 可证明安全的语言隐写假设接收方恢复发送方的词元，但文本信道仅传递文本，而有歧义的分词会破坏提取。现有修复方法会改变分布、以在大词汇表下会崩溃的容量同步整个词元池，或跟踪多个词元历史。我们证明，如果提取在全支撑语言模型上精确且无差错，单历史接收方在每一步都被限制在一个无前缀候选集内——即使它读取整个未来文本且发送方约束后续步骤——因此必须放弃停止熵，即决定每个前缀词元是否在此结束的熵。利用共享随机性在前缀森林上固定这些停止决策，可得到硬币投影：一种闭式方案，达到该界，可与任何分布编码器配合并在每个词元一次模型调用中工作，保留普通采样，并对每个键细化SyncPool。在英语、中文和日语中，歧义文本很少见（最多每1,000个词元中11个），但词和语素前缀处的停止熵占每一步熵的7.2-9.0%；SyncPool的进一步损失来自空格和单字节UTF-8枢纽，它们合并子树而几乎不携带停止不确定性。硬币投影在每个词汇表大小下为编码器保留91-93%的字符串熵；在完整词汇表下，它转化为消息比特的熵是SyncPool的2.16-6.85倍，并恢复每条完成的消息。

items.title_en: Does Your World Model Know Actions Have Consequences?
items.title_zh: 你的世界模型知道行动会产生后果吗？
items.abstract_en: Embodied world models (WMs) are implicit learning systems that predict the next future latent state directly from observations and actions. Unique from other end-to-end learning systems, the dynamics predictor of WMs can simulate the environment's response to alternative actions without physical deployment nor pre-specifying states of the dynamical system. Current metrics focus on the quality of model outputs, e.g., clarity of reconstructions or task success, but fail to assess the fidelity of modeling consequences of counterfactual actions. Inspecting the forced response to action perturbations through sensitivity analysis is one way to audit how well WMs can predict the consequences of counterfactual actions. Deploying WMs on hardware will require new evaluation frameworks to analyze the tradeoffs between state error and accurate sensitivity prediction.
items.abstract_zh: 具身世界模型（WM）是隐式学习系统，直接从观测和动作预测下一个未来潜在状态。与其他端到端学习系统不同，WM的动力学预测器可以在无需物理部署或预先指定动力系统状态的情况下，模拟环境对替代动作的响应。当前指标关注模型输出的质量，例如重建的清晰度或任务成功率，但未能评估对反事实动作后果建模的保真度。通过敏感性分析检查对动作扰动的强迫响应，是审计WM预测反事实动作后果能力的一种方式。在硬件上部署WM将需要新的评估框架来分析状态误差与准确敏感性预测之间的权衡。

items.title_en: Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes
items.title_zh: 基于参考帧的无人机视频稳定中的共识捕获：动态城市场景基准
items.abstract_en: Reference-frame stabilization registers every frame of a hovering-drone video onto one reference frame, keeping object positions comparable. The registration pipelines it relies on are selected on feature-matching benchmarks in which only the camera moves. Over a busy intersection, vehicles moving together supply mutually consistent correspondences that can draw the robust homography estimate toward their motion: consensus capture, which inlier statistics cannot flag. A two-part benchmark measures it and the object masking meant to prevent it. A static protocol scores ten pipelines under exactly known homographies on 4K aerial frames, tuned on a site-disjoint split at a matched resolution and feature budget. A dynamic protocol scores them at an offline and a real-time budget on hovers selected from the video alone to span the amount and coherence of moving foreground, plus a stationary control. It measures background alignment, object position error and the share of a moving group's displacement an estimate follows, against a pseudo-ground-truth reference audited with manually annotated ground control points, which also score every candidate. On static scenes, tuned AKAZE, RootSIFT, SIFT and BRISK lead, retuning the matcher thresholds raises the mean average accuracy (mAA) by at most 0.0062, and masking costs less than 0.005. Unmasked ORB is captured on 28 of 304 real-time dynamic pairs and on 6 offline; its real-time captured estimates have a median corner error of 18.8 px yet typical inlier counts and ratios. Masking removes capture for every pipeline and leaves the leading pipelines unchanged. Code, data and results are released.
items.abstract_zh: 参考帧稳定将悬停无人机视频的每一帧配准到同一参考帧上，使物体位置保持可比。其所依赖的配准流程是在仅相机运动的特征匹配基准上选择的。在繁忙十字路口，共同运动的车辆提供相互一致的对应关系，可能将稳健单应性估计拉向它们的运动：共识捕获，而内点统计无法标记这种现象。一个两部分基准测量该现象以及旨在防止它的物体掩蔽。静态协议在精确已知单应性下对10种流程在4K航拍帧上评分，并在站点不相交的划分上以匹配的分辨率和特征预算进行调优。动态协议在离线与实时预算下对它们评分，所用悬停片段仅从视频中选择，以覆盖移动前景的数量与连贯性范围，并加入静止对照。它测量背景对齐、物体位置误差以及估计跟随移动群体位移的比例，并以伪真值参考为基准，该参考经人工标注地面控制点审核，这些控制点也对每个候选进行评分。在静态场景中，调优后的AKAZE、RootSIFT、SIFT和BRISK领先；重新调优匹配器阈值使平均平均准确率（mAA）最多提高0.0062，掩蔽代价小于0.005。未掩蔽的ORB在304个实时动态对中的28个以及离线中的6个上被捕获；其实时被捕获估计的中位角点误差为18.8像素，但内点计数和比例仍属典型。掩蔽消除了每种流程的捕获现象，且领先流程保持不变。代码、数据和结果已发布。

items.title_en: Prototypes of the Mind: A Unified Framework for Probing the Visual Brain
items.title_zh: 心智原型：探测视觉大脑的统一框架
items.abstract_en: Deep learning has driven substantial progress in modeling fMRI responses, yet most existing approaches are optimized for a single objective---such as neural encoding, stimulus decoding, or post hoc interpretation---making it difficult to obtain a coherent account of neural representations. We introduce a unified framework that connects vision foundation models to brain activity while supporting neural analysis from multiple complementary perspectives. Our approach replaces black-box features with a sparse, interpretable representation composed of visual prototypes, and links these prototypes to voxel responses through a linear readout. This design makes the model transparent at both levels: prototype activations expose the visual concepts present in the stimulus, while the learned linear weights characterize each voxel's selectivity. Using this interface, we identify which visual concepts drive neural responses and where they appear in the image, reveal cortical organization through voxel tuning in prototype space, and perform controlled stimulus synthesis to probe cortical selectivity through targeted interventions. Together, these results establish prototype-based representations as a unified and interpretable foundation for studying visual representations in the human brain.
items.abstract_zh: 深度学习在fMRI响应建模方面取得了显著进展，但现有大多数方法针对单一目标进行优化——例如神经编码、刺激解码或事后解释——这使得难以获得对神经表征的一致描述。我们提出一个统一框架，将视觉基础模型与大脑活动联系起来，同时支持从多个互补视角进行神经分析。我们的方法用由视觉原型组成的稀疏、可解释表征替代黑箱特征，并通过线性读出将这些原型与体素响应联系起来。这种设计使模型在两个层面透明：原型激活揭示刺激中存在的视觉概念，而学习到的线性权重刻画每个体素的选择性。利用这一接口，我们识别哪些视觉概念驱动神经响应以及它们在图像中出现的位置，通过原型空间中的体素调谐揭示皮层组织，并进行受控刺激合成，以通过定向干预探测皮层选择性。这些结果共同确立基于原型的表征作为研究人脑视觉表征的统一且可解释的基础。

items.title_en: Multi-head Quantum Neural Networks: Replacing Transformer Blocks with NISQ Modules inside a 30-Billion-Parameter LLM
items.title_zh: 多头量子神经网络：在300亿参数LLM内部用NISQ模块替换Transformer块
items.abstract_en: We introduce the multi-head quantum neural network (QNN), a quantum module compatible with noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices that can replace transformer blocks inside pre-trained large language models (LLMs) with little loss in accuracy and with far fewer parameters than the blocks it replaces. Encoding a model's $D$ hidden neurons into a qubit register is the obstacle: amplitude encoding scales poorly in circuit depth and angle encoding in qubit count, so neither is practical at production-scale width. We instead partition the hidden space into $k$ disjoint heads, angle-encode each into an $n_q$-qubit register, process the heads in parallel, and couple them through constrained classical linear layers, the mixers. Performing surgery on Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, we show that a single multi-head QNN with $145\,281$ trainable parameters ($D=2048$, $k=32$, $n_q=8$, $L=4$) can replace a contiguous span of eight transformer blocks, displacing $16.33\%$ of the model's parameters. Ablations show that, for a single replaced block, the quantum heads (circuits followed by a learned readout), and not the classical mixers alone, recover the displaced function, whereas for fused spans the mixers alone come within $1$-$3\%$ of the full module in perplexity. Whether this benefit is specific to trained, entangling quantum circuits is not established: controls that switch the entangler off (two seeds), or freeze the circuit at its initial or at uniformly random angles (one seed), beat the full module on held-out perplexity, and a parameter-matched classical multilayer perceptron remains a few percent ahead of the full module. We train classically with exact statevector simulation, then execute the quantum heads of our fusion checkpoints on a $156$-qubit IBM Heron processor, showing that NISQ-scale quantum modules can be installed in a production-scale LLM and run on hardware.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出多头量子神经网络（QNN），一种与含噪中等规模量子（NISQ）设备兼容的量子模块，可在预训练大语言模型（LLM）内部替换Transformer块，精度损失很小，且参数远少于其所替换的块。将模型的D个隐藏神经元编码到量子比特寄存器中是障碍：振幅编码在电路深度上扩展性差，角度编码在量子比特数上扩展性差，因此二者在生产规模宽度下都不实用。我们转而将隐藏空间划分为k个不相交的头，将每个头角度编码到n_q个量子比特的寄存器中，并行处理这些头，并通过受约束的经典线性层（混合器）耦合它们。对Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507进行手术，我们表明一个具有145,281个可训练参数（D=2048，k=32，n_q=8，L=4）的单个多头QNN可以替换连续八个Transformer块，替换掉模型16.33%的参数。消融表明，对于单个被替换块，量子头（电路后接学习读出）而非仅经典混合器恢复了被替换的功能；而对于融合跨度，仅混合器在困惑度上达到完整模块的1-3%以内。这一收益是否特定于经过训练、具有纠缠的量子电路尚未确定：关闭纠缠器的对照（两个种子），或将电路冻结在初始角度或均匀随机角度的对照（一个种子），在留出困惑度上优于完整模块，而参数匹配的经典多层感知机仍比完整模块领先几个百分点。我们使用精确态矢量模拟进行经典训练，然后在156量子比特的IBM Heron处理器上执行融合检查点的量子头，表明NISQ规模量子模块可以安装到生产规模LLM中并在硬件上运行。

items.title_en: Discovering Effective Agent Memory Designs through Program Evolution
items.title_zh: 通过程序演化发现有效的智能体记忆设计
items.abstract_en: Program evolution provides a promising approach to discover agent memory designs and study the choices underlying their effectiveness. We introduce MAPE, a framework that evolves whole memory programs from minimal seeds through a standardized lifecycle interface and an iterative diagnosis-proposal loop. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval yield an absolute accuracy gain of up to 12% over manually designed baselines at 35% of the serving cost, with further evaluations supporting transfer across serving backbones and benchmarks. Empirical analyses and ablations identify and validate two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversations as retrievable evidence preserves details omitted from extracted memories, while composing retrieved evidence according to query intent helps the answering model use it effectively. Transplanting the composition module into five existing memory systems improves accuracy across all five. Beyond these patterns, the search objective shapes where computation goes: optimizing serving cost alongside accuracy shifts computation from LLM-based memory construction to selective processing at query time while retaining competitive accuracy. Together, these findings offer empirical lessons for agent memory design. Code is available at https://github.com/ash-ding/MAPE.
items.abstract_zh: 程序演化为发现智能体记忆设计并研究其有效性背后的选择提供了一种有前景的方法。我们提出MAPE，一个通过标准化生命周期接口和迭代诊断-提议循环，从最小种子演化完整记忆程序的框架。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的实验相对于人工设计基线在35%的服务成本下取得最高12%的绝对准确率提升，进一步评估支持跨服务骨干和基准的迁移。实证分析和消融识别并验证了两种反复出现的设计模式：保留原始对话作为可检索证据可保留提取记忆中被省略的细节，而根据查询意图组合检索到的证据有助于回答模型有效使用它。将组合模块移植到五个现有记忆系统中，五个系统的准确率均得到提升。除这些模式外，搜索目标决定了计算去向：在优化服务成本的同时兼顾准确率，会将计算从基于LLM的记忆构建转向查询时的选择性处理，同时保持有竞争力的准确率。这些发现共同为智能体记忆设计提供了经验教训。代码见 https://github.com/ash-ding/MAPE。

items.title_en: Terrain-Aware Thompson Sampling for Multi-Drone Search and Rescue
items.title_zh: 面向多无人机搜索与救援的地形感知Thompson采样
items.abstract_en: In this work, we propose a decentralized terrain-aware multi-drone Thompson Sampling algorithm tailored for search and rescue (SAR) applications. A probability distribution of locating a lost person is informed by terrain data, using established SAR models (displacement ring, elevation, watershed, dispersion angle, and track offset) derived from historical SAR case data on lost person behavior. Exploration is conducted by a team of drones using Thompson Sampling, where candidate actions are selected by drawing samples from this probability distribution, represented by a per-cell Gaussian posterior whose mean and variance are updated through Bayesian inference. This approach balances exploration of uncertain regions with exploitation of high-probability areas to locate a lost person. Observation uncertainty is incorporated through fractional forest coverage, which measures the percentage of an observation occluded by tree coverage and accounts for reduced detection performance in densely vegetated areas. Simulations using real SAR case data (YOSAR) evaluate the proposed method against a coverage planner and a probabilistic active search method in search regions of 1.5 and 3.8 square kilometers, with 5, 10, 15, and 20 agents flying at 50 km/hr. We demonstrate that our method achieves a success rate of approximately 87% within 60 to 247 seconds in the 1.5 square kilometer region, and success rates of approximately 75% to 91% within 161 to 466 seconds in the 3.8 square kilometer region, across different agent configurations.
items.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出一种面向搜索与救援（SAR）应用的分散式地形感知多无人机Thompson采样算法。定位失踪人员的概率分布由地形数据提供信息，使用从关于失踪人员行为的历史SAR案例数据中得出的既定SAR模型（位移环、高程、分水岭、扩散角和轨迹偏移）。由一组无人机使用Thompson采样进行探索，候选动作通过从该概率分布中抽取样本进行选择，该分布由逐单元高斯后验表示，其均值和方差通过贝叶斯推断更新。该方法在探索不确定区域与利用高概率区域之间取得平衡，以定位失踪人员。观测不确定性通过森林覆盖比例纳入，该比例衡量观测被树木覆盖遮挡的百分比，并考虑茂密植被区域中检测性能的降低。使用真实SAR案例数据（YOSAR）的仿真在1.5和3.8平方公里的搜索区域中，以5、10、15和20架智能体以50公里/小时飞行，将所提方法与覆盖规划器和概率主动搜索方法进行比较。我们证明，在不同智能体配置下，我们的方法在1.5平方公里区域中于60至247秒内达到约87%的成功率，在3.8平方公里区域中于161至466秒内达到约75%至91%的成功率。
